### Chapter-4

मानवसहजप्रयोजन

### The Human Purpose

●​विश्रामकेलियेहीइसपृथ्वीपरमानवअपनेमहत्वकोजानने, पहचाननेकेप्रयासएवंप्रयोगमेंव्यस्तहै।Humans on this Earth are engaged in endeavours and experiments to know and recognise their significance, solely for attaining restfulness. ●​एकसेअधिकमानवएकत्रयासंगठितहोनेकोपरिवार, समुदायवअखण्डसमाजसंज्ञाहै।जागृतमानवपरम्परामेंसार्वभौमव्यवस्थापूर्वकअखण्डसमाजप्रमाणितहोताहै।More than one human coming together or becoming organised is referred to as a family, community, or undivided society. In the awakened human tradition, undivided society is evidenced along with the universal orderliness. ●​संगठनकेलिएकारणसाम्यतालक्ष्यसाम्यताआवश्यकहै।इसकेनिर्वाहकेलिएकार्यक्रमसाम्यताभीआवश्यकहै।For an organisation, commonness of cause and goal is necessary. For its sustainment, commonness of the program is also necessary.

○​अकेलेमेंमानवकेजीवनमेंकोईकार्यक्रम, व्यवहारएवंउत्पादनसिद्धनहींहोताहै।इसपृथ्वीपरमानवअधिकतमविकसितइकाईहै।इससेविकसितइकाईइसपृथ्वीपरपरिलक्षितनहींहै।मानवइसीलिएविकसितइकाईसिद्धहुआहै, क्योंकि :-

1.​वहमानवेतरसृष्टिकेउपयोग, सदुपयोग, शोषणएवंपोषणमेंसक्षमहै।2.​मानवतथामानवेतरतीनोंसृष्टिमेंपाएजानेवालेगुण, स्वभावएवंधर्मकाज्ञातामानवहीहै।3.​मानवेत्तरसृष्टिमेंनपायेजानेवालेस्वभाव, व्यवहारएवंअनुभूतिकोमानवमेंपायाजाताहै।

Humans cannot accomplish any program, behaviour, or production in isolation. They are the most evolved beings on Earth, and there is no unit on Earth more evolved than them. Humans prove to be the most evolved because: 1.​They are capable of use, right-use, exploitation and nurturing the rest of

nature.

2.​Only humans are the knowers of properties, essential nature and dharma of

humans and rest of the nature.

3.​Humans possess essential nature, behaviour, and realisation that are not

found in rest of the nature.

page-55

●​सामाजिकतासेआवश्यकता; आवश्यकतासेप्रयोगएवंउत्पादन; प्रयोगएवंउत्पादनसेअर्थोपार्जन; अर्थोपार्जनसेउपयोग, सदुपयोगवप्रयोजनशीलता; उपयोग, सदुपयोगवप्रयोजनशीलतासेव्यवहारिकता; व्यवहारिकतासेमानवीयतातथामानवीयतासेअखण्डसामाजिकताहै।अखण्डसामाजिकताकेअर्थमेंसार्थकहै।

Sociality gives rise to needs; needs give rise to experimentation and production; experimentation and production give rise to creation of wealth; creation of wealth gives rise to use, right-use and purposeful-use; use, right-use and purposeful-use give rise to practicality; practicality gives rise to humaneness, and humaneness gives rise to sociality. Sociality is meaningful when it is towards undivided sociality.

○​अखण्डता :- अखण्डतासार्वभौमतासहजसूत्रव्याख्यारूपमेंमानवकाप्रयोजन।Indivisibility (akhandta): - The human purpose in the form of essence and elaboration of universality.

○​सामाजिकता:- सम्पर्कएवंसंबंधमेंनिहितमूल्योंकानिर्वाहहीसामाजिकताहै।Sociality (samajikta): - Fulfilling the values inherent in relationships and associations itself is sociality. ○​आवश्यकता :-​निर्वाहकेलिएसमुचितसाधनोंकेप्रति (जोसमझदारपरिवारमेंनिर्धारितहोताहै) तीव्रइच्छाहीआवश्यकताहै।यहशरीरपोषण-संरक्षणसमाजगतिकेअर्थमें।Needs (avashyakta): - The strong desire for adequate resources, determined by a wise family, for fulfilling the values itself is the need. This is meant for bodily nourishment-protection, and societal participation.

○​समुचितसाधन :- मानवकीपरस्परतामेंव्यवहार, प्रयोगएवंउत्पादनकोसंतुलित, समृद्धएवंजागृतिपूर्णप्रमाणपरंपराकेलिएप्रयुक्तआवश्यकीयसाधनोंकीसमुचितसाधनसंज्ञाहै।शरीरपोषण, संरक्षणवसमाजगतिकेलिएअर्पित, समर्पितवस्तुयेंसमुचितसाधनहैं।Adequate resources (samuchit sadhan): - Adequate resources refer to the resources necessary for ensuring balance in behaviour among humans, prosperity in experimentation and production, and evidence of awakening in the tradition. The adequate resources are the objects offered and devoted for bodily nourishment, protection, and societal participation. ○​प्रयोग :- मानवकीआवश्यकताकेरूपमेंप्राकृतिकऐश्वर्यपरश्रमनियोजनपूर्वकउपयोगितामूल्यवकलामूल्यकोस्थापितकरनेहेतुसफलहोतेतकप्रयासहीप्रयोगहै।Experimentation (prayog): - The endeavour, until success is achieved, to meet a human need by instilling usefulness and aesthetic value on natural abundance through the deployment of labour, itself is experimentation. ○​उत्पादन :- प्रयोगकोसामान्यीकृतकरनेहेतुविकसितक्रियापद्धतिमेंश्रमनियोजनप्रक्रियाकीउत्पादनसंज्ञाहैजिसमेंबहुतायतउत्पादनकीअथवानिर्माणकीकामनासन्निहितरहतीहीहै।उत्पादनदोभेदसेहोताहै - सामान्यआकाँक्षासेअथवामहत्वाकाँक्षासे।Production (utpadan): - The process developed for standardising experimentation through the deployment of human labour is referred to as production. Inherent in it is the desire for abundant production or construction. The production takes place in two ways - through common aspiration and through special aspiration.

page-56

○​सामान्यआकाँक्षा :- आहार, आवासएवंअलंकारमेंप्रयुक्तवस्तुओंकोसामान्यआकाँक्षासंज्ञाहै।Common aspiration (samanya akanksha): - The objects used in food, shelter and adornment are referred to as common aspiration. ○​महत्वाकाँक्षा :- दूरगमन, दूरदर्शनतथादूरश्रवणकेलिएप्रयुक्तवस्तुओंकोमहत्वाकाँक्षासंज्ञाहै।Special aspiration (mahattvakanksha): - The objects used in transportation and telecommunication are referred to as special aspiration. ○​अर्थोपार्जन :- प्राकृतिकऐश्वर्यपरउपायपूर्वकश्रमनियोजनसेकलाएवंउपयोगिताकीसिद्धमात्राकीधनोपार्जनसंज्ञाहैं।Earning of wealth (arthoparjan): - The definite measure of usefulness and aesthetic value realised from natural abundance through the planned deployment of human labour is referred to as earning of wealth. ○​उपयोग :- उत्पादनवसेवाकेलिएप्रयुक्तअर्थकीउपयोगसंज्ञाहै।Use (upyog): - The deployment of means for production and seva,is referred to as use. ○​सदुपयोग :- परिवारमूलकस्वराज्यव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीकरतेहुएतन, मन, धनरूपीअर्थकानियोजनसदुपयोगहै।Right-use (sadupyog): - Right-use refers to the utilisation of resources in the form of body, mind and wealth while participating in the family-based self-organising orderliness.○​प्रयोजन :- जागृतिपूर्वकअखण्डसमाजसार्वभौमव्यवस्थामेंतन, मन, धनकानियोजनप्रयोजनहै।Purposeful-use (prayojansheelta): - Purposeful-use refers to the utilisation of body, mind and wealth towards undivided society and universal orderliness upon awakening. ○​व्यवहारिकता :- मानवीयतापूर्णआचरणकीव्यवहारिकतासंज्ञाहै।Practicality (vyavharikta): - Humane conduct is referred to as practicality. ●​अखण्डसामाजिकताकाअध्ययनमानवीयस्वभाव, विषयएवंदृष्टिकेआधारपरहीहै, जिसकेसंरक्षणहेतुसामाजिकव्यवस्थाहै।The study of undivided sociality is based solely on humane nature, propensity, and perspective, and societal orderliness is meant for its protection. ●​उपरिवर्णितआधारपरअध्ययनकरनेपरमानवप्रवृत्तियोंकीकुलतीनप्रकारसेगणनाहोतीहै :- 1. अमानवीयता 2. मानवीयता 3. अतिमानवीयता।Based on the above, human tendencies is seen to have three categories: (1) Inhumaneness, (2) Humaneness and (3) Higher humaneness.

page-57

○​अमानवीयस्वभाव, विषयएवंदृष्टिकासंरक्षण, संवर्धनएवंप्रोत्साहनदेनेहेतुकीगईव्यवस्थाअमानवीयअथवापाशविकप्रवृत्तिव्यवस्थाहै।The orderliness that protects, nurtures and encourages inhumane nature, propensity and perspectives is an inhumane or animalistic orderliness. ○​अमानवीयस्वभाव :- दीनता, हीनताएवम्क्रूरताहीअमानवीयस्वभावहै।Inhumane Nature (amanveeya svabhav): - Servility, perfidy and cruelty itself is inhumane nature. ○​अमानवीयविषय :- आहार, निद्रा, भयएवम्मैथुनहीअमानवीयविषयहै।Inhumane propensity (amanveeya vishaya): - Eating, sleeping, defending and mating are the inhumane propensities.

○​अमानवीयदृष्टि :- प्रियाप्रिय, हिताहितएवम्लाभालाभहीअमानवीयदृष्टिहै।

Inhumane Perspective (amanveeya drishti): - Pleasant-unpleasant, healthy-unhealthy and profit-loss only are the inhumane perspectives. ○​प्रिय :- ऐन्द्रियसुखसापेक्षक्रियाकीप्रियसंज्ञाहै।Pleasant (priya): - The activity of seeking sensory gratification is referred to as the pleasant perspective. ○​हित :- शरीरस्वास्थ्यवर्धनएवंपोषणक्रियाकीहितसंज्ञाहै।Health (hita): - The activity of seeking wellbeing and nourishment of the body is referred to as the health perspective. ○​लाभ :- श्रमसेअधिकद्रव्यपानेकीक्रियाकोलाभअथवालघुमूल्यकेबदलेगुरुमूल्यआदायहीलाभहै।Profit (labh): - The activity of seeking more worth than the labour performed is referred to as the profit perspective. Getting higher value in exchange for lower value itself is profit. ○​दीनता :- अपनेदु:खकोदूसरोंसेदूरकरानेहेतुजोआश्रयप्रवृत्तिहै, उसकीदीनतासंज्ञाहै।Servility (deenta): - The tendency to seek refuge in others to alleviate one's misery is referred to as servility. ○​दीनताअभावजन्ययाअक्षमताजन्यदोप्रकारकीहोतीहै।Servility arises out of deprivation or incapacity. ○​अभाव :- उत्पादनसेअधिकउपभोगएवंउपयोगकीइच्छाहीअभावहै।आलस्य, प्रमाद, अज्ञान, अप्राप्ति, प्राकृतिकप्रकोपतथासामाजिकअसहयोगअभावकेकारणहैं।

page-58

Deprivation (abhav): - The desire to consume or use more than what is produced itself is deprivation. Laziness, negligence, ignorance, scarcity, natural calamities, and societal non-cooperation are the causes of deprivation. ○​अक्षमता :- इच्छानुसारबौद्धिकएवंकार्य-व्यवहारक्रियाकासंपादननकरपानाहीअक्षमताहै।अक्षमताकाकारणअजागृतिऔररोगहै।Incapacity (akshamta): - Incapacity refers to the inability to perform intellectual activity or the desired work and behaviour. Disease and unawakening are the causes of incapacity. ○​हीनता :- विश्वासघातहीहीनताहै।Perfidy (heenta): - Betrayal of trust itself is perfidy. ○​विश्वासघात :- जिससेजिसक्रियाकीअपेक्षाहै, उसकेविपरीतआचरणकियाजानाहीविश्वासघातहै।Betrayal of trust (vishwasghat): - The conduct contrary to what is expected from someone itself is betrayal. ○​छल :- विश्वासघातकेअनन्तरभीउसकाभासयाप्रकटनहोऐसेविश्वासघातकीछलसंज्ञाहै।Deceit (chhal): - The betrayal that goes unnoticed or undisclosed even after it occurs is referred to as deceit. ○​कपट :- विश्वासघातकेअनन्तरउसकेप्रकटयास्पष्टहोजानेकीस्थितिमेंविश्वासघातकीकपटसंज्ञाहै।Fraud (kapat): - The betrayal that gets revealed or exposed afterwards is referred to as fraud. ○​दम्भ :- आश्वासनदेनेकेपश्चात्भीकिएगयेविश्वासघातकीदम्भसंज्ञाहै।Duplicity (dambh): - The betrayal that is done even after giving assurance, is referred to as duplicity. ○​पाखण्ड :- दिखावापूर्वककिएगएविश्वासघातकीपाखण्डसंज्ञाहै।Hypocrisy (pakhand): - The betrayal that is done with ostentation is referred to as hypocrisy. ○​क्रूरता :- स्व-अस्तित्वकोबनाएरखनेकेलिएबलपूर्वकदूसरेकेअस्तित्वकोमिटानेमेंजोवैचारिकप्रयुक्तितथाशोषणकार्यहै, उसेक्रूरताकहतेहैं।Cruelty (kroorta): - The use of intellect to forcefully eliminate the existence of others to ensure one's own survival or the exploitation activity, is called cruelty. ○​अपराधएवंप्रतिकारक्रूरताकेदोभेदहैं।Crime and retaliation are two distinctions of cruelty.

page-59

○​अपराध : - परधन, परनारी/परपुरुष, परपीड़ात्मककार्यव्यवहारहीअपराधहै।Crime (apradh): - Ill-gotten wealth, adultery, and hurtful work & behaviour to others, constitute crimes. ○​अपराधात्मकक्रूरताहिंसाकेरूपमेंव्यक्ततथाप्रतिकारात्मकक्रूरताप्रतिहिंसाकेरूपमेंव्यक्तहै।Criminal cruelty is expressed in the form of violence, while retaliatory cruelty is expressed in the form of counter-violence. ●​मानवीयस्वभाव, विषयएवम्दृष्टिकोसंरक्षण, संवर्धनएवम्प्रोत्साहनदेनेवालीव्यवस्थामानवीयव्यवस्थाहै।

The orderliness that protects, nurtures, and encourages humane nature, propensity, and perspective, is referred to as the humane orderliness.

o​मानवीयस्वभाव :- धीरता, वीरताऔरउदारताहीमानवीयस्वभावहै।

Humane nature (manveeya svabhav): - Fortitude, courage, and generosity itself is humane nature. o​मानवीयविषय :- पुत्रेषणा, वित्तेषणाएवंलोकेषणामानवीयविषयहै।

Humane propensity (manveeya vishaya): - Progeny-motive, wealth-motive, and reputation-motive are humane propensities. o​मानवीयदृष्टि :- न्यायान्याय, धर्माधर्मएवंसत्यासत्यमानवीयदृष्टिहै।

Humane Perspectives (manveeya drishti): - Justice-injustice, dharma-adharma, and truth-untruth are humane perspectives. o​न्याय :- मानवीयताकेसंरक्षणात्मकनीतिपूर्वककियेजानेवालेव्यवहारव्यवस्थाहीन्यायहै।

Justice (nyaya): - Justice pertains to the orderliness of behaviour based on policies that protect humaneness. ●​अतिमानवीयस्वभाव, विषयएवंदृष्टिकीजागृतिकेलिएसमुचितअवसरएवंसाधनकोनियोजितकरनेवालीव्यवस्थाएवंवैयक्तिकप्रयासकोअतिमानवीयसामाजिकव्यवस्थाकहतेहैं।अखण्डसमाज, परिवारमूलकस्वराज्यव्यवस्थावमानवसहजप्रमाणपरम्पराहीअतिमानवीयसामाजिकव्यवस्थाहै।Orderliness or individual endeavour that provides adequate opportunities and resources for the cultivation of higher-humane nature, propensity, and perspectives is called a higher-humanely societal orderliness. A higher-humanely societal orderliness is exemplified by undivided society, family-based self-organising orderliness, as evidence of humane tradition.

○​अतिमानवीयस्वभाव :- दया, कृपाऔरकरुणाहीअति-मानवीयस्वभावहै।

Higher-humane nature (atimanveeya svabhav): - Kindness, grace and compassion itself is the higher-humane nature.

page-60

○​दया :- जिनमेंपात्रताहो, परंतुउसकेअनुरूपवस्तुउपलब्धनहो, ऐसीस्थितिमेंउसेवस्तुउपलब्धकरानेहेतुकीगयीप्रयुक्तिहीदयाहै।Kindness (daya): - Those who have the receptivity, but lack the corresponding content, the endeavour of making that content available to them is kindness.

○​कृपा :- वस्तुसमीचीनहैपरउसकेअनुरूपपात्रताअर्थात्मानवीयतापूर्णदृष्टिनहींहै, उनकोपात्रताउपलब्धकरानेवालीप्रयुक्तिकृपाहै।Grace (krupa): - When the content is available, but its corresponding receptivity or humane perspective is lacking, then the endeavour of instilling that receptivity itself is grace. ○​करुणा :- जिनमेंपात्रतानहोऔरवस्तुभीसमीचीननहों, उनकोउसेउपलब्धकरानेवालीप्रयुक्तिहीकरुणाहै।Compassion (karuna): - Those who neither have receptivity nor have the content available, then the endeavour of making those available to them itself is compassion. ○​अतिमानवीयविषय :- सत्य (सह-अस्तित्वरूपीपरमसत्य) Higher-humane propensity (atimanveeya vishaya): - Benevolence (ultimate truth in the form of coexistence). ○​अतिमानवीयदृष्टि :- मात्रसत्य।Higher-humane perspective (atimanveeya drishti): - Only Truth.

●​न्यायवअन्यायसहितलक्ष्यभेदसेसंपर्कसफलएवंअसफलसिद्धहोताहै, जिससेसामाजिकताकाविकासवह्राससिद्धहोताहै।

An association succeeds or fails depending on whether its goal is with justice or injustice, which leads to development or decline of sociality respectively.

○​सम्पर्क :- जिसपरस्परतामेंप्रत्याशाएँऐच्छिकरूपमेंनिहितहै, ऐसेमिलनकीसंपर्कसंज्ञाहै।Association (sampark): - The mutuality where expectations are voluntary, such union is referred to as association. ○​ऐहिकउद्देश्य (जीवचेतनावश) सेसंबंधनहींहै।संबंधआमुष्मिकउद्देश्य (विकसितचेतना, मानव, देवमानवदिव्यमानवसहजप्रमाण) पूर्वकहीहैं, जिनकानिर्वाहहीजागृतिहै।The relationships are not for mundane objectives of animal consciousness. Instead, relationships are for higher objectives, i.e. evidencing developed consciousness as humane-human, deific-human, and divine-human. Fulfilling these objectives itself is awakening. ○​संबंध :- जिसपरस्परतामेंप्रत्याशाएँपूर्णताकेअर्थमेंपूर्वनिश्चितरहतीहैं, ऐसेमिलनकीसंबंधसंज्ञाहै।

page-61

Relationship (sambandh): - The mutuality where expectations are predetermined in the sense of completeness, such union is referred to as relationship.

●​सामाजिकताकानिर्वाहकर्त्तव्यएवंनिष्ठासेहै, जिससेअखण्डता-सार्वभौमतारुपमेंसामाजिकताकाविकासतथाअन्यथासेह्रासहै।The fulfilment of sociality is through duty and dedication, which leads to the development of sociality in the form of indivisibility and universality. Otherwise, its decline occurs.

○​निर्वाह :- समाधान, समृद्धिसहितउपयोग, सद्उपयोगवप्रयोजनोंकोप्रमाणितकरनाअथवापरस्परपूरकसिद्धहोना।Fulfilling (nirvaha): - Fulfilling is to evidence use, right-use and purposeful-use along with resolution and prosperity, or to prove being mutually complementary. ○​कर्त्तव्य :- मानवीयतापूर्णविधिसेकरनेयोग्यकार्य-व्यवहारएवंमूल्यनिर्वाहक्रियाहीकर्त्तव्यहै।Duty (kartavya): - Performing work & behaviour and the activity of fulfilling the values through humane way, itself is duty.

○​निष्ठा :- कर्त्तव्यएवंदायित्वनिर्वाहकीनिरंतरताहीनिष्ठाहै।Dedication (nishtha): - Continuity of fulfilling duties and responsibilities itself is dedication. ○​सामाजिकताकेनिर्वाहकेलियेसमाधान, समृद्धिआवश्यकहै, इसकेलियेबौद्धिकएवंभौतिकसाधनहै।Resolution and prosperity are necessary for fulfilling sociality, for which humans have intellectual and physical means. ○​साधन :- साधककोअथवासाध्यकेलियेआवश्यकीयवस्तुएवंपात्रताकोसाधनसंज्ञाहै, जोहरसाधकमेंअपेक्षणीयहै।Means (sadhan): - The necessary resources and receptivity for a seeker to achieve their aim are referred to as means, which are expected in every seeker. ○​बौद्धिकसाधन :- क्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रताकेरूपमेंबौद्धिकसाधनहै।Intellectual means (bauddhik sadhan): - The intellectual means are in the form of capacity, ability and receptivity. ○​भौतिकसाधन :- सामान्यएवंमहत्वाकाँक्षाओंकेलियेआवश्यकीयरचनाएवंवस्तुउत्पादनकेरूपमेंभौतिकसाधनहैं।Physical means (bhautik sadhan): - The physical means are in the form of materials and objects used for common aspirations and special aspirations.

page-62

○​उपरोक्तानुसारवर्णितसाधनोंकोप्रयुक्तकरनेहेतुजोप्रयत्न, प्रयासएवंव्यवसाय (उत्पादनक्रिया) है, उसमेंइच्छाकाहोनाआवश्यकहै।The desire has to be there for using the means mentioned above in trials, endeavours, and vocation (production activities). ●​जोजिसकोपानेकेलियेतीव्रइच्छासेसंवेगितहोताहै, वहउसेपायेबिनातृप्तनहींहोताहै।

One who is driven with a strong desire to achieve something, does not become satisfied until they have accomplished it.

○​बौद्धिकएवंभौतिकसाधनोंकीप्रयुक्तिकेलिएइच्छा, किसीनकिसीआवश्यकताकीपूर्तिकेलियेहीहोतीहै।यहआवश्यकतास्वार्थ, परार्थअथवापरमार्थभेदसेहोतीहै।The desire for using intellectual and physical means is meant for satisfying a certain need only. This need is differentiated to be selfish, altruistic and benevolent.

○​स्वार्थ :- सीमितएवंसंकीर्णअर्थनियोजनयोजनाकीस्वार्थसंज्ञाहै।जोएकमानवअथवापरिवारतकहीसीमितरहतीहैअथवावैयक्तिकयापारिवारिकइन्द्रियसुख-सुविधाकेलियेजोविचारएवंव्यवहारहैवहस्वार्थहै।

Selfishness (svarth): – The planning to utilise resources in a limited and narrow way, confined only to one person or family, is referred to as selfishness. It signifies thoughts and behaviours aimed at seeking sensory pleasure and comfort only for oneself or one’s family. ○​परार्थ :- दूसरोंकीसुखसुविधाकेलियेजोविचारएवंव्यवहारऔरइसकीपूर्तिकेलियेअर्थनियोजनकीप्राथमिकताहीपरार्थहै।Altruism (pararth): – The thoughts and behaviours directed towards the comfort of others, along with prioritisation of utilising resources for this purpose, are referred to as altruism. ○​परमार्थ :- जिसविचारएवंव्यवहारमेंसमाधानसहितसर्वशुभकीउपलब्धिहोऔरसमस्याकानिराकरणहोऔरस्नेहकाहीसंबंधहो, इसेसर्वसुलभकरानेकेलियेजोअर्थनियोजनहै, उसकीपरमार्थसंज्ञाहै।Benevolent (paramarth): - The thoughts and behaviours that accomplish universal wellbeing along with resolution, offer solutions to problems, foster relationships based purely on affection, and utilise resources to make these accessible to all, are referred to as benevolent.

उपरोक्तनियमहीविभिन्नप्रकारकीगठितसामाजिकइकाईयोंकेलियेभीलागूहोगा।जिससेविभिन्नतासमाप्तहोकर, मानवीयतास्थापितहोेगी।The above law is applicable to variously constituted social entities as well, which will end their differences and establish humaneness.

○​अर्थमात्रतीनहीहैं :- मन, तन, धन।Resources are only three: - Mind, body, and wealth.

page-63

●​बौद्धिकप्रयोगएवंप्रयाससेबौद्धिकसमाधानतथाभौतिकप्रयोग, प्रयासएवंउत्पादनसेभौतिकसमृद्धिकीउपलब्धिहोतीहै।बौद्धिकसमाधानऔरभौतिकसमृद्धिसामाजिकताकेविकासकेलियेसहायकहै।Intellectual resolution is achieved through intellectual exercise and endeavour, while material prosperity is achieved through physical experimentation, endeavour, and production. Both intellectual resolution and material prosperity are helpful for the development of sociality.

○​भौतिकसमृद्धिकेलियेप्राकृतिकवैभवकाउपयोगएवंसदुपयोगअनिवार्यहै।खनिज, वनस्पतिऔरपशु-पक्षीप्राकृतिकवैभवहै।The use and right-use of natural abundance is mandatory for material prosperity. Natural abundance is in the form of entities of material order, biological order, and animal order. ○​प्राकृतिकवैभवकेउपयोगऔरसदुपयोगकेलियेश्रमरूपीअर्थकानियोजनआवश्यकहै।Deployment of resources in the form of physical labour is necessary for the use and right-use of natural abundance. ○​अर्थ :- तन, मनएवंधनकानियोजन, मानवीयतथाअतिमानवीयभेदसेप्रयुक्तकरनेसेसामाजिकताकाविकासहै।Resources (artha): - The utilisation of body, mind and wealth towards humaneness and higher-humaneness lead to the development of sociality. ●​अमानवीयसमुदायोंकेगठनकेमूलमेंभ्रमितमानवोंवबलवानजीवोंअर्थात्क्रूरताकाभयहै।इसीप्रकारमानवसमुदायगठनकेमूलमेंप्राकृतिकभय, पाशवीयभयतथामानवमेंनिहितअमानवीयताकेभयसेमुक्तहोनालक्ष्यहै।At the root of inhumane sects is the fear of cruelty by deluded humans and mighty animals. Similarly, at the root of the formation of a humane society is the goal of being free from the fear of natural events, fear of animals, and fear of inhumaneness in humans. ●​मानवमात्रद्वारासमस्तप्रयासएवंप्रयोगतृप्तिअथवासुखकेलियेहै।All human endeavours and experimentations are aimed at achieving satisfaction or happiness. ●​ऐन्द्रिय (भौतिक), बौद्धिक (वैचारिक) एवंआध्यात्मिक(अनुभूति) भेदसेतृप्तियाँअथवासुखहै।Satisfaction or happiness has the differentiation of sensory (physical), intellectual (ideological) and spiritual (realisation).

○​शॅब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रसएवंगन्धेन्द्रियोंद्वाराआहार, निद्रा, भयऔरमैथुनसेहोनेवालीसभीतृप्तियाँऐन्द्रियहैजोसामयिकहोतीहै।

page-64

Satisfaction arising through eating, sleeping, defending & mating through the senses of sound, touch, sight, taste & smell is referred to as sensory satisfaction, which is temporal. ○​वित्तेषणा, पुत्रेषणा, लोकेषणातथासमाधानसेप्राप्ततृप्तिकीबौद्धिकतृप्तिसंज्ञाहैजोदीर्घकालीनयादीर्घपरिणामीहोतीहै।The satisfaction from resolution, and from wealth-motive, progeny-motive & reputation-motive, is referred to as intellectual satisfaction, which is long-lasting. ○​ज्ञानानुभूतितथापूर्णविश्रामकीआध्यात्मिकतृप्तिसंज्ञाहैजोअपरिणामीअथवानित्यहै।The realisation in knowledge and complete restfulness is referred to as spiritual satisfaction, which is non-transformable or eternal. ○​वित्तेषणा​:-​सदुपयोगकेअर्थमेंन्यायदृष्टिपूर्वकधनबलकामनाहीवित्तेषणाहै।:- ​धन :- आहार, आवास, अलंकार, दूरश्रवण, दूरगमन, दूरदर्शनसंबंधीवस्तुएँ।Wealth-motive (vitteshna): - The wish for wealth earned with the perspective of justice, for right-use, is referred to as wealth-motive. : - Wealth is in the form of objects of food, shelter, adornment, transportation and telecommunication.

○​पुत्रेषणा :- परिवारएवंसमाजव्यवस्थाकेअर्थमेंजन-बलकामनाएवंवंशवृद्धिमेंविश्वासकीपुत्रेषणासंज्ञाहै।Progeny-motive (putreshna): - The wish for people’s strength for the family and societal orderliness, along with a trust in the continuation of the lineage, is referred to as the progeny-motive. ○​लोकेषणा :- अखण्डसमाजव्यवस्थाकेअर्थमेंन्याय, धर्मदृष्टिपूर्वकयश-बलकामनाहीलोकेषणाहै।Reputation-motive (lokeshna): - The wish for recognition for undivided society and universal orderliness based on justice and dharma is referred to as the reputation-motive. ○​समाधान:- कैसेऔरक्योंकीपूर्ति (उत्तर) हीसमाधानहै।Resolution (samadhan): - The fulfilment (answers) of how and why itself is resolution. ○​विश्राम :- जिसमेंश्रमनहींसमाधानहै, जिसकेद्वाराश्रमनहींहोताहैवहअनुभूतिहीविश्रामहै।Restfulness (vishram): - That in which there is no effort but has resolution, and by which there is no effort, that realisation itself is restfulness.

○​इच्छानुसारद्रवितहोनेवालेअंगकोइन्द्रिय, बोधकरने-करानेवालेअंगकोबुद्धि, सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभूतिअंगआत्मा, समस्तआत्माओंकेआधारभूतसत्ताकीअध्यात्मवपरमात्मासंज्ञाहै।

page-65

The part that functions as per desire is referred to as sense or work organ, the part that attains and imparts enlightenment is referred to as buddhi, the part that realises in coexistence is referred to as atma, and the omnipotent foundation of all atmas is the Spirit or Paramatma. ○​आवश्यकतातथाउपयोगिताकानिर्णयउपरोक्ततीनतृप्तिकारकअथवासुखकारकलक्ष्यभेदसेनिर्णयकियाजाताहै।The determination of need and usefulness is based on the three aforementioned goals (physical, intellectual, and spiritual) that lead to satisfaction and happiness. ●​ऐन्द्रिकतृप्तिक्षणिक, बौद्धिकतृप्तिदीर्घपरिणामीतथाआध्यात्मिक (अनुभव) तृप्तिनित्यअथवाअपरिणामीसिद्धहोतीहै।Sensory satisfaction proves to be momentary, intellectual satisfaction proves to be long-lasting, and spiritual satisfaction (realisation) proves to be ever-lasting or non-transformable. ●​प्रियाप्रिय, विषयसापेक्ष; हिताहित, शरीरसापेक्ष; लाभालाभ, वस्तुवसेवासापेक्ष; न्यायान्याय, व्यवहारसापेक्ष; धर्माधर्म, समाधानसापेक्षतथासत्यासत्य, अस्तित्वमेंअनुभवसापेक्षपद्धतिसेस्पष्टहोताहै।The pleasant-unpleasant perspective becomes clear with respect to instincts; healthy-unhealthy perspective becomes clear with respect to the body; profit-loss perspective becomes clear with respect to material goods and comforts; justice-injustice perspective becomes clear with respect to behaviour; dharma-adharmaperspective becomes clear with respect to resolution; and truth-untruth perspective becomes clear with respect to realisation in existence.

o​प्रियविषयप्राप्तहोनेपरइन्द्रियतृप्तिहोतीहै।अप्रियविषयप्राप्तहोनेपरइन्द्रियाँतृप्तनहींहोतीहै।

Sensory satisfaction happens upon getting a pleasant object. However, there is no sensory satisfaction upon getting an unpleasant object. o​हृदयकेतृप्तहोनेपरहिततथास्वास्थ्यलाभहोताहै।हृदयकेअतृप्तरहनेपरअहिततथास्वास्थ्यका

लाभनहींहोताहै।

Heart’s fulfilment leads to health gain. Heart’s unfulfillment leads to loss of health and the health gain doesn’t happen. ●​इंद्रियतृप्तिसामयिकप्रतिक्रियाहै।Sensory satisfaction is a temporal response.

o​तृप्ति :- आंदोलनोंसेमुक्तक्रियाहीतृप्तिहै।

Satisfaction (trupti): - Satisfaction is the activity devoid of turbulence.

page-66

o​आंदोलन :- हृदयकेसम्वर्धनतथासंरक्षणकीअक्षुण्णताइसकेक्रियाएवंगतिकेसंतुलनसेबनीरहती

है, इसक्रियाएवंगतिकाघटजानायाबढ़जानाहीआंदोलनहै।आंदोलनकासंबंधमूलतःसंवर्धनतथासंरक्षणसेहै।Turbulence (andolan): - The heart's wellbeing remains intact with balance in its activity and speed. Any deviation from this balance, due to increase or decrease in its activity and speed, constitutes a turbulence. Turbulence is related with the heart's wellbeing. o​इन्द्रियतृप्तिसेहृदयतृप्तिआवश्यकनहींहै, परहृदयतृप्तिसेइन्द्रियतृप्तिहोतीहै।

The sensory satisfaction doesn’t necessarily lead to the heart's satisfaction, but the heart's satisfaction leads to sensory satisfaction. ●​लघुमूल्यकेबदलेगुरुमूल्यकाआदाय (प्राप्ति) लाभहै।Obtaining a higher value in exchange for a lower value is profit.

●​लघुमूल्यकेबदलेगुरुमूल्यकाप्रदायतीनपरिस्थितियोंमेंहोताहै :- (1) विवशतावश, (2) स्वेच्छावशतथा (3) अज्ञानवश।

Higher value is offered in exchange for a lower value in three situations: (1) due to helplessness, (2) willingly, and (3) due to ignorance.

●​समस्तव्यवहारकुलछ: दृष्टियोंमेंपरिलक्षितहै :- (1) प्रियाप्रिय (2) हिताहित (3) लाभालाभ (4) न्यायान्याय (5) धर्माधर्मऔर (6) सत्यासत्य।

All human behaviour is manifest in six perspectives: - (1) pleasant-unpleasant, (2) healthy-unhealthy, (3) profit-loss, (4) justice-injustice, (5) dharma-adharma, and (6) truth-untruth.

o​अमानवीयदृष्टिसेयुक्तमानवोंकाव्यवहारमात्रतीनदृष्टियोंयथा-प्रियाप्रिय, हिताहितऔरलाभालाभ

केआश्रयमेंहै।मानवीयदृष्टिसेयुक्तमानवकाव्यवहारन्यायान्याय, धर्माधर्मएवंसत्यासत्यकेआश्रयमेंहै।The behaviour of humans with inhumane perspective is in the refuge of pleasant-unpleasant, healthy-unhealthy, and profit-loss. The behaviour of humans with humane perspective is in the refuge of justice-injustice, dharma-adharma, and truth-untruth. ●​मानवकेलिएआवश्यकीयव्यवहारन्यायपूर्णनियमोंकापालनहैतथाआवश्यकीयविचारधर्मपूर्णनियमोंकापालनहै।The necessary behaviour for humans is to adhere to the laws of justice, and the necessary thought for humans is to adhere to the laws of dharma.

o​उपरोक्तसूत्रकेविपरीतनियमोंकापालनहीमानवकेलियेअनावश्यकीयव्यवहारएवंविचारहै।

page-67

Any behaviour or thought that goes against these laws is unnecessary for humans. o​उपरोक्तानुसारसमस्तजीवअर्थात्पशु-पक्षी, वैषयिक-सामुदायिकप्राणीतथामानव

न्यायिक-सामाजिकइकाईसिद्धहोतेहैं।

According to the above, all animals prove to be instinctive and herd-like, while humans prove to be just and social entities. o​सामान्यत: पशुओंकीसामुदायिकताकाभासभयकीअवस्थामेंपरिलक्षितहुआहै।किसीभी

स्थितिमेंपशुओंकीसामुदायिकताकाभासअध्ययन, उत्पादनतथाव्यवस्थाकार्यमेंपरिलक्षितनहींहुआहैजबकिजागृतमानवोंमेंसामाजिकताकामूलआधारसमाधान, समृद्धि, अभय, सहअस्तित्वमेंजीनाहै।

The semblance of collectivity among animals is generally observed only in situations of fear. Under no circumstances is such collectivity observed in activities of study, production, or the maintenance of orderliness. In contrast, the foundational basis of sociality in awakened humans is living in resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence. o​पशुओंमेंआहार, निद्रा, भय, मैथुनयेचारविषयहीप्रसिद्धहैं, जबकिजागृतमानवोंमेंसामान्यतः

ऐषणात्रयअर्थात्पुत्रेषणा, वित्तेषणाऔरलोकेषणापाईजातीहैतथाविश्रामसहजरूपमेंसमाधान, समृद्धि, अभय, सहअस्तित्वमेंप्रमाणहोनापायाजाताहै।

Only the four primary instincts: eating, sleeping, defending, and mating are widely known in animals. In contrast, awakened humans commonly live with the desire-trio i.e. progeny-motive, wealth-motive, and reputation-motive, and they evidence resolution, prosperity, fearlessness, and coexistence with restfulness. ●​विश्रामहीदु:खकाउन्मूलनतथाभ्रमसेमुक्तिहीमोक्षहै।Restfulness itself is the eradication of unhappiness and liberation from delusion itself is moksha. ●​सृष्टिकाचरमलक्ष्यविश्रामहै, इसकाप्रमाणजागृतमानवपरम्पराहीहै।इसलिएहरभ्रमितमानवभीविश्रामकेलिएव्याकुलरहताहै।समाधानहीविश्रामहै।यहीअभ्युदयहै।The ultimate goal of the universe is restfulness, and its evidence is awakened human tradition only. Therefore, every deluded human also remains anxious for restfulness. Resolution itself is restfulness, which is abhyudaya, or comprehensive resolution.

o​सह-अस्तित्वमेंचारोंअवस्थाओंऔरचारोंपदोंकाअपने-अपनेलक्ष्यकेलिएकियाजानेवाला

क्रियाकलापहीसम्पूर्णसृष्टिहै।The activities of the four orders and the four planes in coexistence, directed towards their respective goals, comprise the entire universe.

●​मानवेतरजीवोंमेंजोज्ञानउपयोगमेंआयाहै, उसेसामान्यज्ञानसंज्ञाहै।मानवद्वाराजोव्यवहृतहै, वहदोवर्गमेंपरिलक्षितहै :- (1) ज्ञानसम्मतविवेकऔर (2) विज्ञान।

page-68

The knowledge that is used by animals is referred to as ordinary knowledge. However, what is practised by humans is apparent into two categories: (1) wisdom and (2) science aligned with knowledge. ●​विवेकऔरविज्ञानसम्पन्नहोनेकेकारणहीमानवनेविश्रामकोपहचानाहैतथाइसकेलिएसमुचितप्रयोगभीकियाहै, जोसृष्टिकेश्रमकाउद्देश्यएवंफलभीहै।Humans have been able to recognise restfulness through the accomplishment of wisdom and science. Furthermore, they have made significant efforts towards it, which is both the objective and the consequence of the universe's efforts. ●​भ्रमितमानवकर्मकरतेसमयमेंस्वतंत्रतथाफलभोगतेसमयमेंपरतंत्रहै, जबकिपशुकर्मकरतेसमयभीऔरफलभोगतेसमयभीपरतंत्रहै।जागृतमानवकर्मकरतेसमयस्वतंत्रतथाफलभोगतेसमयभीस्वतंत्रहै।A deluded human is independent while performing actions but dependent while experiencing their consequences, whereas animals are dependent both while performing actions and while experiencing their consequences. An awakened human is independent both while performing actions and while experiencing their consequences. ●​कर्मकीस्वतंत्रताकेफलस्वरूपहीमानवकोजितनाउन्नतावकाशहै, उतनाहीअवनतावकाशभीहै।फलत: मानवनेसामान्यत: क्रमश: विषयों, ऐषाणाओंतथामोक्षकेद्वाराविश्रामपानेकाप्रयासकियाहै।मोक्षकातात्पर्यसर्वतोमुखीसमाधानहै, यहीभ्रममुक्तिहै।इसेप्रमाणितकरनाहीजागृतिहै।Freedom in action provides humans with the potential for both progress and decline. Consequently, humans have sought to attain restfulness by pursuing instincts, righteous motives, and moksha. Moksha means comprehensive resolution, which is liberation from delusion. Evidencing this state itself is awakening.

o​पूर्वमेंवर्णितकियाजाचुकाहैकिविकसितइकाईमेंअविकसितइकाईकेअथवाविकसितसृष्टिमेंअविकसितसृष्टिकेसभीगुण, स्वभावएवंधर्मविलयरुपमेंरहतेहीहैं।तदनुसारमानवगलतीकरनेकाअधिकारलेकरतथासहीकरनेकाअवसरएवंसाधनलेकरजन्मताहै।क्योंकिपरम्परामेंहरमानव, मानवचेतनाकोपायानहींइसलिएसन् 2000 तकजीवचेतनामेंजीयाऔरजीवचेतनामेंगलतीकरताहीहै।उदाहरणार्थ :-

एकअध्यापककक्षामेंगणितपढ़ाताहै।अध्यापकसहीहीपढ़ाताहैऔरसबकोसमानरूपसेसंबोधितभीकरताहै, फिरभीविद्यार्थीगलतीकरतेहैं।इससेयहसिद्धहोताहैकिबालककेमनमेंभ्रमवशगलतीकरनेकीप्रवृत्तिहैही।इसीकेसाथयहभीसिद्धहोताहैकिमानवीयवातावरणवअध्यापनअर्थात्अध्यापककेबोधकरानेकीक्षमताकेआधारपरवहीविद्यार्थीपुन: सहीकरनेमेंभीसमर्थहोताहै।इससेयहसिद्धहोताहैकिवातावरणतथाअध्ययनप्रत्येकमानवकोएकअवसरवआवश्यकताकेरूपमेंमौलिकत: प्राप्तहैएवंजीवचेतनामेंजीतेहुएसहीकरनेकीप्रवृत्तिकासाक्ष्यहै।

Earlier, it has been explained that the developed universe includes all the properties, essential nature, and dharma of the undeveloped universe. Accordingly, humans are born with the choice to do what is wrong, while also having the opportunity and means to do what is right. However, every human could not find human consciousness from tradition. Consequently, humans lived in animal consciousness until the year 2000, and it is inevitable for them to make mistakes in such a state. For instance, consider a mathematics teacher instructing a class. They teach correctly and treat all students equally. However, some students still make

page-69

mistakes, demonstrating that humans tend to err due to delusion. Moreover, it has been observed that the same students become capable of performing correctly when they are provided with a humane environment and effective teaching. This proves that learning is an inherent need and opportunity for every human, and humans have the tendency to correct themselves despite being in animal consciousness. ●​मानवनेअपनीआवश्यकताकीपूर्तिकेलिएहीउत्पादनकार्यएवंप्रयोगकियाहै।उत्पादनएवंप्रयोगकाफलहीअर्थोपार्जनहै।Humans perform experiments and engage in production only to fulfil their needs. The experimentation and production leads to earning wealth.

o​प्रत्येकमानवप्राप्तअर्थकीसुरक्षाएवंसदुपयोगचाहताहै।

Every human wants security and right-use of available resources.

●​अपने-अपनेयोग्यता, क्षमताएवंपात्रताअनुसारप्रत्येकभ्रमितमानवनेप्राप्तअर्थकेसदुपयोगएवंसुरक्षाकीकामनासेवैयक्तिकनीतिनिर्धारणकियाजिससेमतभेदउत्पन्नहुआ।फलस्वरूपमानवनेसार्वभौमसिद्धांतपूर्णव्यवस्थाकेसंबंधमेंअन्वेषणकियाजिससेएकमौलिकसिद्धांतउपस्थितहुआ, जोनिम्नानुसारहै:-

“मानवसहीमेंएकतथागलतीमेंअनेकहै।”

Based on their respective ability, capacity, and receptivity, each deluded human formulated their individual policy with the desire for the right-use and security of available resources, which led to rise of disputes among them. Consequently, they began to explore a universal principled orderliness, leading to the discovery of one fundamental principle: “Humans are united in the right and divided in the wrong.”

●​सिद्धांतहीनियति, नियतिहीनियम, नियमहीविज्ञानएवंविवेक, विज्ञानएवंविवेकहीज्ञानतथाज्ञानहीसिद्धांतहै।Principle itself is destiny; destiny itself is law; law itself is wisdom and science; wisdom and science itself is knowledge; and knowledge itself is the principle.

o​सिद्धांत :- नियम, प्रक्रियाएवंउपलब्धिजिससमयभाषाकेरूपमेंअवतरितहोताहै, उसेसिद्धांत

कहतेहैं।प्रक्रियाकार्य-व्यवहारकेरूपमेंहैजिसकाफल-परिणामफलितहोताहै।Principle (siddhant): - The law, process, and accomplishment when it takes the form of language, is called as principle. The process is in the form of work and behaviour that has a particular outcome.

o​नियम :- ​क्रियाकेसंरक्षणएवंअनुशासनरीतिहीनियमहै।

Law (niyam): - The way of protection and discipline of an activity, is law.

●​मानवीयताकेसंरक्षणहेतुहीमानवसामाजिकतायथामानवीयतापूर्णसंस्कृति, सभ्यता, विधिऔरव्यवस्थाकाअध्ययन, प्रयोगएवंपालनकरनाचाहताहै, चूंकियहचारोंपरस्परपूरकहैं।Humans want to study, experiment, and adhere to sociality - i.e. humane culture, civilisation, way, and orderliness - for the protection of humaneness, as these four are mutually complementary. ●​विज्ञानएवंविवेकपूर्णविचार, व्यवहार, अध्ययन, अध्यापन, उत्पादन, उपयोग, सदुपयोग, वितरण, प्रचार, विधिएवंव्यवस्थाहीमानवीयताकेसंरक्षणकेलिएमानवद्वाराअनुभूतसंपूर्णकार्यक्रमहै।Science and wisdom based thought, behaviour, study, teaching, production, use, right-use, distribution, dissemination, way, and orderliness - all these constitute the comprehensive program for the protection of humaneness as realised by humans.

o​विचार :- ​प्रियाप्रिय, हिताहित, लाभालाभ, न्यायान्याय, धर्माधर्मतथासत्यासत्यतुलनात्मकवृत्तिकीक्रियाकेफलस्वरूपनिश्चितविश्लेषणहीविचारहै।Thought (vichar): - Thought is the definite analysis resulting from the deliberation with the perspectives of pleasant-unpleasant, healthy-unhealthy, profit-loss, justice-injustice, dharma-adharma, and truth-untruth. o​अध्ययन :- अधिष्ठानअर्थात्आत्माकीसाक्षीऔरअनुभवकीरौशनीमेंस्मरणसहितकियेगयेक्रिया,

प्रक्रियाएवंप्रयासहीअध्ययनहै।:- अधिष्ठानकीसाक्षीमेंबुद्धिद्वाराबोधपूर्वकस्मरणसहितकीगयीस्वीकृतिकीअध्ययनसंज्ञाहै।Study (adhyayan): - The activity, process, and endeavour carried out with remembrance, in the witness of the seat of knowledge or atma, and under the guiding light of realisation, is study. : - Study is the acceptance upon enlightenment by buddhi, with remembrance, in the witness of the seat of knowledge.

o​अध्यापन :- अनुभवमूलकविधिसेअधिष्ठानकीसाक्षीमेंबोधऔरसाक्षात्कारपूर्वकस्मरणसहित

ग्रहणकरानेयोग्यसत्यतापूर्वकक्रियाओंकोबोधगम्यबनानेयोग्यप्रक्रियाहीअध्यापनहै।Teaching (adhyapan): - The process with realisation-based way, in the witness of the seat of knowledge, upon enlightenment and contemplation, with remembrance, that makes the realities understandable truthfully, itself is teaching.

o​प्रचारएवंप्रदर्शन :- इच्छितवस्तुकीसामान्यजन-जातिकेमन-बुद्धिमेंअवगाहनकरानेहेतुप्रस्तुत

प्रक्रियाकेभाषात्मकप्रयोगहीप्रचारहैतथाकलाएवंभाषासहितप्रयुक्तप्रयासहीप्रदर्शनहै।Dissemination and Exhibition (prachar evam pradarshan): - The process of instilling the desired objective in the minds of the general public through language itself is dissemination. The exhibition is to use language and art in this endeavour. o​विधि :- एकयाअनेकव्यक्तियोंद्वाराअखण्डसमाजवसार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकोअक्षुण्णरखनेकेउद्देश्य

सेव्यवस्थाप्रदानकरनेहेतुनिर्णीतनियमपूर्णपद्धतियोंकीविधिसंज्ञाहै।

Way (vidhi): - Way refers to the lawful methods decided by one or more persons, for providing an orderliness with the objective of ensuring the intactness of undivided society and universal orderliness. o​व्यवस्था :- विधिकेआशयकोकार्यरूपप्रदानकरनेहेतुप्रस्तुतपरंपराहीव्यवस्थाहै।

Orderliness (vyavastha): - Orderliness is the manifest tradition for implementing the intent of the way. ●​सहअस्तित्वसहजपरंपराकेबिनासामाजिकताकानिर्वाहनहींहै।There is no sustainment of sociality without the tradition of coexistence. ●​सहअस्तित्वमेंनिर्विरोध, निर्विरोधपूर्वकजागृति, जागृतिपूर्वकसमाधान-समृद्धि, समाधान-समृद्धिपूर्वकसुख-शांति, सुख-शांतिपूर्वकस्नेह, स्नेहपूर्वकविश्वास, विश्वासपूर्वकसहअस्तित्वबोधहोताहैवसहअस्तित्वमेंबोध, अनुभवप्रमाणितहोनाहीजागृतिहै।Coexistence leads to absence of resistance, absence of resistance leads to awakening, awakening manifests as resolution and prosperity, resolution and prosperity is realisation of happiness and peace, happiness and peace lead to affection, affection leads to trust, trust leads to enlightenment of coexistence. The evidence of enlightenment and realisation in coexistence itself is awakening.

o​सहअस्तित्व : - परस्परतामेंशोषण, संग्रहएवंद्वेषरहिततथाउदारता, स्नेहऔरसेवासहितव्यवहार,

संबंधवसंपर्ककानिर्वाहहीसहअस्तित्वहै।Coexistence (sahastitva): - The behaviour characterised by the absence of exploitation, accumulation & malice, and by the presence of generosity, affection, seva, along with fulfilling relationships and associations itself is coexistence. o​निर्विरोध :- न्यायएवंधर्मकेप्रतिनिश्चय, निष्ठाएवंअभ्यासहीनिर्विरोधहै।

Absence of resistance (nirvirodh): - Certainty, dedication and practice towards justice and dharma itself is absence of resistance.

o​समृद्धि :- अभावकाअभावहीसमृद्धिहैअथवाउत्पादनअधिक, अर्थात्आवश्यकतासेअधिक

उत्पादनहीसमृद्धिहै।Prosperity (samriddhi): - The lack of the sentiment of lacking itself is prosperity. Production in excess of needs is prosperity. o​सुख :- न्यायपूर्णव्यवहारएवंधर्मपूर्णविचार (समाधान) काफलनहीसुखहै।

Happiness (sukh): - The result of just behaviour and dharma based thoughts(resolution), is happiness. o​स्नेह :- न्यायपूर्णव्यवहारमेंनिर्विरोधिताकाफलनहीस्नेहहै।यहजागृतजीवनमेंवृत्तिसेअनुरंजितमनकीक्रियाहै।

Affection (sneha): - Affection is the consequence of absence of resistance in just behaviour. It is an activity of mun in an awakened jeevan that is inspired from vritti. o​विश्वास :- परस्परतामेंनिहितमूल्यप्रत्याशाकेनिर्वाहक्रियाहीविश्वासहै।

Trust (vishwas): - Trust is the act of fulfilling the inherent expectation of values in mutuality.

o​सेवा :- उपकारकरसंतुष्टहोनेवालीप्रवृत्तिएवंप्रतिफलकेआधारपरकियागयासहयोगसहकारितासेवाहै।

उपकारप्रधानसेवामेंउपकारकरनेकीसंतुष्टिमिलतीहै।प्रतिफलप्रधानसेवामेंकेवलप्रतिफलआंकलितहोतीहै।

Seva: - Seva is the tendency to derive satisfaction from performing acts of benevolence. It is also the act of providing help and cooperation based on remuneration. In benevolence-focused seva, satisfaction is derived from performing acts of benevolence. In remuneration-focused seva, only the remuneration is considered. o​उपकार = समृद्धिएवंजागृतिकेलिएसहायता, प्रेरणा।

Benevolence (upkar) = Benevolence encompasses help and inspiration for awakening and prosperity. o​जैसाकिऊपरलिखाजाचुकाहै, मानवनेप्रयोगएवंउत्पादनसेप्राप्तअर्थयथातन, मनऔरधनके

सदुपयोगएवंसुरक्षाकीकामनाकियाहै।As previously described, humans have desired the right-use and security of resources obtained through experimentation and production. o​अर्थकासदुपयोगएवंइसकीसुरक्षाकेवलमानवीयतापूर्णव्यवहारएवंविचारकेआधारसेहीसंभवहै।

जिसकेलिएमानवद्वाराविज्ञानएवंविवेकद्वाराव्यवस्थाकानिर्णयकियाजाताहै।

The right use and protection of resources are possible only on the basis of humane thought and behaviour. For this purpose, the determination of orderliness is made through science and wisdom.

o​समस्तभ्रमितमानवपरम्परामेंदोप्रकारकीव्यवस्थाएँपरिलक्षितहोतीहैं : - (1) धर्मनैतिकव्यवस्थाऔर (2) राज्यनैतिकव्यवस्था।

Two kinds of societal arrangements are apparent throughout the deluded human tradition: (1) the religio-moral order and (2) the politico-state order. ●​सामाजिकताकेसंरक्षणकेलियेदोनोंव्यवस्थाओंकापरस्परपूरकहोनाअत्यावश्यकहै।The mutual complementariness of these two orders is absolutely necessary for the preservation of sociality.

page-73

●​जागृतमानवपरंपरामेंहरपरिवारमेंप्राप्तअर्थकासदुपयोगधर्मनीतिकेरूपमेंतथासुरक्षाराज्यनीतिकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।यहीअखण्डसमाज, सार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकाआधारहै।

In the awakened human tradition, the right-use of resources available in every family becomes evident in the form of Moral policy, and the security becomes evident in the form of State policy. This itself is the basis of “undivided society - universal orderliness”.

o​इसप्रकारधर्मनैतिकव्यवस्थातथाराज्यनैतिकव्यवस्थाकाक्षेत्रबिल्कुलहीस्पष्टहै।जबयहदोनोंव्यवस्थाएँएकदूसरेकीपोषकअथवापूरकनहोकर, एकदूसरेकीशोषकयाएकदूसरेकेक्षेत्रमेंहस्तक्षेपकरनेलगतीहैतभीसामाजिकअसंतुलनउत्पन्नहोताहैऔरअमानवीयतावादीविचारएवंव्यवहारकोपुष्टिमिलतीहै।विकल्पकेरुपमेंमानवीयताकीआवश्यकताउदयहोतीहै।Thus, the domains of the religio-moral order and the politico-state order are very clearly defined. However, when these two orders start exploiting or interfering with each other instead of nurturing and complementing each other, societal imbalance arises, and inhumane thoughts and behaviour are encouraged. This gives rise to the need for an alternative based on humaneness. ●​अर्थकीसुरक्षाकेलिएविधिएवंव्यवस्थापक्षहै।विधिआचरणमेंएवंव्यवस्थापरस्परतामेंस्पष्टहै।The way and orderliness are the aspects that address the security of resources. The way becomes apparent in the conduct, and the orderliness becomes apparent in the mutuality.

o​विधिपक्षकीउपादेयताविवेकसम्मतवैयक्तिकएवंअखण्डसमाजअर्थकापोषण, सद्व्ययपरस्परता

मेंतृप्तिकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोतीहै।उपरोक्तानुसारव्यवस्थाकीउपादेयताविधिकेआशयकोकार्यरूपप्रदानकरनेहेतुसमझदारपरंपराकोस्थापितकरनाहै।विधिपक्षकावैभवजागृतपरंपरामेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।The usefulness of the aspect of way becomes evident in the form of wisdom-aligned fostering of individual and societal resources, righteous expenditure, and satisfaction in mutuality. As mentioned above, the usefulness of the orderliness lies in establishing a tradition of understanding for effectively implementing the intent of the way. The grandeur of the way aspect gets manifested in the awakened tradition. ●​संपूर्णसृष्टिजड़एवंचैतन्यभेदसेपरिलक्षितहै।The entire universe is apparent with the distinction of insentient and sentient.

o​चैतन्यपक्षकेअभावमेंशरीरद्वाराकिसीभीक्रियाकासंपादनसंभवनहींहै।मानवचैतन्यसृष्टिकी

विकसितइकाईहै।In the absence of the sentient entity, the body cannot perform any functions. Humans are a developed unit of the sentient universe. ●​चेतना (ज्ञान) व्यापकहै।चेतनापारगामीवपारदर्शीहै, क्रियाशून्यहै (तरंगवदबावमुक्तहै।) चेतनाव्यापकहोनेकेकारणइकाईसिद्धनहींहोती।चेतनासृष्टिकेउत्पत्तिकामूलकारणसिद्धनहींहोतीक्योंकिचेतना

page-74

परिणामरहितहै।सहअस्तित्वहीसृष्टिकामूलकारणहै।चेतनामेंसम्पृक्तप्रकृतिमेंहीसमस्तपरिणामहै।साम्यऊर्जामानवमें, से, केलिएचेतनारुपमेंहै।Consciousness, or knowledge, is omnipresent. It is permeative, transparent, and non-activity (devoid of wave or pressure). Since consciousness is omnipresent, it doesn't prove to be a unit. Consciousness doesn’t prove to be the root cause of the universe's origin, because it is devoid of change. Coexistence is the root cause of the universe. All the changes are only within nature saturated in consciousness. The uniform energy is in the form of consciousness in, by and for humans. समस्तजड़-चैतन्यवस्तुऊर्जासंपन्नरहनेकेलिएचेतनाहीमूलकारणहै।फलस्वरूपपदार्थमेंक्रियाशीलश्रम, गति, परिणामपूर्वकविकासक्रममेंसृष्टिबीजअर्थात्जीव-जगत (मानवेतरप्रकृति) केरूपमेंस्पष्टहोचुकीहै।इससेपदार्थजगतमेंजीव-जगतकाबीजरूपऔरफलरूपहोनास्पष्टहुआ।इसीकेसाथमानवजीवनमेंजागृतिबीजहोनासुस्पष्टहुआ, क्योंकिहरमानवजागृतहोनाचाहताहै।यहीसहअस्तित्वकाप्रमाणहै।Consciousness itself is the root cause of energy in all sentient and insentient entities. As a result, matter in development progression through the activity of effort, motion and result emerges in the form of sentient world and insentient world. This explains that the seed and fruit form of the sentient and insentient world are inherent in the material world. Furthermore, it is evident that the seed of awakening is inherent in human jeevan, as every human desires to be awakened. This itself is the evidence of coexistence.

o​सृष्टिकीसमस्तइकाईयाँअपनेपात्रताकेअनुसारचेतनामेंप्रभावितहै।इसप्रभावकाफलहीइकाईयों

कीअक्षुण्णचेष्टाहै।चेष्टाहीक्रियाकेमूलमेंहैऔरयहीश्रम, गतिऔरपरिणामकाकारणहै।श्रम, गति, परिणामस्वरूपहीजड़प्रकृतिविकासक्रममेंहैऔरविकसितहोकरचैतन्यप्रकृति (जीवन) केरूपमेंसंक्रमितहै।चैतन्यप्रकृतिकामूलरूपगठनपूर्णपरमाणुहै।All units of the universe are inspired by consciousness according to their receptivity. The consequence of this effect is continuous impulsion in the units. The impulsion is at the root of activity and the cause of effort, motion, and result. The effort, motion, and result manifest in the form of "development progression" in material nature, which irreversibly transitions in the form of sentient nature (jeevan) upon development. The sentient nature is essentially the constitutionally complete atom. o​मानवमेंबौद्धिकतथाभौतिकदोनोंपक्षोंकासम्मिलितरूपव्यवहारमेंपायाजाताहैतथाशरीरके

द्वारासम्पन्नकीजानेवालीसभीक्रियाओंमेंयहदोनोंअर्थात्बौद्धिकऔरभौतिकक्रियाएँसम्मिलितपाईजातीहैं।Behaviour in humans is a combination of intellectual and physical aspects. All actions performed through the body involve both physical and intellectual activities.

o​भौतिकपक्षसेतात्पर्यशरीरतथाउसकेद्वाराकीगईउत्पादनक्रियाएँहैं।बौद्धिकपक्षसेतात्पर्यआशा, विचार, इच्छा, ऋतम्भरावप्रामाणिकताज्ञान, विवेक, विज्ञानएवंइससेसंबंधितप्रक्रियाहै।

The physical aspect of human behaviour refers to the body and the activities such as production performed with it. The intellectual aspect pertains to hope, thought, desire, resoluteness, and authenticity - which includes knowledge, wisdom, science and its related processes.

page-75

o​आशा :- आश्रयपूर्वककीगयीअपेक्षाकीआशासंज्ञाहै।शरीरकेआश्रयपद्धतिसेऔरअनुभवके

आश्रयपद्धतिसेआशयोंकाहोनापायाजाताहै।Hope (asha): – Expectation made under a basis of refuge is called hope. Hopes occur either on the basis of the body or on the basis of realisation.

o​विचार :- ​विश्लेषणपूर्वककियागयास्वीकृतियाँजोसमाधानकेअर्थमेंप्रयोजनहै।Thought (vichar): - The analysis for acceptances whose purpose is resolution. o​इच्छा :- आकार-प्रकार, प्रयोजनएवंसंभावनाकाचित्रग्रहणएवंनिर्माणकरनेतथागुणोंकागतिपूर्वक

नियोजनकरनेवालीक्रियाकीइच्छासंज्ञाहै।जीवनशक्तियाँगुण, स्वभाव, धर्म (समाधान) केरूपमेंव्याख्यायितहोतीहैं।Desire (ichchha): - Desire refers to the activity of grasping and forming images of shape, form, purpose, and possibility, and of regulating properties through motion. The powers of jeevan manifest as properties, essential nature, and dharma (resolution). o​ऋतम्भरा :- सत्यसहजवैभवकीअभिव्यक्तिकरनेकीसंपूर्णपृष्ठभूमि।सत्यसेपरिपूर्णसंकल्प।

Resoluteness (ritambhara): - The entire backdrop for the manifestation of the natural grandeur of truth; a resolve suffused with truth. o​संकल्प :- सम्यकप्रकारसेकीगयीस्वीकृति (जिसकोस्वीकारकरनाहैउसकीनिर्भ्रमता) कोनिरंतरता

प्रदानकरनेवालीबौद्धिकक्रिया।Resolve (sankalp): - The intellectual activity that sustains acceptance made in the right manner, without delusion of what is to be accepted.

o​मानवनेसृष्टिमेंअपनेमहत्वकोजाननेऔरपहचाननेकेक्रममेंहरइकाईकेगठन, क्रियाऔर

आचरणकाअध्ययनकरनेकाप्रयासकियाहै।साथहीपूर्णताकेलिएप्रयासएवंअभ्यासभीकियाहै।Humans, in the course of understanding and recognising their significance in the universe, have endeavoured to study the constitution, activity, and conduct of every unit. Furthermore, they have endeavoured and practised to attain completeness. ●​उपरोक्तअध्ययनकेक्रममेंयहअनुभवमेंआयाकिमूलइकाईजड़परमाणुहीहै, जिसनेविकासपूर्वकचैतन्यताकोप्राप्तकियाहै, जोगठनपूर्णताकाप्रमाणहै।गठनपूर्णताकेपश्चात्क्रियापूर्णताकेलिएप्रयासहै।In the course of the above study, it was realised that the fundamental unit is the insentient atom, which, through development, attains sentience as evidence of constitutional completeness. Upon achieving constitutional completeness, its endeavour is towards activity completeness.

o​गठन :- एकसेअधिकअंशकेपहचानने-निर्वाहकरनेकेनियमद्वाराअनुशासितएवंसीमाबद्ध

निश्चितक्रियाकोअक्षुण्णताप्रदानकरनेवालीप्रक्रियाहीगठनहै।

page-76

Constitution (gathan): - Constitution is the process that ensures intactness to a definite activity, which is disciplined and bounded by the law of recognising and fulfilling among multiple parts.

o​आचरण :- जिसक्रियासेमौलिकताकाप्रकाशनहोताहै, उसकीआचरणसंज्ञाहै, आचरणहीस्वभावहै।

यहीनियमहै।Conduct (acharan): - Conduct refers to the activity through which essentiality is expressed. Conduct itself is the essential nature, which itself is the law. o​जड़ :- विचारपक्षसेरहितइकाई, जिसकाकार्यक्षेत्रउसकेलंबाई, चौड़ाईऔरऊँचाईतकहीसीमितहै।

Insentient (jad): - The entity lacking the thought aspect, whose field of activity is limited to its length, width and height, is referred to as insentient. o​चैतन्य :- ​जिसइकाईकाकार्यक्षेत्रउसकीलंबाई, चौड़ाईऔरऊँचाईसेअधिकहोतथाजिसकाविचार

पक्षसक्रियहोऐसीइकाईकीचैतन्यसंज्ञाहै।Sentient (chaitanya): - The entity whose field of activity extends beyond its length, width and height, and whose thought aspect is active, is referred to as sentient. ●​ऐसीविशेषसक्रियताप्राप्तहोतेहीवहइकाईआशाकेबंधनसेयुक्तहोजातीहै।प्रमाणहरजीवमेंजीनेकीआशाहैही।Upon attaining such special activeness, the sentient entity (jeevan) becomes associated with the hope-bondage. As evidence, every animal has the hope of living. ●​जड़एवंचैतन्यइकाईयोंमेंगठनसिद्धांतमेंसाम्यतापाईजातीहै।The principle of constitution is common in sentient and insentient units. ●​आत्मामेंअनुभूति; बुद्धिमेंउल्लासवआप्लावन; चित्तमेंआह्लाद; वृत्तिमेंउत्साहतथामनमेंकौतूहलहीविकासकीओरसक्रियहोनेकीमूलभूतऊर्जानियोजनरीतिहै।इसकेलिएऊर्जाकाअन्तरनियामनआवश्यकहै।The mode of channelling jeevan’s energies towards development (awakening) is through curiosity in mun, enthusiasm in vritti, delight in chitta, elation and immersion in buddhi, and finally, realisation in atma. For this, inward regulation of jeevan energies is essential.

o​अनुभूति :- अनुक्रमसेप्राप्तसमझ, स्थिति-गति, प्रकटनवपरिणामहीअनुभूतिहै।

Realisation (anubhuti): - The understanding, status (state-motion), emergence and result obtained through natural progression itself is realisation. o​आप्लावन :- निर्भ्रमताकेप्रभावकीआप्लावनसंज्ञाहै।बुद्धिहीनिर्भ्रमताकोप्राप्तकरआप्लावितहोती

है।Immersion (aplavan): - The effect of absence of delusion is referred to as immersion. Buddhi becomes immersed upon attaining absence of delusion.

page-77

o​आह्लाद :- अभावकाअभावहीआह्लादहै।चित्तमेंहीअभावकेअभावकीप्रतीतिहोकरआह्लादहोता

है।Rejoicing (ahlaad): - The lack of the sentiment of lacking itself is rejoicing. Rejoicing occurs in chitta upon awareness of absence of the lacking. o​उत्साह :- ​उत्थानयाविकासकीओरजोसाहसहै, उसकीउत्साहसंज्ञाहैतथायहवृत्तिमेंहोताहै।

Enthusiasm (utsah): - The intrepidity towards rise or development (awakening) is referred to as enthusiasm, and it occurs in vritti. o​कौतूहल :- अज्ञातकोज्ञातकरने, अप्राप्तकोप्राप्तकरनेहेतुसंवेगकीक्रियाकौतूहलहै।जोमनमेंहोता

है।Curiosity (kautuhal): - The impetus to know the unknown and to achieve the unachieved is curiosity, which occurs in mun. o​प्रत्येकपरमाणुमेंपरमाणुअंशोंकीअवस्थितिमध्यमेंतथापरिवेशोंमेंपायीजातीहै।प्रथमपरिवेशमें

एकयाएकसेअधिकअंश, उसीप्रकारद्वितीय, तृतीयतथाचतुर्थआदिपरिवेशमेंभीएकयाएकसेअधिकअंशोंकोपायाजाताहै, जोमध्यांशकेसभीओरअविरतरूपसेभ्रमणशीलहै।प्रत्येकपरमाणुकेसभीओरतथापरमाणुकेगठनमेंपाएजानेवालेअंशोंकेसभीओरशून्यकीस्थितिपाईजातीहै।शून्यसेरिक्तवमुक्तस्थानयावस्तुनहींहै।

Particles in every atom are situated either in the nucleus or in the surrounding orbits. The first orbit contains one or more particles continuously revolving around the nucleus; the same is the case with the second, third, fourth, and so on. Space pervades all around each atom as well as all around the particles within the atom’s constitution. There is no place or entity that is without Space or devoid of it. ●​चैतन्यइकाई (गठनपूर्णपरमाणु) केमध्यांशकोआत्मा, उसकेप्रथमपरिवेशीयअंशोंकोबुद्धि, द्वितीयपरिवेशीयअंशोंकोचित्त, तृतीयपरिवेशीयअंशोंकोवृत्तितथाचतुर्थपरिवेशीयअंशोंकीेमनसंज्ञाहै।The nucleus of the sentient unit (a constitutionally complete atom) is referred to as atma. The particles in its first orbit are referred to as buddhi, those in the second orbit are referred to as chitta, those in the third orbit are referred to as vritti, and those in the fourth orbit are referred to as mun.

o​इसपृथ्वीपरप्रत्यक्षरूपमेंसृष्टिचारअवस्थामेंहैं।इनचारोेंअवस्थाओंमेंपरमाणुओंकामध्यांश

मध्यस्थक्रियाहै, क्योंकिउसपरसमयाविषमकाप्रभावनहींपड़ताहै।Nature on this Earth is perceptible as four orders. The nucleus of atoms in all four orders is the mediative activity because it is not affected by generative or degenerative forces. o​गठनशीलपरमाणुओंमेंश्रम, गतिएवंपरिणामघटितहोताहीरहताहै।परिणामकेअमरत्वके

फलस्वरूपचैतन्यइकाईरूपी ‘जीवन’ मेंविश्रामानुभूतियोग्यक्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रतापर्यन्तश्रमकाअभावनहींहै।Effort, motion, and result continue to occur within evolving-constitution atoms. Even upon attaining immortality, there is no lack of effort in the activity of ‘jeevan’

page-78

(the sentient unit) until it has developed the capacity, ability and receptivity for restfulness. ●​पदार्थावस्थामेंसभीप्रजातिकेपरमाणुकेअंतिमपरिवेशीयअंशहीश्रमपूर्वकसक्रियरहतेहैंअथवाअग्रेषणक्रियामेंरतहैं।The particles only in the last orbit of all kinds of atoms within the material order are active through effort or involved in ascending activity.

o​क्षोभ :- क्षमताएवंयोग्यताकोश्रममेंपरिवर्तितकरनेपरजोह्रासहैउसकीक्षोभसंज्ञाहै।यहीपात्रता

कीअपूर्णताहै।Frustration (kshobh): - The shortcoming in converting capacity and ability into effort is referred to as frustration. This signifies incompleteness of receptivity.

o​अग्रेषण :- क्षमताएवंयोग्यताकोश्रममेंपरिवर्तितकरनेमेंजोसंतुलनअथवापात्रताकाअर्जनहैउसकी

अग्रेषणसंज्ञाहै।Ascending (agreshan): - The balance and receptivity gained while converting capacity and ability into effort is referred to as ascending. ●​जड़परमाणुओंमेंअंतिमएवंउसकेपहलेपरिवेशीयअंशहीसक्रियहोकरश्रमपूर्वकयौगिकक्रियाओंमेंसंलग्नरहतेहैं।अग्रिमरचनाप्राणावस्थाकेलियेअग्रेषितरहतेहैं।Only the particles in the outermost and second-to-last orbits of insentient atoms are actively engaged in compounding activities through effort, advancing towards the higher status of the biological order. ●​जीवावस्थामेंशरीररचनाएँप्राणकोषासेहीरचितहैऔरजीवनमेंवंशानुषंगीकार्यप्रवृत्तिरहतीहै।चैतन्यपरमाणु (जीवावस्था) मेंचतुर्थ, तृतीय, द्वितीयपरिवेशोंकेअंशआंशिकरूपमेंसक्रियरहतेहैंऔरइससेश्रेष्ठअभिव्यक्तिकेलिएअग्रेषितरहतेहैं।The bodies in the animal order are composed of biological cells only, and the "jeevan" there has a tendency for species-conformance. Particles in the fourth, third, and second orbits in the sentient atom (in animal order) are partially active and engaged in ascending for more evolved expressions.

●​ज्ञानावस्थामेंभीशरीररचनाप्राणकोषाओंसेहीहैऔरजीवनजागृतिक्रममेंचतुर्थ, तृतीय, द्वितीयपरिवेशोंकेक्रियाशीलताविधिसेसाढ़ेचार (4½) क्रियाओंकोशरीरमूलकविधिसेव्यक्तकरताहै।The bodies of the knowledge order are also composed of biological cells. In the awakening progression stage, jeevan expresses its four and a half (4½) activities with activeness in the fourth, third, and second orbits, through the body-based way.

●​जागृतिपूर्वकअनुभवमूलकविधिसेपूरेदसक्रियाओंकोप्रमाणितकरताहै।मानवशरीररचनामानवपरंपरामें‘जीवन’ मेंहोनेवालीदसोंक्रियाओंकोप्रमाणितकरनेयोग्यरहताहै।

Upon awakening, jeevan evidences all ten of its activities through the realisation-based way. The human body is capable of evidencing all ten activities of jeevan in the human tradition.

page-79

●​ज्ञानावस्थामेंईष्टसेवनकालक्ष्यईष्टसेतादात्म्य, तद्रूप, तत्सान्निध्यएवंतदावलोकनहै।ईष्टकेनामरूप, गुणएवंस्वभावतथासाधककीक्षमता, योग्यतातथापात्रताकेअनुपातमेंसफलहोतीहै।The goal of pursuing the ideal in the knowledge order is to achieve absolute-oneness, absolute-accordance, absolute-connectedness, and absolute-observance of the ideal. This is accomplished in proportion to the seeker's capacity, ability and receptivity towards the name, form, properties, and essential nature of the ideal.

o​ईष्ट :- निर्भ्रान्तज्ञानसहितस्वेच्छापूर्वकसहअस्तित्वकेप्रतिश्रद्धा, विश्वासएवंनिष्ठाहीईष्टहै।

Ideal (isht): - The ideal is the self-driven reverence, trust, and dedication towards coexistence, along with the complete knowledge. o​तादात्म्य, तद्रूप :- जागृतिहीपरमउपलब्धिहोनेकेकारणतद्रूप, अनुभवबोधसेतादात्म्यहोनाजीवन

सहजतथाअनुभवसहजक्रियाहै।सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवहीतद्रूप, तदाकारविधिहै।क्योंकिनियम, नियन्त्रण, संतुलन, न्याय, धर्म, सत्य, अनुभवकेफलनमेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।Absolute-oneness, Absolute-accordance (tadatmya, tadroop): - As awakening is the ultimate accomplishment, absolute-accordance and absolute-oneness with enlightenment is natural for jeevan and realisation. Realisation in coexistence itself is the way of absolute-accordance and absolute-resonance (tadakar), because law, regulation, balance, justice, dharma, and truth become evident as a result of realisation. o​तत्सान्निध्य :- तत्सान्निध्यकाअर्थसुख, शांति, संतोष, आनंदकासान्निध्यहै।

Absolute-connectedness (tatsannidhya): - Absolute-connectedness means abiding in happiness, peace, contentment and bliss. o​तदावलोकन :- सहअस्तित्वमेंदृष्टापदप्रतिष्ठाहीतदावलोकनक्रियाहै।सहअस्तित्वकादृष्टाजागृत

जीवनहीहै।Absolute-observance (tadavlokan): - Absolute-observance refers to being established in the seer status in coexistence. Only an awakened jeevan is the seer of coexistence. o​जागृतिकोतत्शब्दसेइंगितकरायाहै।

Awakening is indicated by the word “absolute”.

●​ज्ञानावस्थाकीइकाईकीसमस्तक्रियाओंकालक्ष्यनिर्बीजनव्यवहारकीउपलब्धिहै।निर्बीजनकातात्पर्यभ्रममुक्तिऔरप्रमाणरूपमेंजागृतिहै।यहीआचरणपूर्णताहै।

The goal of all activities of the knowledge order units is to achieve seedless (nirbeejan) behaviour, which means liberation from delusion with awakening as its evidence. This itself is conduct completeness.

o​सबीजनहोनेकातात्पर्य :- शरीरको ‘जीवन’ मानलेनाजबकि ‘शरीर’ भौतिक-रासायनिकवस्तुकीरचना

है। ‘जीवन’ गठनपूर्णपरमाणुचैतन्यइकाईहैतथारासायनिक-भौतिकसंसारकादृष्टाहै।

page-80

Seedful (sabeejan): - Seedful refers to the belief that the body is "jeevan," while in reality, the body is a composition of physical-chemical matter. Jeevan is a constitutionally complete atom - a sentient unit - which is seer of the physicochemical world.

●​निर्बीजनव्यवहारभ्रम-मुक्तिकीस्थितिमेंहोताहै।Seedless behaviour happens in the state of liberation from delusion. ●​निर्बीजनव्यवहारमेंअमानवीयतासेमुक्ति, मानवीयताकापोषणतथाअतिमानवीयतापूर्णस्थितिकाप्रमाणहै।Seedless behaviour comprises the state of liberation from inhumaneness, the nurturing of humaneness, and the evidence of higher-humaneness. ●​शरीरकीनश्वरताऔर ‘जीवन’ कीअमरत्ववनिरंतरता, कार्य-व्यवहारकेनियमोंकीपूर्णस्वीकृतिवअनुभूतिहीनिर्बीजविचारहैऔरतदनुसारव्यवहारहीनिर्बीजनव्यवहारहै।यहीभ्रममुक्तिहै।The complete acceptance and realisation of mortality of the body, immortality and continuity of jeevan, and the laws of work and behaviour comprise the seedless thought, and behaviour accordingly is the seedless behaviour. This itself is the liberation from delusion. ●​निर्बीजविचारहीजीवनमुक्तकीयादिव्यमानवकीस्वभाव-सिद्धवैचारिकप्रक्रियाहै।Seedless thought itself is the natural thought process of a liberated-jeevan (jeevan mukta) or divine-human. ●​जीवन-मुक्तअर्थात्जीवचेतनाएवम्भ्रममुक्तमानवअर्थात्सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवसम्पन्नमानवमेंभूतकालकेस्मरणसेतथाभविष्यकीआशासेपीड़ानहींहोतीववर्तमानसेविरोधनहींहोता।A liberated-jeevan (jeevan mukta), i.e., one who has irreversibly transitioned from animal consciousness and delusion, and achieved realisation in coexistence, does not suffer from the recollection of the past or apprehension about the future, and has no resistance with the present. ●​भ्रममुक्तिअथवाजागृतिहीमध्यस्थस्थितिवगतिहै।मध्यस्थस्थितिप्राप्तकरनेमेंसम-विषमक्रियाकेक्षोभसेमुक्तिहै।जीवनमेंजागृतिपूर्वकउपयोगिता, सदुपयोगिता, प्रयोजनशीलता, पूरकताविधियोंसेसंतुष्टहोनेकीव्यवस्थाहै।जागृतजीवनमेंमध्यस्थअर्थात्आत्माअथवाअनुभवबोधविधिसेहीसंतुलित, संतुष्टहोनापायाजाताहै।Awakening or liberation from delusion itself is the mediative state and motion. Attaining the mediative state entails liberation from the frustration of generative and degenerative activities. Jeevan attains contentment upon awakening by ways of use, right-use, purposeful-use, and complementariness. In an awakened jeevan, there is contentment and balance only through the mediative way i.e. through the atma-bodh or enlightenment of realisation.

o​जागृतिक्रममेंसर्वमानवरूप, बल, धन, पदकेबढ़नेकोसमक्रियातथाइनकेबनेरहनेकोमध्यस्थ

क्रियावइनकेघटनेकोविषमक्रियाकेरूपमेंपहचानेरहतेहै।इसप्रकारजागृतिक्रममेंभ्रमवशसमव

page-81

मध्यस्थक्रियाएंसभीकोस्वीकाररहतीहैंतथाविषमअस्वीकाररहतीहैं, इसलिएक्लेशमेंरहतेहैं।जागृतमानवपरंपरामें ‘जीवन’ कावैभवएवंमहत्ताप्राथमिकहोजातेहैंतथाभौतिकताएँद्वितीयहोजातेहैंतथाभौतिकतासहजसम, विषम, मध्यस्थक्रियाएंनियंत्रितहोजातीहैं।In awakening progression, humans believe enhancement in physical appearance, might, societal status, and wealth as generative, sustainment as mediative, and their decrease as degenerative. Therefore, in awakening progression due to delusion, the generative and mediative activities are acceptable to all, while the degenerative activity remains unacceptable, which is the reason for their suffering. In the awakened human tradition, the grandeur and importance of jeevan become primary, and the material aspect becomes secondary, thereby the generative, degenerative, and mediative activities of the material aspect become regulated. ●​क्षोभहीदु:खअथवाक्लेशहै।Frustration itself is unhappiness or suffering. ●​क्षोभयासमस्याअथवादु:खकेनिवारणहेतुहीजीनेकीआशाजागृतिपूर्वकप्रमाणआवश्यकताहै।

It is for the removal of frustrations, problems, or suffering that the evidence of awakening in living becomes necessary. ●​जीनेकीआशामेंउद्भव, विभवएवंप्रलयसमाविष्टहै।जीवावस्थाकेशरीररचना, प्राणावस्थाकीरचनाक्रियाहै।इनमेंविभवसबसेप्रियहैजोस्थायीनहींहै।भ्रमवशमानवविभवमेंहीबल, रूप, पदवधनकेस्थायीकणकेलिएप्रयासकरताहै, जोउसकास्थायीगुणनहोनेकेकारणअसफलहै।उपरोक्तानुसारविभवकालकीस्थिरतातथाइसमेंकीगईउपलब्धियोंकीस्थिरतासिद्धनहींहोती।मानवकाविभवजागृतपरम्पराहीहै।Life spans the stages of creation, sustainment, and dissolution. The sustainment stage is the most pleasant among them, but it is not permanent. Due to delusion, humans try to achieve permanence in their physical appearance, might, societal status, and wealth of the sustainment stage only, which ultimately proves unsuccessful because that is not its permanent property. Therefore, there is no stability in the sustainment stage of the body and the accomplishments made during this stage. The sustainment of humans is the awakened tradition only. ●​आकृतिकोरूप, प्रभावकोगुण, वस्तुस्थितिकोतत्वतथाकिसीरूप, क्रिया, वस्तुवस्थानकोनिर्देशकरनेहेतुप्रयुक्तशब्दकी ‘नाम’ संज्ञाहै।The structure is referred to as the form, the effect is referred to as the property, the state of manifestation is referred to as the element, and the word used to indicate any form, activity, object, and place is referred to as the "name". ●​रूपएवंगुणसापेक्षऔरसामयिकतथ्यहै।Form and properties are relative and temporal aspects.

o​सामयिकतथ्य : - किसीक्रियायाक्रियासमुच्चयकापरिणामभावीहै, उसकीसामयिकतथ्यसंज्ञाहै।

page-82

Temporal Aspect (samyik tathya): - The activities or set of activities whose change is inevitable, are referred to as temporal aspects. ●​समस्ततत्वनिरपेक्षमेंसंपृक्तकार्यरतहै।All elements are saturated and active in the absolute.

●​भाषाकेमूलमेंभाव; भावकेमूलमेंमौलिकता; मौलिकताकेमूलमेंमूल्यांकन; मूल्यांकनकेमूलमेंदर्शन; दर्शनकेमूलमेंदर्शक; दर्शककेमूलमेंक्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रता; क्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रताकेमूलमेंसत्यभास, आभास, प्रतीति; भास, आभास, प्रतीतिकेमूलमेंभाषाहै।यहसबचितकीक्रियाहैजोदर्शककेजागृतिकेअनुसारसफलहैअथवाअसफलहै।

Language has sentiment (bhav) at its root; sentiment has essentiality at its root; essentiality has evaluation at its root; evaluation has worldview at its root; worldview has perceiver at its root; perceiver has capacity, ability and receptivity at its root; capacity, ability and receptivity have the perception, comprehension and awareness of truth at its root; perception, comprehension and awareness of truth have the language at its root. All of these are activities of chitta, which succeed or fail depending on the perceiver's level of awakening. ●​पदार्थावस्थाएवंप्राणावस्थाकीसृष्टिमेधसरहिततथाजीवावस्थावज्ञानावस्थाकीसृष्टिमेधससम्पन्नहै।The entities of the material order and biological order do not have brain, while those of the animal order and knowledge order have brain.

o​मेधस :- ​चैतन्यइकाईकीइच्छाओेंएवंआकाँक्षाओंकेसंकेतकोग्रहणकरनेयोग्यक्षमता, योग्यताऔरपात्रतासहितसप्राणअंगहीमेधसहै, जिसकीअवस्थितिसाम्यत: मानवकेशिरोभागमेंपाईजातीहै।

Brain (medhas): - The brain is the respirational organ of the body located in the head, responsible for receiving and processing signals related to the desires and aspirations of the sentient unit (jeevan). ●​‘जीवनपुंजस्थ’ आशा, विचार, इच्छा, ऋतम्भरातथाप्रमाणिकता (प्रमाण) काप्रसारण (संकेतग्रहण) मेधसपरहीहै, जिसकेअनन्तरहीज्ञानवाहीएवंक्रियावाहीप्रक्रियाएँहरमानवशरीरमेंपाईजातीहैजोमानवपरंपरामेंपरावर्तितहोताहै।The transmission of jeevan-cloud’s hope, thought, desire, resoluteness, and authenticity (evidence) is received only by the brain. Subsequently, the cognitive and motor functions take place in the human body, which get further projected in human tradition.

o​पुंज :- चैतन्यइकाईसहजकार्यसीमासहितजोआकारहै, उसेपुंजकीसंज्ञाहै।ऐसेपुंजकेमूलमेंएक

हीगठनपूर्णपरमाणुकाअस्तित्वहैजिसमेंहीआत्मा, बुद्धि, चित्त, वृत्तितथामनकीक्रियाएँदृष्टव्यहैं।Jeevan-cloud (punj): - Jeevan-cloud refers to the shape created by the limits of a sentient unit's activity. At its root there exists only one constitutionally complete atom, within which the activities of mun, vritti, chitta, buddhi, and atma take place. o​प्रसारण :- आशा, विचार, इच्छा, ऋतम्भराएवंप्रमाणिकतासहजप्रमाणोंकेसंकेतसेमेधसतंत्रपरप्रभाव

डालनेहेतुप्रयुक्ततरंगकीप्रसारण (संकेतग्रहण) संज्ञाहै, जिसमेंप्रत्याशाकाहोनाआवश्यकहै।

page-83

Transmission (prasaran): - Transmission refers to the wave generated by jeevan that carries signals of hope, thought, desire, resoluteness, and authenticity - which is received by the brain (nervous system), from which jeevan has an inherent anticipation of response. ●​ग्रहण, विसर्जन, निग्रह, अनुग्रह, संग्रहएवंउदारताकेभेदसेहीसमस्तसुखाकाँक्षाएंहैं।All aspirations of happiness are differentiated as the acts of embracing, discarding, self-restraint, grace, accumulation and generosity.

o​ग्रहण :- उपयोगिताकेमूल्यांकनकीग्रहणसंज्ञाहै।Embracing (grihan): - Refers to the evaluation of usefulness. o​विसर्जन :- अनुपयोगिताकीविसर्जनसंज्ञाहै।Discarding (visarjan): - Refers to assessment that something is not useful. o​निग्रह :- स्वसंयमताकेअर्थमेंप्रवृत्ति।Self-restraint (nigraha): - Refers to the tendency of self-discipline. ●​आशाएँआस्वादनकेरूपमें; विचारप्रसारणकेरूपमें; इच्छाएँ (काँक्षाएं) प्रयोगएवंव्यवहारकेरूपमेंतथाऋतम्भरादृढ़ताएवंनिष्ठाकेरूपमेंव्यक्तहै।यहक्रमसेमन, वृत्ति, चित्तऔरबुद्धिसेप्रदर्शितहोनेवालेगुण, स्वभावसहितक्रियापक्षहैअर्थात्मनसेआशा, वृत्तिसेविचार, चित्तसेइच्छा (काँक्षा) औरबुद्धिमेंअनुभवप्रमाणऋतम्भराक्रियाएँहैं।

Hopes manifest as tasting, thoughts as propagation, desires (aspirations) as experimentation and behaviour, and resoluteness as firmness and dedication. This constitutes the activity aspect—together with properties and essential nature—exhibited respectively by mun, vritti, chitta, and buddhi. That is, hope arises from mun, thought from vritti, desire from chitta, and resoluteness with the evidence of realisation from buddhi.

●​हरचैतन्यइकाईदृष्टिसंपन्नहै।जड़परमाणुविकासपूर्वकचैतन्य (जीवन) परमाणुहोतेतकदृष्टिसम्पन्ननहींहै।

Every sentient unit (jeevan) is endowed with perspective. An insentient atom does not have perspective until, through development, it becomes sentient (jeevan) atom. ●​अपनेदृष्टिकेद्वारादृश्यकोदेखनेहेतुदर्शकद्वाराप्रयुक्तक्रियाएवंप्रक्रियाहीदर्शनहै, जिसकीउपलब्धिअर्थात्दर्शनकीउपलब्धिसमझयाज्ञानहै।ज्ञानसेहीस्वएवंपरस्परताकानिर्णयतथाअनुभवएवंअभिव्यक्तिहै।जागृतमानवमेंस्वयंहोनेकाबोधवसंपूर्णअस्तित्वहोनेकाबोधहोताहै।यहीस्वएवंपरस्परताहै।The activity and process that a perceiver uses through their perspective for seeing the scene itself is worldview, the accomplishment from which is the understanding or knowledge. Knowledge alone is the basis for discerning, realising, and expressing self and mutuality. An awakened human has the awareness of their own being and of the being of the entire existence. This itself is the realisation of self and mutuality.

o​अपनेवातावरणमेंस्थितिपूर्ण-अपूर्ण, रूप-गुण-स्वभाव-धर्म, योग-वियोग, क्रिया-प्रक्रिया, परिणाम-फल, ह्रासऔरविकासकासंकेतग्रहणदर्शनद्वाराहीदर्शकनेकियाहै।

The perceiver receives the signals of their environment as complete-incomplete, form-properties-essential nature-dharma, union-separation, activity-process, result-consequence, and development-decline, through their worldview only. ●​चैतन्यइकाईस्वयंजीवनपुंज-मन, वृत्ति, चित्त, बुद्धिवआत्माकाअध्ययनहै।The study of the sentient unit or jeevan-cloud is the study of the activities of mun, vritti, chitta, buddhi and atma.

o​इसकेपूर्वअमानवीयताऔरअतिमानवीयताकावर्गीकरणस्वभावात्मकवव्यवहारात्मकभेदसेकिया

जाचुकाहै।मानवजातिपाँचश्रेणियोंमेंपरिलक्षितहै, जोनिम्नानुसारहैं : - The classification of inhumaneness, humaneness and higher humaneness has been done earlier, differentiated by their essential nature and behaviour. Humankind is apparent in the following five categories: - o​अमानवीयमानवकेदोवर्गहैं : - (एक) पशुमानवऔर (दो) राक्षसमानव।

Inhumane humans are in two categories: - (one) animalistic-humanand (two) demonic-human. ●​पशुमानवमेंदीनताप्रधान, हीनताएवंक्रूरतावादीकार्यव्यवहारहोताहै।The animalistic-human primarily exhibits servility, along with perfidy and cruelty in their work and behaviour. ●​राक्षसमानवमेंक्रूरताप्रधान, दीनताएवंहीनतावादीकार्यव्यवहारहोताहै।The demonic-human primarily exhibits cruelty, along with perfidy and servility in their work and behaviour. ●​(तीन) मानवीयतापूर्णमानवएकवर्गमेंहै।(Three) Humans with humaneness are in one category.

o​मानवीयदृष्टि ​: ​न्याय, धर्म, सत्य।Humane perspective (manveeya drishti): Justice, Dharma, and Truth.

o​मानवीयविषय ​:​पुत्रेषणा, वित्तेषणा, लोकेषणा।

Humane propensity (manveeya vishaya): Progeny-motive, Wealth-motive, reputation-motive.

o​मानवीयस्वभाव ​: ​धीरता, वीरता, उदारता।

page-85

Humane nature (manveeya svabhav): Fortitude, Courage, Generosity. ●​अतिमानवीयतापूर्णमानवपुन: दोवर्गमेंहै : - Higher-humanely humans are in two categories: -

o​(चार) देवमानवऔर (पाँच) दिव्यमानव।

(four) deific-human and (five) divine-human. o​अतिमानवीयतापूर्णमानवकीदृष्टि, विषयऔरस्वभावनिम्नानुसारहै : -

The perspective, propensity and essential nature of higher-humanely humans are as follows: - ●​देवमानवदृष्टि- धर्मप्रधानन्यायऔरसत्य।The perspective of deific-humans is – primarily dharma with justice and truth.

o​विषय - लोकेषणा।

Propensity (vishaya) – reputation-motive. o​स्वभाव - धीरता, वीरता, उदारतातथादयाप्रधानकृपा, करूणा।

Essential nature (svabhav) – primarily kindness, grace and compassion, along with fortitude, courage, and generosity. ●​दिव्यमानवदृष्टि-परमसत्य।The perspective of divine-humans is – ultimate truth.

o​विषय ​- ​ सहअस्तित्वरूपीपरमसत्य।Propensity (vishaya):– ultimate truth in the form of coexistence. o​स्वभाव - ​करुणाप्रधानदया, कृपा।Essential nature (svabhav): – primarily compassion, kindness and grace, along with fortitude, courage, and generosity. o​उपरिवर्णितपाँचश्रेणीकेमानवअपनेसेअविकसितपरनिरीक्षण, परीक्षणएवंसर्वेक्षणपूर्वकव्यवहार

एवंअधिकारकरतेहैं।The five categories of humans described above behave and exercise authority over those who are less developed than them, through inspection, examination, and survey.

o​अधिकार :- अपनेसहीमन्तव्यकेअनुसारअन्यकोगतिएवंकलाप्रदानकरनाऔरउसकाउपयोग,

सदुपयोगतथापोषणकरनेकीक्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रताहोनाहीअधिकारहै।

page-86

Authority (adhikar): - Authority is the capacity, ability and receptivity to provide direction and refinement to others in accordance with their right perspective for use, right-use and nurturing.

o​उपरोक्तविधिसेजागृतिपूर्वकहीमानवअखण्डता, सार्वभौमतासहजसूत्रव्याख्यासम्पन्नहोताहै

क्योंकिविकसितद्वाराअविकसितकोप्रेरितकरनेकाअधिकारहोताहैजबकिअविकसितद्वाराविकसितकामात्रअध्ययनहीसंभवहै।Accordingly, it is only through awakening that humans become capable of manifesting undividedness and universality, because the developed hold the natural authority to inspire the undeveloped, whereas the undeveloped can only study the developed. o​उपरोक्तानुसारविवेचनाकेआधारपरहीइसवैविध्यतासेपीड़ितसंसारकेमूलमेंप्रत्येकमानवअपना

भीमूल्यांकनकरनाचाहताहै, क्योंकिस्वयंकामूल्यांकनयदिसहीनहींहैतोउसस्थितिमेंअध्ययनकेलियेआवश्यकसामर्थ्यकोसंजोलेनासंभवनहींहै - जैसेएकरूपयाकेमौलिकताकोपूरा-पूरासमझेबिनादोएवंउसकेआगेवालेसंख्याकीगतिएवंप्रयोगनहींहै।एकरूपयाकेमूल्यको 1 से 99 पैसेतकमूल्यांकनकरनेकीस्थितिपर्यन्तउसएकरूपयाकापूर्णमूल्यांकितज्ञानउसइकाईमेंप्रादुर्भूतनहींहुआ।Based on the above reasoning, at the root of the world’s suffering from fragmentation lies the need for every human to evaluate themselves. If one’s self-evaluation is incorrect, it is not possible to gather the capacity required for the study of existence. For example, unless the value of one rupee is fully understood, it is futile to proceed to two or beyond. Likewise, until the value of one rupee is evaluated through the understanding of 1 to 99 paise, the complete evaluative knowledge of that rupee does not manifest in the individual. o​अत: मानवकोअपनेविकासकीदृष्टिसेस्वयम्कामूल्यांकनकरनाप्राथमिकएवंमहत्वपूर्णकार्यक्रम

सिद्धहै।यहीज्ञानावस्थाकीविशिष्टताहै।Therefore, self-evaluation is the first and foremost step for humans from the point of view of their own development. This itself is the uniqueness of the knowledge order. o​अध्ययनयथार्थता, वास्तविकता, सत्यताकेअर्थमेंहीसंपन्नहोताहै।सर्वप्रथमव्यापकवस्तुमें

समाहितसंपूर्णएक-एकवस्तुओंकावर्गीकरणविधिसेअध्ययनसंभवहोगयाहै।यहीचारअवस्था, चारपदोंमेंअध्ययनगम्यहै।क्रियाकाअध्ययनविकासक्रम, विकास, जागृतिक्रम, जागृतिकेरूपमेंबोधगम्यहोनेकीव्यवस्थाहै।इसीकेसाथ-साथरूप, गुण, स्वभाववधर्मकाअध्ययनहोनाआवश्यकहै।चारोंअवस्था, चारोंपदोंमेंस्पष्टहै।विकासकाअध्ययनपरमावश्यकहै।विकसितइकाईकेरूपमें‘जीवन’ काअध्ययनसंपन्नहोताहै।औरजीवनमेंहीजागृतिक्रम, जागृतिकास्पष्टप्रमाणहोताहै।The study is accomplished only for reality, actuality, and verity. It has become possible to study all units of nature contained in the omnipresent reality through classification. This can be studied as four orders and four planes. There is provision for the study of activity (nature), which is understandable in the form of development progression, development, awakening progression, and awakening. Along with this, there is a need to study the form, properties, essential nature, and dharma. The four orders of nature are evident in the four planes. The study of development (constitutional completeness) is absolutely essential. Jeevan is studied in the form of a developed unit, wherein awakening progression and awakening become clearly evident.

ऐसेविकासात्मकअध्ययनमेंमात्रतात्विकताकावर्णनबोधगम्यनहोनेकेकारण (अनुमानकरनेयोग्यस्वीकृतिनहोनेकेकारण) तर्ककीसहायताआवश्यकहै।यहाँतर्ककीआवश्यकताइसलिएप्रतीतहोतीहैऔरनियोजितकीगईहैकिवांछित (जिसेसिद्धकरनाहै) कीकल्पनापहलेसेसाधकमें (जिसेप्राप्तकरनाहै) पूर्वाभ्यासरूपमेंप्रतिष्ठितकरनाहै।In such a study of consciousness development, mere description of existentiality is not sufficient to comprehend it (because the seeker has no prior notion for inferring it). Here logical reasoning is necessary and deployed to establish the desired objective in the seeker's imagination, serving as a form of preparation. सर्वप्रथमअध्ययन; द्वितीयस्थितिमेंप्रयोगवअभ्यास; तृतीयस्थितिमेंअनुभव, प्रमाणप्रमाणितहोनाहीउपलब्धिऔरसार्थकताहै।विकासऔरजागृतिसंबंधीअध्ययनमानवकुलकेलिएअथवामानवकुलसुरक्षितरहनेकेलिएपरमावश्यकहै।सर्वमानवमेंसमझदारीकीप्यासहैही।यहीपात्रतासर्वमानवमेंहोनेकाप्रमाणहैइसेतर्कसंगतविधिसे, अर्थबोधसहितस्थितिसत्य, वस्तुस्थितिसत्य, वस्तुगतसत्यकोबोधगम्य, अध्ययनगम्य, फलत: अनुभवगम्यताकोप्रमाणितकरनेकीस्थितिसमीचीनहै, यहीअध्ययनकातात्पर्यहै।This process has three stages: (1) study, (2) experiment and practice, and (3) realisation with evidence, which itself is the accomplishment and success. The study of development and awakening is crucial for humankind’s survival. All humans have an inherent thirst for understanding. The evidence of this receptivity’s presence in all humans is that the absolute truth, relative truth, and objective truth is always studiable, understandable and realisable in a logical way, which itself is the meaning of study. मानवीयतापूर्णमानवव्यवस्थासहजरूपमेंहोनेकेआधारपरनिश्चयनऔरध्रुवीकरणहुआ।मानवीयतापूर्णमानवसेकमविकसितपशुमानववराक्षसमानवकाव्यवस्थामेंजीनासंभवनहींहुआ, यहसमीक्षितहोचुकाहै।मानवसेश्रेष्ठदेवमानववदिव्यमानवहैं, जोजागृतिपूर्णहैं।अनुभवप्रमाणकेरूपमेंजागृतमानवपरंपरामेंसार्थकसिद्धहुईं।जागृतपरंपरामेंमानवीयतापूर्णकार्य-व्यवहारकेरूपमेंस्पष्टहोताहै, ‘अनुभवप्रमाण’ परिवारव्यवस्थाऔरविश्वपरिवारव्यवस्थामेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।यहपरमआवश्यकताहैही।उक्तविधिसेव्यवहारकेसभीआयामोंमेंमानवीयताकोपहचानना, मूल्यांकितकरनाऔरव्यवस्थामेंमानवीयतासहितअनुभवप्रमाणोंकोपहचाननाऔरप्रमाणितकरनासहअस्तित्वदृष्टिकोणसेसंभवहोगयाहै।It has been ascertained and anchored that humane-humans are naturally in orderliness, and it is not possible to live in orderliness for animalistic-humans and demonic-humans, who are less developed than humane-humans. The deific-humans and divine-humans, being completely awakened, are more eminent than humane-humans. Their realisation manifests in human tradition in the form of ‘realisational evidence’. This ‘realisation evidence’ embodies humaneness in work and behaviour, and becomes apparent within the family order and the world family order. This is absolutely necessary. Accordingly, with the co-existential viewpoint, it has now become feasible to recognise and evaluate humaneness in all aspects of behaviour; along with recognising and evidencing ‘realisation-evidences’ in the orderliness. o​दिव्यमानवकाविषय (प्रवृत्ति) परमसत्यरूपीसहअस्तित्वहै।

The propensity (tendency) of divine-humans is the ultimate truth in the form of coexistence.
