This is observed in human interactions as well. Living with justice, dharma, and truth itself is the complete awakening.

○​मानवकोअध्यात्मिक (व्यापकपक्ष), अधिदैविक (बौद्धिकपक्ष), औरअधिभौतिक (जड़पक्ष) कादर्शन, अध्ययनवप्रयोगकरनेकाअवसरप्राप्तहै।सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभववप्रयोगकरनेकाअधिकारहरनरनारीकोप्राप्तहै।Humans possess the opportunity to understand, study, and experiment with the spiritual (Omnipresence), deific (intellectual), and metaphysical (insentient nature) aspects. Every man and woman has the inherent right for realisation and experimentation in coexistence.

○​रहस्यकेमूलमेंअहंकारअथवाभ्रमहीहै।At the root of mystery lies ego or delusion only.

○​सत्यबोधकेअभावमेंचित्तमेंहोनेवालीचित्रणक्रियामेंअतिव्याप्ति, अनाव्याप्तिअथवाअव्याप्तिदोषकारहनाअनिवार्यहै।फलत: काल्पनिकआरोपचित्रणमेंहोगाही।चित्रणमेंइसकाल्पनिकआरोपकी ‘अभिमान’ अथवाभ्रमसंज्ञाहै।

page-285

In the absence of enlightenment of truth, the visualisation activity in

chitta mandatorily has the flaws of excess, deficiency, or omission. As a result there will be imaginary imposition in visualisation. This imaginary imposition in visualisation is referred to as 'conceit' or 'delusion'.

○​मनसेवृति, वृत्तिसेचित्त, चित्तसेबुद्धिश्रेष्ठप्रक्रियाहै।अत: इसीक्रमिकअधिकारभेदसेउनकापरस्परनियंत्रणहै।

Vritti is superior to mun, chitta is superior to vritti, and buddhi is superior to chitta in their functioning. Accordingly, their mutual regulation is based on this hierarchical order of authority.

●​मानवयीतापूर्णदृष्टि, स्वभावऔरविषयपरअधिकारपानेकेपश्चात्हीदेवमानवीयतातथादिव्यमानवीयताकेलिएजोशेषप्रयासहैं, उसेकरनेमेंसाधकप्रवृत्तहोताहै।It is only when the seeker attains the authority on perspective, essential nature, and propensity of humaneness that they engage in the remaining endeavours for deific humaneness and divine humaneness.

●​आत्मबोधहीआध्यात्मिकउपलब्धिहै।Atma-bodh itself is the spiritual accomplishment.

○​अन्तर्नियामनप्रक्रियाद्वाराहीआत्मबोधहोताहै, जोध्यानदेनेकीचरमउपलब्धिहै।यहहीजागृतिहै।ऐसेआत्मबोध (अनुभवबोध) सम्पन्नमानवकी, जागृतमानवसंज्ञाहैतथायहीप्रमाणरूपमेंमानव, देवमानव, दिव्यमानवहोनापायाजाताहै।Atma-bodh happens solely through the inward regulation process, which is the highest accomplishment of concentration. This itself is awakening. Individuals who have achieved atma-bodh (enlightenment of realisation) are referred to as the awakened humans, and these only are evident in the form of humane-human, deific-human and divine-human.

●​अवधारणाकेअनन्तरआत्माकीओरबुद्धिकाप्रत्यावर्तनहोतेहीआत्मबोधतथाब्रह्मानुभूति(सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभूति) एकसाथहीप्रभावशीलहोतीहै।प्रभावितहोजानाहीउपलब्धिहै।ऐसीउपलब्धिबुद्धिकोआप्लावितकियेरहतीहै।

Upon attaining conception, along with reflection of buddhi towards atma, atma-bodh and Brahma-realisation (realisation in coexistence) come into

page-286

effect simultaneously. This becoming affected itself is accomplishment. Such

an accomplishment keeps the buddhi immersed.

●​ऐसेब्रह्मानुभूतआचरणप्रमाणसम्पन्नइकाईकोमानव, देवमानव, दिव्यमानवकीसंज्ञाहैजोसततप्रेरणाकाश्रोतहै।Such Brahma-realised individuals, with evidence in conduct, are referred to as humane human, deific human, and divine human - who are continuous sources of inspiration.

●​मानवअपनीतथाअन्यमानव, देवमानव, दिव्यमानव, देवात्मावदिव्यात्माकीप्रेरणासे, अनुग्रहसेतथाअनुकम्पासेअध्ययनपूर्वकजागृतहोनाचाहताहै, जिससेवहभीदेवत्वतथादिव्यत्वकीउपलब्धिकरसकें।Humans aspire to attain awakening by way of study through self-inspiration, as well as through the inspiration, grace, and compassion of other humane humans, deific humans, divine humans, deific-jeevans, and divine-jeevans, so

that they too may achieve humaneness, deific-ness, and divineness.

●​जागृतमानवअजागृतमानवकामार्गदर्शकहैहीतथामार्गदर्शनकरताहीहै।Awakened humans are natural guides for un-awakened humans, and provide them guidance.

○​सामाजिकताकी ‘अपेक्षा’ उसकेयोग्यवैचारिकसंवेदनशीलतासेहै।वैचारिकपरिमार्जनआवश्यकहै, क्योंकिसामाजिकताकासंरक्षणसम्पर्कोंएवम्सम्बन्धोंकेनिर्वाहसेहै।सामाजिकताकानिर्वाहपरिमार्जितविचारएवम्संज्ञानपूर्णव्यवहारसेहीहै।ऐसेपरिमार्जितविचारएवम्व्यवहार, मात्रमानवीयताएवम्अतिमानवीयतासेसम्पन्नहोनेपरहीसम्भवहै।यहीजागृतिहै।The expectation of sociality is based on corresponding sensitivity in thinking. Refinement in thinking is necessary because the protection of sociality is achieved through the fulfilment of relationships and associations. Sustainability of sociality is only through refined thought and behaviour imbued with cognisance. Such refined thinking and behaviour are possible only upon attaining humaneness and higher humaneness. This itself is awakening.

○​जड़पक्षपरजागृतमानवसहअस्तित्वसहजसंतुलनकोबनायेरखनेकेलिएनियन्त्रणकरनेकाअधिकारसम्पन्नरहताहै।इसीनियंत्रण (ज्ञान) सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवसहजक्षमता, योग्यतातथापात्रतापूर्णहोनेपरचैतन्यपक्षकीजागृतिप्रमाणितहोतीहै, अन्यथामेंउसकेद्वाराह्रासकीस्वीकृतिहीहै।

page-287

The awakened human has the natural authority and control over the

insentient aspect for sustaining the balance of coexistence. The awakening of the sentient aspect (jeevan) becomes evident when its capacity, ability, and receptivity are fully developed, allowing for the realisation of this regulation (knowledge) in the form of coexistence. Without such realisation, they have only an acceptance of decline.

○​नियंत्रण (ज्ञानयाव्यापकता) कीअनुभूतिकेलियेविचारपक्षकीसंयमता, विचारपक्षकीसंयमताकेलियेचित्तशक्तिकाप्रत्यावर्तन, ऐसेप्रत्यावर्तनकेलियेदृढ़तातथानिष्ठा, औरदृढ़तातथानिष्ठाकेलियेजड़, चैतन्यवव्यापककानिर्भ्रमज्ञानआवश्यकहै।For the realisation of regulation (knowledge or omnipresence), the restraint of thoughts is necessary; for the restraint of thoughts, reflection of the chitta is necessary; for such reflection, firmness and

dedication are necessary; and for firmness and dedication, delusion-less knowledge of the insentient, sentient, and omnipresence is necessary.

नीचेसंक्षेपमेंजड़, चैतन्यतथाव्यापकसत्ताकेबारेमेंमूलनिर्देशकतत्वदियेगयेहैं - The basic guidelines regarding the insentient, sentient, and the omnipresent Omnipotence are summarised below:

1. जड़मरणधर्मा, चैतन्यअमरत्वधर्मातथाव्यापकनित्य-धर्माहै।The insentient is mortal, sentient is immortal, and Omnipresence is eternal.

1. अनेकपरमाणुओंसेगठितपिण्डयाअनेकपरमाणुओंसेगठितअवस्थाकी ‘स्थूल’ संज्ञाहै।An object or body constituted of many atoms is referred to as ‘gross’.

1. परमाणुकी ‘सूक्ष्म’ संज्ञाहै।Atoms are referred to as ‘subtle’.

1. आत्माकी ‘कारण’ संज्ञाहै।Atma is referred to as ‘causal’. 5. व्यापककी ‘महाकारण’ संज्ञाहै।

page-288

Omnipresence is referred to as ‘supreme cause’.

निरपेक्षऊर्जासर्वत्र (व्यापक) होनेकेकारणसर्वदासबकोप्राप्तहै।नित्यसहअस्तित्वकेकारण :- Absolute energy is always inherent to all because it is everywhere (omnipresent). Due to the eternity of coexistence:-

●​पदार्थावस्थाकीइकाईयाँइसेपाकरसक्रिय।The units of material order are active because of being in it. ●​प्राणावस्थाकीइकाईयाँइसमेंहोनेकेकारणस्पन्दित।The units of biological order have pulsation because of being in it.

●​जीवावस्थाकीइकाईयाँइसमेंहोनेकेकारणआशान्वितहै।The units of animal order have hope of living because of being in it. ●​ज्ञानावस्थाकीइकाईयाँइसमेंहोनेकेकारणआशान्वितऔरसंज्ञानितहैं।The units of knowledge order are hopeful and conscientious because of being in it.

○​उत्तरोत्तरविकसितइकाईमेंनिम्नस्तरीयइकाईयोंकेगुणविलयरहतेहीहैं।A higher-order unit includes the properties of lower-order units.

●​ज्ञानकाउद्घाटनचैतन्यपक्षअथवाविचारोंद्वाराहीहोताहै।The unfolding of knowledge occurs only by sentient aspect (jeevan) or thoughts.

●​विचारपक्षसंस्कारोंकेआधारपरह्रासऔरजागृतिकीओरगतितहै।The sentient aspect (jeevan) moves towards awakening or decline based on sanskars.

●​दूसरोंकेकष्ट, दुःख, वेदनाएवम्संकटकेप्रतिमानवमेंसंवेदनाहोतीहीहै, जोज्ञानानुभूतिकीसक्षमताअथवासंभावनाकेकारणहै।

page-289

Humans have sensitivity towards suffering, misery, pain, and troubles of

others, because of their capacity or possibility for realisation in knowledge.

●​ज्ञानानुभूतिकीयोग्यतामानवकेजागृतिपर; मानवकीजागृतिसंस्कारोंपर; संस्कारोंकाविकास

वातावरण, अध्ययनवप्रयासपर; वातावरण, अध्ययनवप्रयासमानवीयता, अतिमानवीयतापर; मानवीयता, अतिमानवीयताज्ञानानुभूतिकीयोग्यतापरनिर्भरकरतीहै।The ability of realisation in knowledge depends on human awakening; human awakening depends on sanskars; development of sanskars depends on environment, study & endeavour; environment, study & endeavour depend on

humaneness and higher humaneness; humaneness and higher humaneness depend on the ability of realisation in knowledge. ●​स्वस्वरूपहीआत्मा (मध्यस्थक्रिया) है।मन, वृत्ति, चित्तऔरबुद्धिसेआत्मासहजअनुभवश्रेष्ठ

क्रियाहै।फलस्वरूपहीआत्माकेप्रभावसेपूर्णतयाप्रभावितनहोनेतकबुद्धिमेंआनन्दानुभूति, चित्तमेंसन्तोषानुभूति, वृत्तिमेंशान्तिकीअनुभूतितथामनमेंसुखानुभूतिनहींहै।The self is atma (mediative activity). The realisation activity of atma is more eminent than the activities of mun, vritti, chitta, and buddhi. Therefore, until buddhi, chitta, vritti, and mun become completely affected by atma, there is no

realisation of bliss in buddhi, contentment in chitta, peace in vritti, and happiness in mun.

●​जोसुखीनहींहै, वहदूसरोंकोसुखीनहींकरसकता।जोसुखीनहींहै, वहदुःखीहीहोगातथाजिसकेपासजोहोगावहउसीकाबंटनकरसकेगा।The one who is not happy cannot make others happy. One who is not happy must be unhappy, and one can distribute only what one has. ●​बुद्धिकोआत्मबोधवव्यापकतासहजअनुभवबोधकाअवसरहै।इसीलियेऐसीअनुभूतिके

अनन्तरसर्वतोमुखीसमाधानवसमझसुलभहै।

Buddhi has the potential for atma-bodh and enlightenment of the realisation in omnipresence. Therefore, after its realisation, the comprehensive resolution and understanding become accessible.

●​विकसितइकाईअविकसितइकाईकेअनुरूपव्यवहारऔरविचारसेह्रासकीओरगतितहोतीहैजैसेमानवजीवोंसेविकसितहैपरजीवोंकेसदृश्यव्यवहार, विहारएवंआहारकेप्रयाससेहीह्रासकीओरगतितहै।

page-290

A developed unit moves towards decline by thinking and behaving like an

undeveloped unit. For instance, humans, who are more developed than animals, move towards decline when they try to adopt the behaviour, lifestyle, and eating habits of animals.

●​आसक्तिवशहीगुरुमूल्यकालघुमूल्यकीओरझुकावहै, जोअवमूल्यनहै।गुरुमूल्यकोलघुमूल्यकेलिएप्रायोजितएवंनियोजितकरनेकेलिएभ्रमकारहनाअनिवार्यहै।The inclination of higher value towards lower value is solely due to attachment, which is under-evaluation. The presence of delusion is mandatory for espousal and deployment of higher value towards lower value.

●​यथार्थतासेभिन्नमान्यताही ‘भ्रम’ है।Belief different from reality itself is "delusion".

●​ह्रासकीसूचनारहतेहुएभीविकासकेस्पष्टज्ञानएवम्निष्ठाकेअभावमेंमानवविवशतापूर्वकअर्थात्भ्रमपूर्वकपतनकीओरगतितहै।Despite being aware of decline, humans, lacking clear knowledge and dedication about development, helplessly i.e. deludedly move towards downfall.

○​ह्रासएवंविकासकाजोक्रमहै, वहआवर्तनशीलताकेआधारपरसिद्धहोताहै।प्रत्येकमानवजागृतिहीचाहताहै, किन्तुभ्रमवशह्रासकोप्राप्तकरताहै।इसकाकारणमन, वृत्ति, चित्त, बुद्धिऔरआत्माकेबीचआवर्तनएवंप्रत्यावर्तनक्रियाएवंउसकेप्रभावकाज्ञाननहोनाहीहै, जोरहस्यताकेरूपमेंमानवमनकोउद्वेलितकिएरहताहै।The progression towards development or decline in humans proves to be based on the reflection-projection cycle. While every human being desires awakening, they end up in decline due to delusion. This is because of a lack of understanding regarding the reflection and projection activities between mun, vritti, chitta, buddhi, and atma, as well as their respective effects - which keeps the human mind agitated in the form of mysteriousness.

●​अपराधहीनव्यवहारकेलियेसार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकीप्रेरणा, न्यायपूर्णविचारकेलियेसामाजिकआचरणकाप्रभाव, धर्मपूर्णइच्छाकेलियेअध्ययनएवम्सुसंस्कारकाप्रभावतथाअज्ञानरहितबुद्धिकेलियेअर्न्तनियामनकाप्रभावआवश्यकसिद्धहोताहै।

page-291

The inspiration of the universal orderliness proves to be necessary for

crime-free behaviour, the influence of social conduct proves to be necessary for justice-oriented thinking, the effect of study and susanskar proves to be necessary for dharma-oriented desire, and the effect of inward regulation proves to be necessary for buddhi to be devoid of ignorance.

○​अतःपरस्परतामेंजोव्यतिरेकहैउसकेउन्मूलनकेलियेतथापरस्परतामेंविश्वासकोउत्पन्नकरनेकेलिये, जोजागृतिकेलियेप्रथमसोपानहै, मानवीयतापूर्णआचरणवसामाजिकता, न्यायपूर्णव्यवस्था, सहअस्तित्वरूपीसत्यप्रतिष्ठितशिक्षाएवम्इसमेंविश्वासपूर्वकव्यक्तिगतनिष्ठाउत्पन्नकरनासबकासम्मिलितदायित्वसिद्धहोताहै।Therefore, for eliminating divergence in mutuality and for generating trust in mutuality—which is the first step towards awakening—it is the collective responsibility of all to establish humane conduct and sociality,

justice-based orderliness, education founded upon the truth of coexistence, and personal commitment grounded in trust towards it.

●​भ्रान्तअवस्थामेंप्रधानतःछःप्रकारकेआवेशोंकोपायाजाताहै, वेहैं 1. काम, 2. क्रोध, 3. मद, 4. मोह, 5. लोभऔर 6. मत्सर।Primarily six kinds of flaws are found in the deluded state. These are 1. Lust, 2. Anger, 3. Intoxication, 4. Infatuation, 5. Greed, and 6. Malevolence.

●​इनसबकेमूलमेंआवेशहै।आवेशहीमानवकेलिएदुःखकाकारणहै।All these have agitation at their root. Agitation itself is the cause of

unhappiness for humans.

●​आवेशकेमूलमेंहठ, हठकेमूलमेंभ्रमऔरभ्रमकेमूलमेंअहंकारहै।At the root of agitation lies stubbornness, at the root of stubbornness lies delusion, and at the root of delusion lies ego.

○​हठ :- अपनेविचारयाव्यवहारसेपूर्णतःप्रभावितहोजानाहठहै।Stubbornness (hath): - Being completely affected by one's own thoughts or behaviour is stubbornness.

○​काम : - प्रजननयायौनसंवेदनाक्रियामेंसुखपानेकीप्रवृत्तिकीकामसंज्ञाहै।

page-292

Lust (kaam): - The tendency to seek pleasure in sexual activities is

called lust.

○​क्रोध : - स्वयम्कीअक्षमताकाप्रदर्शनहीक्रोधहै।Anger (krodh): - The display of one's own incapacity is anger.

○​मदः- असत्यताकेप्रतिमान्यताकीपराकाष्ठाहीमदहै।Intoxication (mad): - The extremeness of belief towards falsehood is intoxication.

○​मोह : - मुग्धहोजानाहीमोहहै।Infatuation (moha): - Becoming captivated itself is infatuation.

○​लोभ : - पात्रतासेअधिकविशेषविभूतिकेप्रतिउत्कटवांछाएवम्प्रयासहीलोभहै।सुविधा-संग्रहप्रवृत्तिहोना।Greed (lobh): - The intense desire and effort for achieving something that is beyond one's deserving is greed. Tendency towards comfort and accumulation.

○​मत्सर : - दूसरेकेह्रासएवम्पतनहेतुउत्कटकामनावप्रयासमत्सरहै।Malevolence (matsar): - Malevolence is the fervent wish and efforts for

the decline and downfall of another person.

●​मनमेंआवेश, वृत्तिमेंहठ, चित्तमेंभ्रमतथाबुद्धिमेंआत्मासेविमुखता (अहंकार) हीशरीरमूलकप्रवृत्तियाँहै, औरमनमेंमित्र-आशा, वृत्तिमेंविचार, चित्तमेंइच्छाऔरबुद्धिमेंऋतम्भरा, आत्मामेंअनुभवप्रमाणपरावर्तनक्रियाहै।Agitation in mun, stubbornness in vritti, delusion in chitta, and ego in buddhi are tendencies based on the body, whereas friendly hopes in mun, resolved thoughts in vritti, benevolent desires in chitta, resoluteness in buddhi, and realisational evidence in atma are the projection activities of awakening.

●​मनएवम्वृत्तिकेमध्यमेंभ्रमितमनःकृतवातावरणकेदबावसेदुःखतथाइसकेविपरीतवृत्तिएवम्मनकेमध्यमेंवृत्तिसहजवातावरणकेप्रभावसेसुखकीउपलब्धिहोतीहै।

page-293

Between mun and vritti, the pressure of the environment created by deluded

mun leads to unhappiness, and conversely, between vritti and mun, the effect of the environment of vritti leads to accomplishment of happiness.

●​वृत्तिएवम्चित्तकेमध्यमेंवृत्तिकृतवातावरणकेदबावसेअशांतितथाइसकेविपरीतचित्तएवम्वृत्तिकेमध्यमेंचित्तसहजवातावरणकेप्रभावसेशान्तिकीउपलब्धिहोतीहै।

Between vritti and chitta, the pressure of the environment created by vritti leads to unrest, and conversely, between chitta and vritti, the effect of the environment of chitta results in accomplishment of peace.

●​चित्तएवम्बुद्धिकेमध्यमेंचित्तकृतवातावरणसेअसंतोषतथाइसकेविपरीतबुद्धिएवम्चित्तकेमध्यबुद्धिसहजवातावरणसेसंतोषकीउपलब्धिहोतीहै।Between chitta and buddhi, the environment created by chitta leads to discontent, and conversely, between buddhi and chitta, the effect of the environment of buddhi leads to accomplishment of contentment.

●​बुद्धिएवम्आत्माकेमध्यमेंआत्माकाहीवातावरणहोनापायाजाताहैक्योंकिआत्मामध्यस्थहै।यहवातावरणप्रभावपूर्णरहताहैतथाआत्माभिमुखबुद्धिसहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवसहजआनन्दकीअनुभूतिरहनापायाजाताहै।Between buddhi and atma, there is only the environment of atma since atma is mediative by nature. This environment is potent, therefore the atma-oriented buddhi remains with the bliss of realisation in coexistence.

○​इसप्रकारयहस्पष्टहुआकिजागृतजीवनमेंमनऔरवृत्तिकेयोगसेसुख, वृत्तिऔरचित्तकेयोगसेशान्ति, चित्तवबुद्धिकेयोगसेसंतोषतथाबुद्धिऔरआत्माकेयोगसेआनन्दकीअनुभूतिहोतीहै।यहीजागृतिहै।Hence it becomes clear that in an awakened jeevan, the union of mun and vritti leads to happiness, the union of vritti and chitta leads to peace, the union of chitta and buddhi leads to contentment, and the union of buddhi and atma leads to bliss. This itself is awakening.

page-294

●​जागृतजीवनमेंआवर्तनक्रियामेंआत्मसत्ताकाबुद्धिमें, बुद्धिसत्ताकाचित्तमें, चित्तसत्ताकावृत्तिमेंतथावृत्ति-सत्ताकामनमेंपूर्णतःअवगाहनहोताहै।चूंकिमनसेवृत्ति, वृत्तिसेचित्त, चित्तसेबुद्धिऔरबुद्धिसेआत्माश्रेष्ठहै, जोजागृतिमूलकआवर्तनक्रमकेअनुसारआनन्द, संतोष, शान्तिऔरसुखकेरूपमेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।In the reflection-projection cycle of an awakened jeevan, there is a complete adherence to the authority of atma in buddhi, similarly of buddhi in chitta, of chitta in vritti, and of vritti in mun. This is because vritti is more eminent than mun, chitta is more eminent than vritti, buddhi is more eminent than chitta, and

atma is more eminent than buddhi. This becomes evident in the form of bliss, contentment, peace, and happiness according to the reflection-projection cycle based on awakening.

●​बुद्धिकेलिएआत्मानुभूतितथाव्यापकताकाबोध, चितकेलिएसत्यबोधपूर्णबुद्धिकाचिंतन, वृतिकेलिएयथार्थचिन्तनपूर्णचितकाविचारऔरमनकेलिएन्यायपूर्णविचारोंकामननहीपूर्णविकासहैजोप्रत्यावर्तनप्रक्रियाकेद्वारादेवमनुष्यतथादिव्यमनुष्यकाजीवनसिद्धहोताहै।The complete development for buddhi is enlightenment of realisation in atma and of Omnipresence; for chitta it is contemplation of buddhi replete with enlightenment of truth; for vritti it is thought of chitta replete with contemplation

of reality; and for mun it is ratiocination of vritti replete with thoughts of justice - which is the accomplishment of reflection process. Thus, complete development of jeevan, through the reflection process, becomes evident as humane-human, deific-human and divine-human.

●​आत्मा, मध्यस्थक्रियाहोनेकेकारणप्रभावीहीरहताहै, क्योंकिदबावसम-विषममेंहीहै।अनुभवप्रभावमध्यस्थहोनेकेकारणदबावमुक्तहै।अनुभवसहजनित्यप्रभावहीहै।Atma, being the mediative activity, remains as effective, because pressure is only in generative and degenerative activities. The effect of realisation is devoid of pressure because it is mediative. Realisation is only an eternal effect.

●​कुछइकाईयोंकाविकास (जागृति) तथाअन्योंकाह्रास (भ्रम) एकरहस्यसालगताहै।इसरहस्यकेमूलमेंप्रत्यावर्तनक्रियाहै।ह्रासकीओरगतितमानवोंकोअन्योंकाविकासशीलहोनारहस्यमयलगताहै; जबकिइसमेंकोईरहस्यनहींहै।ह्रासकीओरगतितमानवभीउन्हींसाधनोंकाउपयोगकरह्रासकोप्राप्तकररहाहै, जिनसाधनोंकाउपयोगकरदूसराव्यक्तिविकसित (जागृत) होरहाहैअर्थात्साधनवहीहैमात्रउनकीप्रयुक्तिकीदिशामेंहीअंतरहै।

page-295

The development (awakening) of some and the decline (delusion) of others

seems like a mystery. The root of this mystery lies in the lack of reflection activity. To humans who are moving towards decline, the development of others may seem mysterious, but in reality, there is no mystery involved. Those who are moving towards decline are using the same means that others are using for their development (awakening). The means are the same; the only difference is the direction in which they are deployed.

●​आत्मामध्यस्थक्रियाहै।मध्यस्थ-क्रियाकावातावरणभीमध्यस्थहै, यहीकारणहैकिआत्मातथाउसकेवातावरणपर्यन्तसमतथाविषमकादबावनहींपड़ताहै।Atma is mediative activity. The environment of mediative activity is also mediative; this is the reason there is no pressure of generative and degenerative on atma and its environment.

●​सत्ताव्यापकहैइसलिएवहदबावकाकारणसिद्धनहींहोता।क्रियाकेबिनादबावयाप्रभावसिद्धनहींहोता।अतःशून्यअथवाव्यापकसत्ताप्रभाववदबावदोनोंसेमुक्तवसम-विषमप्रभावसेतटस्थहै।हरइकाईस्वयम्कीपात्रतावशहीउसेपाकरगतिशीलहै।Omnipotence, being omnipresent, doesn’t prove to be the cause of pressure. Pressure or effect cannot exist without activity. Thus, Space or the omnipresent Omnipotence is free from both pressure and effect, and remains

neutral to generative and degenerative effects. Every unit is in motion by inherently having it only due to its own receptivity.

○​व्यापकसत्तासर्वत्रएवम्सर्वकालिकअवस्थितितथाउसमेंसमस्तक्रियाएंसमाहितहोनेसेयहसिद्धहुआकिव्यापकसत्ताएवम्क्रियाएंअविभाज्यहै।Since Omnipotence is present everywhere and at all times, and all units are encompassed within it, it is proven that the Omnipotence and the activities are indivisible.

○​यहसर्वकालिक, सर्वदेशिकहैएवम्सर्वत्रव्याप्तहोनेकेकारणसबकोसमानरूपसेप्राप्तहै।इसलिए, यहसिद्धहोताहैकिसभीशून्यमेंसंरक्षितवनियंत्रितहै।यहनियंत्रणहीइकाईकीचेष्टाकामूलकारणहै।इसलिएसत्ताको ‘महाकारण’ संज्ञासेभीजानाजाताहै।Omnipotence, because of being at all times, at all places and all pervasive, is equally inherent to all units. Therefore, it is proven that all units are protected and regulated within Space. This regulation itself is the root cause of impulsion of units. Hence, Omnipotence is also referred to as the 'Supreme Cause'.

page-296

○​यहविकल्पअखंडसमाज, सार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकेरूपमेंहै।इसप्रस्तावमेंमानवहीअखंडसमाज, सार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकाप्रमाणदेनाप्रतिपादितहै।साथहीमानवहीप्रमाणहोनेकासाक्षीकोभीसँजोलियाहै।इसमुद्देपरसर्वमानवकाध्यानाकर्षणकरनाआवश्यकहैही।इसक्रममेंसमुदायचेतनासेमानवचेतना, मानवचेतनासेसमाजचेतनामेंपरिवर्तितहोनाहीमहत्वपूर्णघटनाहै।ऐसेस्थितिकीसफलतामानवही, शिक्षा-संस्कारपूर्वक, सर्वतोमुखीसमाधानसंपन्नहोनाहीएकमात्रउपायहै।इसेसार्थकबनानेकेक्रममेंहीमानवव्यवहारदर्शन, मानवकेसम्मुखप्रस्तुतहै।इसप्रकारसमग्रविकासऔरजागृतिकोपरंपरामेंप्रमाणितकरनेहेतुएकमात्रइकाईमानवहैक्योंकिअस्तित्वमेंकेवलमानवहीदृष्टापदप्रतिष्ठामेंहै।This alternative is in the form of "undivided society, universal orderliness”. This proposal postulates that only humans evidence undivided society, universal orderliness, and humans alone serve as

witnesses to this evidence. Therefore, it is necessary to draw the attention of all humans to this alternative. In this context, transition from sectarian consciousness to humane consciousness, and subsequently to social consciousness, is the significant milestone. The only solution is - humans attain comprehensive resolution through education-sanskar. To facilitate this process, "Holistic View of Human Behaviour" (Manav Vyavhar Darshan) has been presented to humankind, because humans are the only entities who possess the capacity to evidence overall development and awakening in tradition, as only humans are in the seer status in existence.

○​भ्रमितमानवकेद्वाराभ्रमितमानवकेचारऐश्वर्यों (रूप, बल, पद, धन) काशोषणहोताहै

।

Deluded humans exploit the four assets (appearance, might, societal status, wealth) of deluded humans. ●​जागृतिकावैभवहीअज्ञानकानिराकरणहै।The grandeur of awakening itself is the elimination of ignorance.

●​अविकसितकेप्रतिआसक्ति (आकर्षण) सेहीविवशताहै, जोजागृतिकोअवरूद्धकरतीहै।जैसेभ्रमितपरम्परामेंमानवपशुओंकेसदृश्यजीतादेखागयाहै।Attachment (attraction) towards the undeveloped is the only reason for helplessness, which hinders awakening. For example, humans in deluded tradition are seen to be living like animals.

page-297

●​अविकसित, विकसितकेलिएसाधनहीसिद्धहुआहैऔरविकसितअविकसितकेलिएसाध्य।The undeveloped proves to be only the means for the developed, and the

developed proves to be the ends for the undeveloped.

●​साधनकासदुपयोगहीविकासहैऔरउसकादुरूपयोगहीह्रासकाद्योतकहै।The right-use of means itself is "development", and their misuse itself is indicative of "decline".

●​विकसितकाएकसूत्रवत्अनुकरणतथाअनुसरणपूर्वकस्वयंस्फूर्तहोनाहीऔरजागृतिकोप्रमाणितकरनाहीसर्वमानवकावैभवहै।The grandeur of all humans lies in their ability to be self-driven by integrally following and emulating the awakened, and evidencing the awakening.

●​विश्रामयासमाधानबौद्धिकताकावैभवहै।Restfulness or resolution is the grandeur of sentience.

●​अध्यात्मिकताकीकोईसीमानहींहैक्योंकियहव्यापकहै।व्यापकवस्तुमेंसहअस्तित्वरूपीसमझहीसमाधानहै।इसेप्रमाणितकरनाहीसर्वमानवकासौभाग्यहै।There is no limit to spirituality because it is omnipresent. The understanding in the form of coexistence in Omnipotence itself is resolution, and evidencing it is the good fortune of all humans.

●​भौतिकतापरिणामवादी, बौद्धिकताअमरत्ववादीतथाअध्यात्मिकतानित्यवादीहै।Insentience is of changing-nature, sentience is of immortal-nature, and spirituality is of eternal-nature.

●​चैतन्यइकाईकेसंस्कारभेदसेहीउसकीक्षमता, योग्यताएवम्पात्रताहै।The capacity, ability, and receptivity of a sentient unit are determined by its sanskar.

●​क्षमता, योग्यताएवम्पात्रताकेअनुसारहीचैतन्यइकाईनेमानवीयता, अतिमानवीयताऔरअमानवीयताकाउद्घाटनकियाहै।

page-298

A sentient unit has unfolded humaneness, higher humaneness, and

inhumaneness only based on its capacity, ability and receptivity.

●​मानवकीक्षमताभेदसेक्रमसेबोध, दर्शन, कल्पना, आशा, अवस्था, प्रयास, प्रभावऔरमानवकीक्षमताकाद्योतकहै।

The human capacity is indicated by their enlightenment, worldview, imagination, hope, state, endeavour, and effect.

●​पदार्थ, मन, वृत्ति, चित्त, बुद्धिऔरआत्माकानाशनहींहैयाअभावनहींहै।इनमेंमात्रविकासऔरजागृतिकाहीन्यूनाधिक्यहै।There is no annihilation or absence of matter, mun, vritti, chitta, buddhi, and atma. They exist only in varying degrees of development and awakening.

●​पदार्थपरिणामवादी, प्राणतरंगवादी, मनचयनवादी, वृत्तितुलनवादी, चित्तचित्रणवादी, बुद्धिबोधवादीतथाआत्माअस्तित्ववादीतत्वहै।

Insentient matter is changing-nature, prana is wave nature, mun is selective nature, vritti is deliberative nature, chitta is imaginative nature, buddhi is enlightening nature, and atma is existential nature element.

●​आत्मातीनोंकालोंमेंमध्यस्थक्रियाकेरूपमेंएकसाविद्यमानहै।अस्तित्वअपरिवर्तनीयहै।इसकाआत्मामेंअनुभव, बुद्धिमेंबोधहोताहै।Atma exists in the form of mediative activity across all three times. Existence

is unchanging; its realisation happens in atma, and enlightenment happens in buddhi.

●​स्वस्वरूपतथापरस्वरूपबोधबुद्धिमें, पूर्णअपूर्णचित्रणभेदचितमें, सत्यासत्य, धर्माधर्म, न्यायान्याय, लाभालाभ, हिताहित, प्रियाप्रियभेदवृतिवप्रवृतिमेंपूर्वानुक्रमयापरानुक्रमभेदमनमेंतथाउसकीचयनक्रियाएंहै।

The enlightenment of the true form of the self and of that which is other than the self occurs in buddhi. Visualisation with differentiation of completeness and incompleteness occurs in chitta. Deliberation with differentiation of truth-untruth, dharma-adharma, justice-injustice, gain-loss, healthy-unhealthy, and pleasant-unpleasant occurs in vritti. Selection with differentiation of higher-conformance and lower-conformance occurs in mun.

page-299

●​वृत्ति, चित्त, बुद्धिवआत्माकेअनुकूलप्रेरणाकी ‘पूर्वानुक्रम’ तथाप्राण, हृदय, शरीरऔरउसकेव्यवहार, व्यवसायकेअनुकूलविवशतायादबावकीपरानुक्रमसंज्ञाहै।The inspiration aligned with vritti, chitta, buddhi, and atma is referred to as

‘higher-conformance’, while the compulsion or pressure from prana, heart and body, and thereby behaviour and work, is referred to as ‘lower-conformance’.

●​भौतिक, रासायनिकवस्तुवसेवामेंआसक्तिसेसंग्रह, लोभवकामुकता; प्राणतत्वमेंआसक्तिसेद्वेष, मोह, मद, क्रोध, दर्प; जीवत्व (जीनेकीआशा) मेंआसक्तिसेअभिमान, अज्ञान, ईर्ष्याऔरमत्सरयहअजागृतमानवकीप्रवृत्तियाँहै।सत्यकेप्रतिनिष्ठासेकर्त्तव्यमेंदृढ़ता, असंग्रह, सरलतातथाअभयतावप्रेमपूर्णमूलप्रवृत्तियाँसक्रियहोतीहैं।The tendencies of accumulation, greed, and lust arise from attachment to material possessions and comforts; malice, infatuation, pride, anger, and arrogance stem from attachment to the prana (the body); conceit, ignorance,

jealousy, and malevolence result from attachment to animal instincts; these are the tendencies of un-awakened humans. In contrast, dedication to truth activates the inherent tendencies of firmness in duty, non-accumulation, simplicity, fearlessness, and love.

●​पूर्ण-बोधकाअवसरइसभूमिपरकेवलमानवकोहीहै, अन्यकिसीइकाईकोनहीं।इसलिएमानवउसकेबिनासुखीनहींहुआहै।स्वस्वरूप (आत्म) बोधकोपूर्णबोधसंज्ञाहै।Only humans, and no other entity on Earth, have the opportunity for complete enlightenment. Therefore, humans have not achieved happiness without it.

Enlightenment of self (atma) is referred to as complete enlightenment.

○​पूर्णबोध - अस्तित्वदर्शनबोध, जीवनज्ञानबोध, मानवीयतापूर्णआचरणबोध।Complete enlightenment (poorna bodh): - Enlightenment of holistic view of existence, enlightenment of knowledge of jeevan, and enlightenment of humane conduct.

○​अपूर्णबोध - सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवप्रमाणबोधहोनेकेपहलेअपूर्णबोध।Incomplete enlightenment (apoorna bodh): - Incomplete enlightenment is before the enlightenment of realisation-evidence in coexistence.

●​जागृतमानवपरम्पराहीसर्वमानवमें, से, केलिएसर्वशुभकास्त्रोतहै।

page-300

The awakened human tradition alone is the source of universal wellbeing in,

by, and for all humans.

●​मनःस्वस्थताअथवाआनंदकीउपलब्धिहीरहस्यसेमुक्तिहै।The accomplishment of mental wellbeing or bliss itself is liberation from mystery.

●​स्वस्वरूपकीअनुभूतिपरम्परासहजयोगविधिसेसार्थकहोनापायाजाताहै।योगकाअर्थमिलनहै।सार्थकमिलनकाअर्थजागृतपरम्परामेंशरीरऔरजीवनकायोगहोनेसेहै।जागृतमानवकेसाथजागृतिकेलिएमिलनक्रियासम्पन्नहोनेसेहै।The realisation of self is attained through yog in the tradition. Yog means union. "Meaningful union" is the union of body and jeevan and uniting with awakened humans for awakening, in the awakened tradition.

“सर्वशुभहो” "May there be universal wellbeing"

page-301

अध्याय - अट्ठारह

### Chapter-18

### सुख-शांति-संतोषऔरआनन्दHappiness, Peace, Contentment and Bliss

●​मानवनेअनुभूतिमें ‘सुख-शान्ति-संतोषऔरआनन्द’ सहजनिरन्तरतापानेकाप्रयासकियाहै।Humans have endeavoured to attain a state of continuous ‘happiness, peace, contentment, and bliss’ in realisation. ●​अनुभूतिकेलियेयोगआवश्यकहै।योगकेप्राप्तएवम्प्राप्यदोभेदहैं।

Yog is necessary for realisation. Yog has two distinctions: pre-existing and attainable.

○​प्राप्ययोगमेंकिसीकेयोगमेंकिसीकावियोगभीहै।प्राप्तयोगमेंनकिसीकायोगहैऔरनहीकिसीकावियोगहै।प्राप्तिउसीकीहोगीजिसकाअभावहोगा।प्राप्तयोग (व्यापकसत्ता) सेरिक्तमुक्तकोईइकाईनहींहैयाक्रियानहींहै।इसीलियेप्राप्ययोगकाहीसान्निध्यअथवासंग्रहहोताहैतथाप्राप्तयोगकीमात्रअनुभूतिहोतीहै।In attainable yog, union with one involves separation from another as well, while in pre-existing yog, there is neither union nor separation of anyone. The attainment will be only of that which was lacking. There is no entity or activity that is devoid of or free from pre-existing yog (omnipresent Omnipotence). This is why proximity or accumulation is only of attainable yog, while realisation happens only of pre-existing yog. ●​प्राप्तयोगानुभूतिकेलिएसुयोग्यक्षमता, योग्यताऔरपात्रताहीअधिकारहै।ऐसीसुयोग्यक्षमता, योग्यताऔरपात्रताप्राप्तकरनाहीइकाईकेजागृतिकाचरमोत्कर्षहै।The suitable capacity, ability and receptivity for realisation of pre-existing yog is the right of every human being. The attainment of such suitable capacity, ability and receptivity is the pinnacle of their awakening.

○​सुयोग्यक्षमता, योग्यताऔरपात्रताकेलियेसहअस्तित्वमेंअध्ययनहै।अनुभवकेलिएमानवनेअध्ययन, प्रयोग, अनुसंधानतथाअभ्यासभीकियेहैं, जोमानवीयताऔरअतिमानवीयताकेरूपमेंपरिलक्षितहुआहै।For suitable capacity, ability and receptivity there is study in coexistence. Humans have also undertaken studies, experiments, explorations, and practices for realisation, which have reflected in the form of humaneness and higher humaneness.

page-302

○​इसदिशामेंजागृतिकापरिचयचैतन्य, ज्ञानावस्थाकेजागृतमानवोंमेंहीपायाजाताहै, जोमानव, देवमानवएवम्दिव्यमानवकेरूपमेंहै।मानवदेवतथादिव्यमानवोंकीसंख्यावृद्धिकेलिएसमुचितप्रयोग, अध्ययन, व्यवहारवव्यवस्थाकेस्तरमेंएकसूत्रताकोअनुस्यूतकियाजानामानवकुलकेलियेअतिआवश्यकहै, क्योंकिऐसेविकसितमानवोंद्वाराअपराधयाअपव्ययकीसंभावनानहींहै।

In this direction, the embodiment to awakening is found only in the sentient, in knowledge order, in awakened humans who are in the form of humane human, deific-human, and divine-human. For increasing their numbers, ensuring continuity of Integrality of experiment, study, behaviour, and orderliness is essential for humankind, because there is no possibility of crime or wastage by such evolved humans. ●​अज्ञान, अत्याशातथाअभाववशहीमानवअपराधकरताहैऔरअविवेकवशहीअपव्ययकरताहै।It is out of ignorance, excessive expectation, and deprivation that humans commit crime, and it is out of lack of wisdom that they fall into wastefulness.

○​अपराधऔरअपव्यय, यहदोनोंव्यवहार, मानवीयताऔरसामाजिकताकीदृष्टिसेसहायकनहींहै।अजागृतिवशअपराधहै।Both crime and wastefulness are not supportive from the perspective of humaneness and sociality. Crime is due to unawakening.

●​मध्यस्थक्रिया (आत्मा) काअध्ययनअनुसंधानपूर्वकप्रस्तुतमध्यस्थदर्शनकाशोधपूर्वकअध्ययनअनुसरणहीएकसूत्रताहै।एकसूत्रतान्याय, धर्मतथासत्यतापूर्णव्यवहार, विचारएवंअनुभूतिहीहै।The study and practice of mediative activity (atma) based on Madhyasth Darshan, which has been presented after exploration, itself leads to integrality. Integrality is justice, dharma, and truth-based behaviour, thought and realisation.

●​मानवकोविचारकेअभावमेंकिसीभीसम-विषमात्मकक्रियासम्भावनानहींहै।

Humans have no possibility of any generative or degenerative activity in the absence of thought. ●​सत्यपहलेसेहीप्राप्तसत्ताहै, जिसकीउपस्थितिजागृतिकेपूर्वभीपाईजातीहैऔरअन्तिमह्रासभीइसमेंहीअवस्थितहै।इसीकेआनुषंगिकजोअनुभूतिहै, उसे ‘पूर्वानुक्रम’ कीसंज्ञाहै।ऐसीअनुभूतिमेंहीमानवनेसमाधानएवम्आनन्दकीनिरंतरताकाअनुभवकियाहै।Truth is the eternally inherent Omnipotence that exists even prior to awakening and the ultimate decline is also encompassed in it. Realisation according to this truth is referred to as "higher-conformance". Humans have experienced a continuity of resolution and bliss only in this realisation.

page-303

●​मानवमेंतीनोंऐषणाएं, मानवीयविषय-प्रवृत्तिकेरूपमेंस्पष्टहुआरहताहै, दृष्टिन्यायप्रधान, धर्मवसत्यसम्मतरहतीहै।इनकास्वभावधीरता, वीरता, उदारताकेरूपमेंपहचानागयाहै।ऐसेविषय, प्रवृत्ति, स्वभाववदृष्टिसंपन्नमानवकोजागृतमानवकेरूपमेंपहचानागयाहै।इन्हेंसर्वतोमुखीसमाधानज्ञानहुआहीरहताहै।उसेक्रियान्वयनकरनेकीस्थितिमेंऐषणाएंविशेषकरपुत्रेषणा, वित्तेषणासीमितक्षेत्रोंमेंव्यक्तकरनेकेलिएव्यस्तरहतेहैं।इसविधामेंमानवउपयोगी, सदुपयोगीहोतेहुए, प्रयोजनपूर्णहोनेमेंअपेक्षाबनीरहतीहै।इसलिएदेवमानव, दिव्यमानवकेरूपमेंव्यक्तहोना, प्रमाणितहोनाआवश्यकताकेरूपमेंहोनापायाजाताहै।The humane human has all three righteous motives apparent in the form of humane propensity or tendencies, and their perspective is aligned with justice, along with dharma and truth. Their essential nature has been recognised in the form of fortitude, courage and generosity. Humans with such propensity, tendencies, essential nature, and perspective are recognised as awakened humans. They possess knowledge of comprehensive resolution, and in order to implement it they remain engaged in expressing in limited ways especially the righteous motives of progeny-motive and wealth-motive. In this way, they express use & right-use, and purposeful-use remains in them as an expectation. Thus, expressing and evidencing as deific-human and divine-human is a need in them. ●​पूर्वानुक्रमअनुभूतिमें, निहितक्रियाकेरूपमें, विकसितकासंकेतग्रहणकरनाहै, जिससेविकासकीओरप्रवृत्ति, प्रयासएवम्उद्देश्यकारहनापरमआवश्यकहै।Realisation in higher-conformance is inherently the activity of the reception of signals from the developed, for which it is absolutely necessary to have a tendency, endeavour, and objective towards awakening. ●​हरमानवजागृतिशीलहैअथवाजागृतहोनाचाहताहै।हरमानवयोगपूर्वकहीजागृतहोताहै।जागृतिकेलिएहीवहआतुर, कातुर, आकुल, व्याकुल, आवेशितअथवाउद्विग्नरहताहै।Every human is awakening-oriented i.e. they desire to be awakened. This awakening is achieved through yog only. Humans are impatient, impetuous, distressed, anxious, agitated and restless only in their quest for awakening.

○​आतुर :- पात्रतासेअधिकइच्छाप्रगटकरनेकाप्रयास।Impatient (aatur): - Trying to express more desire than one's receptivity. ○​कातुर :- वाँछितइच्छापूर्तिकेलिएशीघ्रतासेकार्यरतहोनाजिसमेंकुशलता, निपुणताऔरपाण्डित्यकाअभावहो।Impetuous (kaatur): - Quickly taking action to satisfy the desired awakening, despite lacking the necessary skill, proficiency, and scholarliness. ○​आकुल :- वाँछितकेअभावकीपीड़ाकाअनुभव।

page-304

Distressed (aakul): - Feeling the pain from lack of desired awakening. ○​व्याकुल :- वाँछितकीपीड़ासेभरजाना।Anxious (vyakul): - Becoming full of pain from lack of desired awakening. ○​उद्विग्न :- वाँछितक्रियामेंअप्रत्याशितगति।Restless (udvign): - Unexpected movement towards desired awakening. ○​आवेश :- अतिक्रमणयाआक्रमणसेप्राप्तदबावहीआवेशहै।Agitation (avesh): - The pressure from encroachment or attack itself is agitation. ○​विधिवत्आचरण :- धर्मनीतिएवंराज्यनीतिसम्मतव्यवहार।Legitimate conduct (vidhivat acharan): - Behaviour that is aligned with Moral policy and State policy.

●​आस्वादनएवंअनुभूतिकेलिएहीमानवद्वाराविभिन्नसभीपक्षोंकाअनुसंधान, संधान, प्रयोगवव्यवसाय, अभ्यासतथाआविष्कारकियागयाहै।Humans have engaged in exploration, innovation, experimentation, vocation, practice and invention in various dimensions, for taste and realisation only.

○​आस्वादन :- जोजिसमेंनहींहोयाकमहोऔरउसेपानेकीइच्छाहो, ऐसीस्थितिमेंउसकीउपलब्धिसेप्राप्तप्रभावपूर्णक्रियाकी, जिसमेंतृप्तियातृप्तिकीप्रत्याशाअवश्यहो, ‘आस्वादन’ संज्ञाहै।Taste (asvadan): - That which is lacking or insufficient in one, and one has desire to attain it, the effectful activity resulting from its accomplishmen, wherein there is satisfaction or at least its anticipation, is referred to as ‘taste’.

●​कामना-जन्यक्षुधातथातृषा, रागद्वेषात्मकआवेशजन्यकामऔरक्रोध, मनआशितचारविषयतथालोभयहभ्रमितमानवकीविवशताएँहैं।जागृतविचारोंसेपोषितव्यवहारएवंतीनऐषणाएँ, चिंतनसेप्रस्तुतकलाएवंसाहित्य, बोधपूर्वकप्रस्तुततात्विकतातथासमाधान, जागृतमानवकेद्वाराउद्घाटितहुआहै।

Hunger & thirst generated from desire, lust & anger generated from agitation of passion or malice, the four instincts & greed from hope of mun - these are compulsions of deluded humans. Behaviour & three righteous motives nurtured by awakened thoughts, art & literature presented with contemplation, existentiality & resolution presented with enlightenment - these have been unfolded by awakened humans.

page-305

●​संसारकेसमस्तक्रियाकलापव्यापकसत्ताकीअनुभूति, विकसितकेसान्निध्यऔरअविकसितकेआस्वादनकेलियेहै।All activities of the world are for realisation of the omnipresent Omnipotence, proximity of the developed (awakened), and taste of the undeveloped (material nature). ●​सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवहीसर्वमानवकाईष्टहै।अनुभवकेफलनमेंसहअस्तित्वमेंतद्रूपता, तादात्म्यताहोनास्वाभाविकहै।ऐसेतादात्म्यमानवत्वसंपन्नमानवहीदेवमानव, दिव्यमानवकोटिमेंहोतेहैं।ऐसेमानवकेतत्सान्निध्यएवंतदावलोकनहोनाजागृतमानवपरंपरामेंभावीहै।इससेस्पष्टहुआकिचरमविकासऔरजागृतिवअभिव्यक्तिप्रमाणसदा-सदामानवपरंपरामेंहोनाहीसौभाग्यहै।The ideal for all humans is the realisation in coexistence, which naturally leads to absolute-accordance and absolute-oneness in coexistence. Humans who embody this absolute-oneness as human-ness attain the category of deific-human and divine-human. Absolute-connectedness and absolute-observance with such individuals occur naturally in the awakened human tradition. Thus, the permanent presence of the evidence of the highest development and awakening in human tradition itself is universal wellbeing. ●​भ्रमितमानवजागृतिक्रमसेजबजागृतहोताहै, तबजागृतिईष्टहोनेकेआधारपरजोभ्रमात्मकगुणस्वभावरहाहैवहशनै: शनै: विलयहोजाताहै।फलत: जागृतिमेंतद्रूपताकोजीवनप्रमाणितकरताहै।जोमानवपरंपरामेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।भ्रमितअवस्थामेंअधिमूल्यन, अवमूल्यन, निर्मूल्यनकोमूल्यमानेरहतेहैं, वहपूर्णतयाजागृतहोकर, जीवनमूल्य, मानवमूल्य, स्थापितमूल्य, शिष्टमूल्यऔरउपयोगितावकला(सुंदरता) मूल्यकोपहचाननाबनजाताहै।यहीतादात्म्यताकाप्रमाणहै।यहीतत्सान्निध्यताहै।सहअस्तित्वनित्यसान्निध्यहै।जागृतिकीनिरंतरताहीतदावलोकनहै।जागृतिमेंतादात्म्यताहीभ्रमकासमापनहै।भ्रमकासमापनकातात्पर्यजागृतिकेउपरांतअपने-आपभ्रमकापूर्णतयाप्रभावशून्यहोजानेसेहै।When a deluded human progresses towards awakening, then on the basis of their ideal being awakening, their delusive properties and nature gradually disappear. As a result, jeevan evidences absolute-accordance with awakening, which manifests in human tradition. In the deluded state, one considers over-evaluation, under-evaluation, and mis-evaluation to be values. However, after awakening, one recognises jeevan values, human values, established values, civic values, and the usefulness & aesthetics value. This itself is the evidence of absolute-oneness and absolute-connectedness. Coexistence is eternally proximate. The continuity of awakening itself is absolute-observance. Absolute-oneness in awakening marks the end of delusion, meaning the effect of delusion becomes nil on its own after awakening.

○​ईष्टकेगुण, स्वभाव, धर्मसेपूर्णतयाप्रभावितहोजानाहीतद्रूपताहै।स्वमूल्यकाईष्टकेमूल्यमेंविलीनीकरणहीतादात्मयताहै।ईष्टकाआश्रयभावहीतत्सान्निध्यहै।ईष्टकादर्शनमिलतेरहनाहीतदावलोकनहै।जागृतिहीमानवकाईष्टहै।तद्रूपता, तादात्मयता, तत्सान्निध्यताएवं

page-306

तदावलोकनहीविकसितकीअनुभूतिकाअंतिमलक्ष्यएवंउपलब्धिहै।Absolute-accordance is nothing but becoming completely affected by the properties, essential nature, and dharma of the ideal. Absolute-oneness is the merging of one's own-value into the ideal's value. Being in the refuge of the ideal is absolute-connectedness, while continuously perceiving the ideal is absolute-observance. Awakening itself is the ideal of humans. The final goal and accomplishment of realisation of the ideal is absolute-accordance, absolute-oneness, absolute-connectedness, and absolute-observance. ●​जागृतिपूर्वकहीमानवमेंप्रमाणसहितमूल्योंकीअभिव्यक्ति, संप्रेषणा, प्रकाशनहोताहैऔरइसकीनिरंतरतामानवपरंपरामेंबनाहीरहताहै।यहीप्रेमवभक्तिहै।

It is upon awakening that the expression, communication, and exposition of values, with evidence, occur within humans, and its continuity is maintained within human tradition. This itself is love and devotion. ●​दया, कृपा, करुणाकीसंयुक्तअभिव्यक्तिहीप्रेमहै।जिसकाहरजागृतमानवमें, सेप्रमाणितहोनास्वाभाविकहै।यहतदावलोकनमेंपायीजानेवालीशीर्षकोटिकीउपलबिॅधवअनुभूतिहै।The combined expression of kindness, grace, and compassion itself is love, which is naturally evident in every awakened human. It is the pinnacle of achievement and realisation found in the state of absolute-observance. ●​व्यापकतामेंअनुभूतिसेप्राप्तआप्लावनसे (प्रभाववप्रवाह) बुद्धि, चित्त, वृत्तिएवंमनपर्यन्तप्रभावशीलहै।इसआप्लावनकोबुद्धिकेस्तरपरआनंद, चित्तकेस्तरपरसंतोष, वृत्तिकेस्तरपरशांतितथामनकेस्तरपरसुखसंज्ञाहै।यहअनुभूतिहीइकाईकाचरमोत्कर्षहै।

Buddhi, chitta, vritti, and mun are affected from immersion (as effect and flow) attained by realisation in Omnipresence. This immersion is referred to as bliss at the level of buddhi, contentment at the level of chitta, peace at the level of vritti, and happiness at the level of mun. This realisation itself is the highest achievement in jeevan. ●​सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभूतिआत्माकरतीहै, तभीबुद्धिकाप्रत्यावर्तनसंभवहोताहै।Atma realises in coexistence, only then the reflection of buddhi becomes possible. ●​मनकाप्रत्यावर्तनवृत्तिमें, वृत्तिकाप्रत्यावर्तनचित्तमें, चित्तकाप्रत्यावर्तनबुद्धिमें, बुद्धिकाप्रत्यावर्तनआत्मामेंएवंआत्माकाप्रत्यावर्तनव्यापकसत्तामेंहोताहै।

The reflection of mun occurs in vritti, of vritti in chitta, of chitta in buddhi, of buddhi in atma, and the reflection of atma occurs in the omnipresent Omnipotence. ●​प्रत्यावर्तनहीजागृतिकाकारणहै।

page-307

Reflection itself is the cause of awakening.

●​मानवमेंजागृतिज्ञान, विवेक, विज्ञानपूर्वकहीहैजिसेबौद्धिकपक्षकहतेहैं।जोमानवीयतातथाअतिमानवीयतासहजहै।Awakening in humans is only through knowledge, wisdom & science which is referred to as the intellectual aspect. It pertains to humaneness and higher humaneness. ●​जागृतमानवमेंमध्यस्थव्यवहार, विचारवअनुभवपायाजाताहै।An awakened human is with mediative behaviour, thought, and realisation. ●​मध्यस्थव्यवहार ​:- न्यायपूर्णव्यवहार।Mediative behaviour: - Just behaviour. ●​मध्यस्थविचार :- धर्मपूर्णविचार।Mediative thought: - Dharma based thoughts. ●​मध्यस्थअनुभव ​:- सहअस्तित्वरूपीपरमसत्य।Mediative realisation: - Ultimate truth in the form of coexistence. ●​न्यायपूर्णव्यवहारहीमानवीयतापूर्णव्यवहारहै।मानवीयतापूर्णव्यवहारसेतात्पर्यहैमानवीयताकेप्रतिनिर्विरोधपूर्णव्यवहारजिसकोसमझनावसमझानाअखंडमानवसमाजकीदृष्टिसेआवश्यकहै।इसकेलिएअध्ययनवशिक्षाआवश्यकहै।Just behaviour itself is humane behaviour. Humane behaviour means unresisting behaviour towards humaneness. Understanding it and imparting its understanding is essential from the perspective of undivided human society. Study and education are necessary for this. ●​शिक्षणएवंप्रशिक्षणद्वाराकेवलव्यवसायकाज्ञानकरायाजाताहैयहमात्रभौतिकसमृद्धिकेलियेसहायकहुआहै।Only vocational knowledge is imparted through teaching and training, which has been helpful for material prosperity only. ●​मानवीयताऔरअतिमानवीयताकावर्गीकरणएवंपुष्टिमानवकेसाथकिएगयेव्यवहारसेहीसिद्धहुईहै, जिसकेलिएअध्ययनतथादीक्षाआवश्यकहै।

page-308

Humaneness and higher humaneness have been classified and validated only with respect to behaviour with humans, for which study and ordination are necessary.

○​दीक्षाअनुभवमूलकविधिसे :- सुनिश्चितव्यवहारपद्धतिवआचरणपद्धतिबोधकी ‘दीक्षा’ संज्ञाहै, जोव्रतहै, जिसकीविश्रृंखलतानहींहै, अथवाजिसमेंअवरोधनहींहै।Ordination by realisation-based way: - Ordination refers to accepting a specific method of behaviour and conduct, which is a pledge, which has no discontinuity or obstruction.

●​मानवकेआहार, विहार, व्यवहारवव्यवस्थामेंभागीदारीसेहीउसकेव्यक्तित्वकामूल्यांकनहोताहै।The evaluation of a human's personality is by their food, lifestyle, behaviour, and participation in the orderliness.

○​व्यक्तित्व :- स्वयंमेंनिहितप्रतिभा-प्रसारणकेक्रममेंसहायकआहार, विहारवव्यवहारकी ‘व्यक्तित्व’ संज्ञाहै।Personality (vyaktitva): - The food, lifestyle, and behaviour that are conducive to exhibiting one's talent, is referred to as ‘personality’.

○​व्यवहारकाईष्ट-अनिष्ट, उत्थान-पतन, विकास-ह्रास, उचित-अनुचित, लाभ-हानि, न्याय-अन्याय, पुण्य-पाप, विधि-निषेध, कर्त्तव्य-अकर्त्तव्य, समाधान-समस्या, आवश्यक-अनावश्यक, भेद-प्रभेदसेतुलनात्मकअध्ययनकियाजाताहै।व्यक्तिकामूल्यांकनउसकेचैतन्यपक्षकीप्रतिभाकाहीमूल्यांकनहै, क्योंकिचैतन्यइकाईद्वाराहीजड़पक्षकाचालन, संचालन, प्रतिचालन, परिपालन, परिपोषण, मूल्यांकन, परिवर्धनवपरिवर्तनकीक्रियाकासंपादनहुआहै, जोउसीकीइच्छावविचारकापूर्वरूपहै।

The comparative study of behaviour is carried out through the distinctions of ideal and non-ideal, rise and fall, development and decline, appropriate and inappropriate, profit and loss, justice and injustice, virtue and sin, lawful and unlawful, duty and non-duty, resolution and problem, necessary and unnecessary, and distinction and sub-distinction. The evaluation of an individual is, in fact, the evaluation of the capability of the sentient aspect, because it is the sentient unit that drives, steers, balances, complies, nourishes, evaluates, enhances, and changes the material aspect, and the root of these actions lies in the sentient aspect's desire and thought. ○​ईष्ट :- प्रयोजनशीलवसार्थकइच्छाकेअनुकूलमानवीयतापूर्णवअतिमानवीयतासहजउपलब्धि।समाधानसमृद्धिअभयसहअस्तित्वसहजज्ञान, विवेक, विज्ञानहै।Ideal (isht): - The accomplishment of humaneness and higher humaneness according to purposeful and meaningful desire. Resolution, prosperity, fearlessness and coexistence according to knowledge, wisdom and science.

page-309

○​अनिष्ट :- प्रयोजनशीलवसार्थकइच्छाकेप्रतिकूलउपलब्धि।Non-ideal (anisht): - The result contrary to purposeful and meaningful desire. ○​उत्थान :- मानवीयताकीओरगति।Rise (utthan): - Movement towards humaneness. ○​पतन :- अमानवीयताकीओरगति।Fall (patan): - Movement towards inhumaneness. ○​ह्रास :- अधिकमूल्यनसेन्यूनमूल्यनकीओरपरिणाम।Decline (hras): - Change of state from higher-value to lower-value.

○​विकास :- न्यूनमूल्यसेअधिकमूल्यकीओरपरिणाम।Development (vikas): - Change of state from lower-value to higher-value. ○​शोषण :- भ्रमवशकियागयाकार्य-व्यवहार।Exploitation (shoshan): - The work and behaviour done due to delusion. ○​पोषण :- मानवीयता, अतिमानवीयतासहजपरंपरा।Nurturing (poshan): - The tradition of humaneness and higher humaneness. ○​अनुचित :- समय, परिस्थितितथाघटनाओंकेसंदर्भमेंमानवीयतायाअतिमानवीयताकाशोषण, विरोध।Inappropriate (anuchit): - Resisting and hindering humaneness or higher humaneness as per prevailing time, situation and events. ○​उचित :- समय, परिस्थितितथाघटनाओंकेअनुसारमानवीयतायाअतिमानवीयताकापोषण।Appropriate (uchit): - Nurturing humaneness or higher humaneness as per prevailing time, situation and events. ○​लाभ :- कमवस्तुवसेवाकेबदलेमेंअधिकवस्तुवसेवाकापाना।Profit (labh): - Getting more goods and services in exchange of less goods and services.

page-310

○​हानि :- अधिकवस्तुवसेवाकेबदलेमेंकमवस्तुवसेवाकापाना।Loss (hani): - Getting less goods and services in exchange for more goods and services. ○​न्याय :- मानवीयताकेपोषणकेलिएसंपादितक्रियाकलापवव्यवहार।संबंधोंकीपहचान, मूल्योंकानिर्वाह, मूल्यांकन, उभयतृप्तिहीन्यायहै।Justice (nyaya): - The activities and behaviour for nurturing humaneness. Recognising relationships, fulfilling values, evaluating, and achieving mutual satisfaction is justice. ○​अन्याय :- मानवीयताकेविपरीतशोषणकेलिएकियागयाक्रियाकलापवव्यवहारतथाअमानवीयतावशक्रियाकलापवव्यवहारहीअन्यायहै।Injustice (anyaya): - The activities and behaviour contrary to humaneness and aimed at exploitation, stemming from inhumaneness, is injustice. ○​पुण्य :- मानवीयतातथाअतिमानवीयतापूर्णव्यवहार।Virtue (punya): - Behaviour of humaneness and higher humaneness. ○​पाप :- अमानवीयतावादीव्यवहार।Sin (paap): - Inhumane behaviour. ○​विधि :- सामाजिकता, मानवीयता, अखण्डसमाजसार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकीसंरक्षणपोषणवादीनीति, कार्यव्यवहार।Lawful (vidhi): - Policies, work and behaviour that nurture and protect sociality, humaneness, and undivided society universal orderliness. ○​निषेध :- सामाजिकताकीशोषणवादीनीति, अमानवीयकार्यव्यवहार।जीवचेतनावशकियागयासमस्तकार्यव्यवहारविचार।Unlawful (nishedh): - Policies that are exploitative of sociality, and inhumane work & behaviour. All work, behaviour, and thought due to animal consciousness. ○​कर्त्तव्य :- प्रत्येकस्तरपरप्राप्तसंबंधएवंसंपर्ककेमध्यनिहितमानवीयतापूर्णआशावप्रत्याशापूर्वकव्यवहार।संबंधोंकीपहचान, मूल्योंकानिर्वाह।Duty (kartavya): - The behaviour for fulfilling the hopes and expectations of

page-311

humaneness inherent in relationships and associations at all levels. Recognising relationships and fulfilling values.

○​अकर्त्तव्य :- प्रत्येकस्तरपरप्राप्तसंबंधएवंसंपर्ककेमध्यनिहितमानवीयतापूर्णआशावप्रत्याशाकानिर्वाहनकरनेकेस्थानपरअमानवीयतावादीआचरणअकर्तृत्वहै।Non-duty (akartavya): - Instead of fulfilling hopes and expectations for humaneness inherent in relationships and associations at every level, engaging in inhumane conduct is called undutiful. ○​समाधान :- प्रत्येकक्रियाकेलिएपरिशिष्टएवंपरिमार्जितपद्धतिकेअनुसरणमेंस्थितिसत्य, वस्तुगतसत्यएवंवस्तुस्थितिकाज्ञानतथासही, क्यों, कैसेकाउत्तर, समाधान।Resolution (samadhan): - Resolution is to have the knowledge of absolute truth, objective truth, and relative truth by following a definite and refined method, and having the right answer of how and why for every activity.

○​समस्या :- पशुमानव, राक्षसमानवकाकार्यव्यवहार।समाधानकेविपरीतमेंसमस्या।Problem (samasya): - The work and behaviour of animalistic and demonic humans. The problem is lack of resolution. ○​आवश्यक :- मानवीयतातथाअतिमानवीयताकीओरप्रगति।Necessary (avashyak): - Progress towards humaneness and higher humaneness. ○​अनावश्यक :- अमानवीयताकीओरगति।Unnecessary (anavashyak): - Movement towards inhumaneness. ○​चालन :- त्वरणन।Driving (chalan): - To move. ○​संचालन :- संगठितरूपसेपूर्णताकेअर्थमेंचालन, विधिवतचालन।Steering (sanchalan): - To drive towards completeness in a coordinated way, disciplined driving. ○​प्रति-संचालन :- संतुलितरूपमेंत्वरणन।Balancing (prati-sanchalan): - To move with stability.

page-312

○​प्रतिपालन :- जीवनमेंव्यतिक्रमकानिवारण।न्याय, धर्म, सत्यप्रतीतहोनेकेअर्थमेंपालन।Regulating (pratipalan): - Removing the obstacles in living. Adherence towards understanding of justice, dharma and truth. ○​परिपालन :- परम्पराकेअर्थमेंपालन।Adherence (paripalan): - Follow the tradition. ○​परिपोषण :- जीवन-क्रमकोजागृतिसहजनिरंतरताप्रदानकरना।Nourishing (pariposhan): - Sustaining the continuity of awakening in jeevan. ○​परिवर्धन :- जीवनकेक्रिया-कलापमेंजागृतिकेलिएसहयोग।Enhancing (parivardhan): - Being helpful for awakening in the jeevan’s activities. ○​चित्त-परिवर्तन :- मनाकारमेंउन्नतोचित्तस्फूर्तहोना।Changing (parivartan): - The mind’s positively getting engaged in materialising ideas. ●​खनिज, वनस्पतिएवंजीवकाउपयोगएवंसदुपयोगप्राकृतिकएवंवैकृतिकभेदसेमानवकरताहै।Human beings use and right-use minerals, vegetation, and animals in natural and artificial ways.

○​वैकृतिक :- उपयोगिताकेअर्थमेंमनाकारकोसाकारकरना।Human-made (vaikrutik): - Materialise ideas in terms of usefulness.

●​संवेदन, संवहन, संरक्षण, संबोधन, संवर्तनतथाप्रत्यावर्तनक्रियाचैतन्यपक्षकीविशिष्टताहै, जोजड़मेंनहींपायीजाती।Sensing, enquiring, protecting, enlightening, adhering, and reflecting are specialties of the sentient aspect that are not found in the insentient.

○​संवेदना :- पाँचोंज्ञानेंद्रियोंवकर्मेंद्रियोंकाज्ञानअथवाविकासकेप्रतिप्रवृत्ति।Sensing (samvedan): - Knowledge of the five cognitive organs and the five work organs. It also refers to the tendency for development (awakening).

page-313

○​संवहन :- पूर्णताकेअर्थमेंजिज्ञासाओंकावहन।अथवापूर्णताकेअर्थमेंवहनशीलता।Enquiring (samvahan): - The act of bearing inquiries for knowledge of completeness. ○​संरक्षण :- विकासकेलिएमार्गप्रशस्तकरना।Protecting (sanrakshan): - Paving the way towards development (awakening). ○​संबोधन :- यथार्थ-बोधन।Enlightening (sambodhan): - Imparting knowledge and understanding of reality. ○​संवर्तन :- परिमार्जनएवंपरिपूर्णताकेलियेप्राप्तसंकेतकेअनुसरणक्रियाकीसम्वर्तनसंज्ञाहै।Adhering (samvartan): - The act of following the received signals towards refinement and completeness. ○​प्रत्यावर्तन:- जागृतिसहजगतिशीलता।Reflection (pratyavartan): - Movement of awakening. ●​मानवजागृतिक्रमएवंजागृतिकेअनुसारपशुमानव, राक्षसमानव, मानव, देवमानव, दिव्यमानवकेरूपमेंदृष्टिगतहोताहै।Humans are perceived in the form of animalistic-human, demonic-human, humane-human, deific-human, and divine-human according to the awakening progression and awakening.

○​मानव, देवमानव, दिव्यमानवरूपमेंजागृतिपरंपराहै।The tradition of awakening is in the form of humane-humans, deific-humans, and divine-humans. ●​मानवजागृतिमेंचैतन्यपक्षकासंस्कारऔरशरीरऔरजीवनकेसंयुक्तरूपमेंसंस्कृतिएवंसभ्यतामेंहीगण्यहै।यहमानवपरंपरामेंप्रमाणितहोताहै।The sanskar in sentient aspect itself manifests as culture and civilisation in humans as a joint form of jeevan and body. This becomes evident in human tradition.

○​संस्कृति :- पूर्णताकेअर्थमेंकार्य-व्यवहार।क्रियापूर्णताएवंआचरणपूर्णताकेअर्थमेंकियागयाकृतियाँ।:- अखंडसमाजकेअर्थमेंकृतियाँ।

page-314

:- जागृतव्यक्तियाव्यक्तियोंकीअखण्डसमाजसार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकेअर्थमेंअभिव्यक्ति,

संप्रेषणा, प्रकाशन।Culture (sanskruti): - The work and behaviour towards completeness. The acts towards activity completeness and conduct completeness. : - The acts towards undivided society. : - The expression, communication and exposition by awakened individuals towards the undivided society universal orderliness.

○​सभ्यता :- सार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकेअर्थमेंप्रमाणितहोना।यहीसार्वभौमव्यवस्थाकेअर्थमेंअभिव्यक्तिहै।

:- मानवीयतापूर्णव्यवहारकीसभ्यतासंज्ञाहै।Civilisation (sabhyata): - Evidencing for the universal orderliness. This itself is the expression for the universal orderliness. : - Humane behaviour is referred to as civilisation.

●​चैतन्यपक्षमेंजागृतिहीसंस्कारहै।यहसुसंस्कारहैएवंजीवचेतनावशभ्रमहीकुसंस्कारहै।सुसंस्कार :- मानवीयतापूर्णमानवद्वाराअखंडसमाजमें, से, केलिएकियागयाआवश्यकीयकार्यऔरआचरणसुसंस्कारहै।The awakening in the sentient aspect itself is sanskar. This is susanskar, while delusion due to animal consciousness itself is kusanskar. Susanskar: - The necessary work and behaviour by humane-humans in, by, and for the undivided society, is called susanskar.

●​समाजकीअखंडता, मानवीयतापूर्णआचरणपरनिर्भरकरतीहै।The undividedness of society depends on humane conduct. ●​मानवीयताकीप्रतिष्ठाव्यक्तिकेसंस्कार, समाजकीसंस्कृतिएवंसभ्यतातथासमाजगठनकेमूलमेंपाईजानेवालीविधिएवंव्यवस्थापरनिर्भरकरतीहै।The establishment of humaneness depends on sanskar in the individual, culture & civilisation in society, and the way & orderliness at the root of the structure of the society. ●​मानवीयतातथाअतिमानवीयतासेसम्पन्नहोनेकेलिएसहअस्तित्वमेंसंकल्प, इच्छावविचारकापरिष्कृतहोनाआवश्यकहै, जोसुसंस्कारहीहै।The refinement of resolve, desire and thought in coexistence is necessary for attaining humaneness and higher-humaneness, which itself is susanskar.

page-315

●​सुसंस्कारकेलियेवातावरणएवंअध्ययनहीप्रधानकारणहैएवंसहायकभीहै।इसकोेसुरक्षिततथापरिमार्जितकरनेकादायित्वमनीषियोंपरनिर्भरहै।न्यायपूर्णव्यवहारतथाअखण्डसामाजिकताकीप्रेरणासुसंस्कारोंकेवर्धनमेंसहायकहै।The environment and study are the main causes and assistance for susanskar. The responsibility for protecting and refining it rests on the wise humans. The inspiration of just behaviour and the undivided society are helpful in the growth of susanskar. ●​न्यायपूर्णव्यवहारपक्ष, समाधानपूर्णविचारपक्षतथासत्यानुभूतिपूर्णअनुभवपक्षकोभाषाद्वाराबोधगम्य, ज्ञानगम्यतथाव्यवहारगम्यबनानेकाप्रयासअनुभवशीलमानवअथवाजागृतिसहजवृत्तिसंपन्नव्यक्तिद्वाराकियाजाताहै।

The endeavour of making the just behaviour aspect, resolved thoughts aspect, and realisation in truth aspect understandable, knowable and practicable through language is done by the realised humans and by the persons with awakened vritti.

○​सहजता :- व्यवहार, विचारएवंअनुभवकीएकसूत्रताहीसहजताहै।Effortlessness (sahajta): - The integrality of behaviour, thought, and realisation itself is effortlessness. ○​सहज-वृत्ति :- सहजताप्राप्तमनीषियोंकीवृत्तिकोही ‘सहज-वृत्ति’ कीसंज्ञाहै।Awakened vritti (sahaj vritti): - The tendency of wise humans with effortlessness is referred to as ‘awakened vritti’.

○​न्यायपूर्णव्यवहार :- सत्यसहजभास, संबंध, मूल्य, मूल्यांकन, उभयतृप्ति।Just Behaviour (nyaya poorna vyavhar): - The perception of truth; relationships, values, evaluation, and mutual satisfaction.

○​समाधानपूर्णविचार :- सत्यसहजआभास।Resolved thoughts (samadhan poorna vichar): - The comprehension of truth. ○​चिंतन :- सत्यसहजप्रतीति।Contemplation (chintan): - The awareness of truth. ○​ज्ञानानुभूति :- सहअस्तित्वरूपीपरमसत्यमेंअनुभूति।Realisation in knowledge (gyan-anubhuti): - Realisation in the ultimate truth which is in the form of coexistence.

page-316

●​ज्ञानानुभूतिकेलिएसहअस्तित्वरूपीईष्टकेप्रतिनिर्भ्रमज्ञान, अनन्यता, अनुरागतथाप्रेमकेयोग्यक्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रताकाहोनाअनिवार्यहै, जोसाधककेन्यायपूर्णव्यवहार, समाधानपूर्णविचारसेतथाकिसीअनुभवपूर्णमानवकेआज्ञापालनमेंपूर्णनिष्ठासेसिद्धहै।To attain the realisation in knowledge, it is mandatory to have the capacity, ability and receptivity for delusion-less knowledge, non-otherness, devotedness, and love towards the ideal in the form of coexistence. This is achieved by the seeker through just behaviour, resolved thoughts, and full dedication in obedience to a realised human being.

○​निर्भ्रमज्ञान :- जोजैसाहै, उसकोवैसाहीजाननावसमझना, समझाना।delusion-less knowledge (nirbhram gyan): - Knowing, understanding and imparting the understanding of the realities the way they are. ○​अनन्यता :- निर्भ्रमज्ञानकीनिरंतरता।Non-otherness (ananyata): - Continuity of delusion-less knowledge. ○​अनुराग ​:- ​अनन्यताकीनिरंतरता।:-​निभ्रमताकेलिएउत्कटप्रयासहीअनुरागहै।Devotedness (anurag): - Continuity of non-otherness.

: - Earnest endeavour for absence of delusion itself is devotedness. ○​प्रेम :- ​अनुरागसहितअनन्यताकीनिरंतरता।:- ​दया, कृपा, करूणासहजसंयुक्तअभिव्यक्ति।Love (prem): - Continuity of non-otherness along with devotedness. : - Combined expression of kindness, grace, and compassion.

●​प्रेमकीनिरंतरतासेहीमानवतद्रूपभावकोप्राप्तहोकरभ्रममुक्तिकाअधिकारीहोताहै।

Through the continuity of love, a human attains the state of absolute-accordance and becomes qualified for liberation from delusion. ●​अनादिकालसेव्यापकरूपीसत्ताहरइकाईकोसमानरूपमेंप्राप्तहैही, इसमेंअनुभूतिहीमानवकेलियेसान्निध्यानुभूतिहै।यहीमानवकालक्ष्यहै।Omnipotence in the form of omnipresence is uniformly inherent to every entity since eternity. Its realisation itself is absolute-connectedness for humans. This indeed is the goal of humans. ●​अनुभूतिकीस्थितिकोही ‘कैवल्य’ या ‘तादात्म्य’ अनुभूतिकीसंज्ञाहै, जिसमेंक्लेश, अमर्ष, भय, भ्रमबंधनमुक्तिहै।

page-317

The state of realisation itself is referred to as 'absoluteness' or 'absolute-oneness', which entails liberation from suffering, resentment, fear, and the bondage of delusion. ●​आत्मासहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभूतहोतेहीबुद्धि, चित्त, वृत्तिऔरमनपरउसमहिमाकीप्रसारण-क्रियाबिंब-प्रतिबिंब-अनुबिंब-न्यायसेप्रभावसम्पन्नहोतीहै।

As atma realises in coexistence, that magnificence is transmitted to buddhi, chitta, vritti, and mun through the process of mirroring. ●​चैतन्यइकाईकाअधिकतमविकसितअंशआत्माहीहै, क्योंकिहरअवस्थाकेपरमाणुमेंमध्यांश, मध्यस्थक्रियामेंव्यस्तहैऔरअन्यसभीअंगसमयाविषमक्रियामेंव्यस्तपाएजातेहैं।Atma itself is the most developed particle of the sentient unit because, in the atoms of every kind, the nucleus is constantly engaged in mediative activity, while all the other particles are engaged in generative and degenerative activity. ●​समझदारीकीआंशिकतामेंक्रिया, क्रियाकीआंशिकतामेंभोग, भोगकेअनुपातमेंइंद्रियानुभवऔरइसकेअतिरिक्तअनुमानकेकारणज्ञानवर्धनसंपन्नहुआहै।मूलमेंपूर्णज्ञानव्यंजनाकाअधिकारआत्मामेंहै।A part of understanding manifests into action, a part of action manifests into sensory enjoyment. The sensory experience is in proportion to the sensory enjoyment, and inference beyond sensory experience is the cause of enhancement in knowledge. At its core, the impressionability for complete knowledge resides within the atma.

○​व्यंजना :- अनुभवक्रियाकाप्रभावशील, क्षमताअथवाप्रभावक्षेत्र।Impression (vyanjana): - The capacity of affecting realisation activity or its field. ●​अज्ञान, आलस्य, अत्याशा, आक्रोश, आवेश, प्रलोभन, अभाववरोगपक्षहीदु:खकाकारणहै।समस्तदु:खकामूलभ्रममेंहीहै।Only the aspects of ignorance, laziness, excessive expectation, outrage, agitation, temptation, deprivation, and disease are the causes of unhappiness. Delusion is at the root of all unhappiness. ●​ह्रासांशमेंस्थितइकाईकेलिएदोकारणहैं :- प्रथमहै, अजागृतितथाद्वितीयहै, शक्तिकाअपव्यय।There are two reasons for a human to be in a state of decline: the first is unawakening, and the second is the wastage of their powers. ●​अजागृतकोजागृतबनानाहीसामाजिकताकाएकमहत्वपूर्णउद्देश्यऔरकार्यक्रमहै।

page-318

One significant objective and program of sociality is to awaken the un-awakened.

○​जोजिसकोअधिकमूल्यवानमानताहै, उसीकेलिएवहअपने, तन, मनवधनकाव्ययकरताहै।ऐसीमूल्यांकनक्रियामनुष्यकेद्वारानिर्भ्रान्त, भ्रान्ताभ्रान्तऔरभ्रान्तअवस्थाभेदसेहोतीहैजिसकेकारणकुछमनुष्योंनेचारविषयों, कुछमनीषियोंनेतीनऐषणाओंकुछनिर्भ्रान्तमानवोंनेभ्रममुक्तिकोपरमावधिमूल्यांकितकियाहै।इसमूल्यांकनकेअनुरूपहीविभिन्नस्तरकेमनुष्योंद्वारासमस्तसाधनोंकानियोजनकियागयाहै।Humans tend to deploy their body, mind, and wealth to what they regard as more valuable. This evaluation activity happens based on one’s status with respect to awakening - i.e. delusion, discerning, and delusion-less. Deluded humans regard fulfilment of the four instincts as the most valuable, whereas some wise ones (discerning humans) regard the pursuit of the three righteous motives as the most valuable. Delusion-less humans regard liberation from delusion as the most valuable. Based on their evaluation only, humans at different statuses of awakening utilise all their means. ○​मानवकुलमेंनिहितवैविध्यताकानिराकरणकेवलन्यायपूर्णव्यवहारसमाधानपूर्णविचारनीतिसेसंभवहुआहै।The elimination of differences in humankind becomes possible only through the policy of just behaviour and resolved thoughts. ○​भ्रांतस्थितिसेकीगयीमूल्यांकनक्रियाकोआसक्ति, भ्रांताभ्रांतस्थितिसेकिएगएमूल्यांकनकीजागृतितथानिभ्रांतस्थितिसेकिएगएमूल्यांकनस्थितिकी ‘यथार्थ’ संज्ञाहै।The evaluation from the 'delusion' state is referred to as attachment, the evaluation from the 'discerning' state is referred to as awakening, and the evaluation from the 'delusion-less' state is referred to as reality. ○​यथार्थमूल्यांकनक्षमताहीदर्शनकीपूर्णता, दर्शनकीपूर्णताहीसंतुलन, पूर्णसंतुलनहीज्ञान, ज्ञानहीव्यापकतामेंअनुभूति, व्यापकमेंअनुभूतिहीनिर्भ्रमताऔरनिर्भ्रमतासेहीयथार्थमूल्यांकनक्रियानि:सृतहोतीहै।ऐसीइकाईमेंन्यायपूर्णव्यवहारऔरधर्मपूर्णविचारस्वभावकेरूपमेंपरिलक्षितहोताहै।The capacity of evaluating reality itself is completeness of worldview, completeness of worldview itself is balance, complete balance itself is knowledge, knowledge itself is realisation in Omnipresence, realisation in Omnipresence itself is absence of delusion, and from absence of delusion emerges the evaluation of reality. Just behaviour and dharma based thoughts is the essential nature of such humans.

●​अनुभवकेलिएसमझदारी, समझदारीकेलिएअनुभूति, इच्छाकेलिएसमझदारीऔरसमझदारीकेलिएइच्छा, इच्छाकेलिएक्रियाऔरक्रियाकेलियेइच्छा, उपयोगकेलियेक्रियाऔरक्रियाकेलिएउपयोग, क्रियाकेलिएउत्पादनऔरउत्पादनकेलिएक्रियाव्यस्तहै।

page-319

Realisation is engaged for understanding and understanding is engaged for realisation, understanding is engaged for desire and desire is engaged for understanding, desire is engaged for action and action is engaged for desire, action is engaged for utilisation and utilisation is engaged for action, utilisation is engaged for production and production is engaged for utilisation. ●​रूपक्रियाकीगणनाकाल, सम्वेग, वेग , विसर्जन, गुणवस्वभावकेअनुसारस्थूलवसूक्ष्मभेदसेहै, जोमानवकीसमझदारी (ज्ञान) बुद्धिमेंभाव, इच्छामेंप्रतिभाव, विचारमेंअनुभाव, मनसेप्रवृत्तियोंकेरूपमेंव्यक्तहोतीहै।

The evaluation of form activities at gross and subtle level is with respect to time, impetus, speed, lifetime, properties and essential nature - which as understanding (knowledge) of humans, manifest in the form of enlightenment in buddhi, reflective sentiment in chitta, resolution in vritti, and tendencies in mun. ●​सुरूपवकुरूपकेभेदसेरूप, जड़वचैतन्यकेभेदसेक्रिया, लोकवलोकेशकेभेदसेलक्ष्य, विषयवनिर्विषयव्यवस्थाकेभेदसेज्ञान, विधिवनिषेधकेभेदसेकर्म, सार्थकवनिरर्थकभेदसेभाषाहै।Form is differentiated as beautiful and ugly; activity as insentient and sentient; goal as worldly and spiritual; knowledge as instinctual and systemic; action as lawful and unlawful; and language as meaningful and meaningless.

●​अवस्थाभेदसेआसक्तिएवंसमाधान, आसक्तिएवंसमाधानभेदसेआवश्यकता, आवश्यकताभेदसेश्रम, श्रमभेदसेउत्पादन, उत्पादनभेदसेउपलब्धि, उपलब्धिभेदसेपरिणाम, परिणामभेदसेहीक्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रता; क्षमता, योग्यताएवंपात्रताभेदसेसहजात्मक, लोकात्मक (ईषणात्मक) औरविषयात्मकप्रवृत्तियाँतथाइनतीनोंअथवाइनकेमिश्रितबौद्धिकअवस्थामेंहीचित्रणकीअभिव्यक्तिकीसमर्थताहै।The differentiation of consciousness-level determines attachment and resolution; of attachment and resolution determines needs; of needs determines physical labour; of physical labour determines production; of production determines accomplishment; of accomplishment determines result; of result determines capacity, ability and receptivity; of capacity, ability and receptivity determines the spiritual, worldly (three righteous motives), and instincts-focused tendencies. The ability of expressing visualisation depends on these three tendencies and their combination on the consciousness-level. ●​सतर्कता, सजगता, सहजताप्राप्तमानवजीवनमेंविश्रामकातथालोकासक्तमानवजीवनमेंश्रमकाक्षोभहै।There is restfulness in human jeevan that has attained alertness, awareness, and effortlessness; and human jeevan that is attached to worldly desires has frustration of effort.

page-320

●​मानवनेअपनीक्षमता, योग्यताऔरपात्रताकेअनुसारसहजोन्मुखतामेंनित्यताका, लोकोन्मुखतामेंअमरत्वकाबोधऔरविषयोन्मुखतामेंअनित्यताकीस्वीकृतिकियाहै।सहजतामेंदिखावा, रहस्यतथाअविद्यावभ्रमकापूर्णविलयहोताहै।इसीलिएजागृतमानवविकारसेमुक्तहै।साथहीइसस्थितिमेंनिरंतरतृप्ति, समाधानऔरविश्रामकाअनुभवहै।Humans - based on their capacity, ability, and receptivity - have realised eternalness in spiritual-orientation, understood immortality in orderliness-orientation, and experienced impermanence in instincts-orientation. Effortlessness entails the complete dissolution of pretension, mystery, false learning, and delusion. Thus, awakened humans are devoid of flaws, along with this there is realisation of continuous satisfaction, resolution, and restfulness. ●​लोकेषणाहीश्रेष्ठऐषणाहै।देवमानवस्वयंकीजागृतिकोप्रमाणितकरनेकेअर्थमेंमानवीयपरंपराकापोषणऔरसम्वर्धनकेलिएजनबलवधनकानियोजनकरतेहैं।यहीयशकाकारणवस्वरूपहै, जिसकीसार्थकतामानवपरंपरामेंव्यवस्थासार्वभौमिकताकेरूपमेंहोनाहै।इसकेफलनमेंअखंडसमाजकाख्यातिहोनाआवश्यकहै।लोकेषणाअर्थात्जागृतमानवपरंपराकोलोकव्यापीकरणकरनेकेक्रममेंयशकास्वीकृतिहै।यशकातात्पर्य-जागृतिकीस्वीकृति, सहानुभूति, अनुकरणक्रियाहै।मानवीयताकेविरोधीजितनेभीकायिक, वाचिक, मानसिकक्रियाकलापहैउससेमुक्तरहनाहीयशहै।The reputation-motive is the most eminent of the three righteous motives. Deific-humans utilise their resources and relations to nurture and promote the humane tradition for evidencing their awakening. This itself is the reason and essential nature of reputation, whose actualisation is in the form of the universal orderliness and undivided society. It is about accepting reputation as a consequence of dissemination of awakening in the human tradition. Reputation means acceptance, understanding and emulation of awakening. Reputation is abstaining from all physical, verbal, and mental activities that are against humaneness.

○​चारोंविषयइंद्रियतृप्तिसेसीमितहै।स्थूलशरीरमात्रकीमृत्युनिश्चितहैइसलिएविषयोंसेप्राप्तसुखकीनिरंतरतानहींहै।All four instincts are in the purview of sensory gratification. Since death of the gross body is inevitable, there is no continuity of gratification from instincts.

●​मानवीयतापूर्णपरंपरासहजउद्देश्यसेप्रयास, प्रयासभेदसेसाधनोंकाउपयोग, सदुपयोग; उपयोग, सदुपयोगभेदसेफल; फलसेप्रयोजन; प्रयोजनसेउद्देश्यसफलहोनापायाजाताहै।यहीजागृतिपूर्णजीवनपरंपराचक्रहै।

Ascertaining the objective of humane tradition leads to endeavours; endeavours lead to use and right-use of resources; use and right-use of resources leads to consequence (as resolution); consequence leads to realisation of human purpose; and the realisation of human purpose leads to accomplishment of the objective of humane tradition. This is the cycle of completely awakened human tradition. ●​समस्तसाधनोंकीगणनाअंतरंगऔरबहिरंगभेदसेहै।

All the means can be categorised as external or internal.

○​बहिरंगसाधन :- शरीरवउससेउत्पन्नयाउत्पादितसमस्तवस्तुएँबहिरंगसाधनहैं।External means (bahirang sadhan): - External means include the body and everything produced by it. ○​अंतरंगसाधन :- मन, वृत्ति, चित्त, बुद्धिवउससेउत्पन्नसंकल्प, इच्छा, विचारवआशाअंतरंगसाधनहै।Internal means (antrang sadhan): - Mun, vritti, chitta and buddhi; and hope, thought, desire and resolve generated respectively from them are the internal means. ●​शरीरकासाध्यमन, मनकासाध्यवृत्ति, वृत्तिकासाध्यचित्त, चित्तकासाध्यबुद्धि, बुद्धिकासाध्यआत्माऔरआत्माकासाध्यसहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवसहजप्रमाणहै।

The body’s aim is mun, mun’s aim is vritti, vritti’s aim is chitta, chitta’s aim is buddhi, buddhi’s aim is atma, and atma’s aim is evidence of realisation in coexistence.

○​साध्य :- जिसकोपानाहै।Aim (sadhya): - That whose accordance is to be achieved. ○​साधन :- साध्यकोपानेहेतुआवश्यकप्रयुक्ति, उपायएवंवस्तु।Means (sadhan): - The necessary usage, solution and objects for achieving the aim. ○​साधक :- साध्यकोपानेहेतुसाधनकोजोप्रयुक्तकरताहै।Seeker (sadhak): - The one who uses the means for achieving the aim. ●​जिसकीजागृतिऔरतृप्तिशेषहै, उसेहीशेषजागृतिकोप्राप्तकरनेकेलियेसाधनकीआवश्यकताहै।

Only those whose awakening and satisfaction remains to be achieved, need the means to attain the remaining awakening. ●​आत्माकापूर्णविकास (ज्ञानकीपारदर्शकता) सहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभूतिमें, बुद्धिकापूर्णविकासआत्माकेसंकेतग्रहणसे, चितकापूर्णविकासबुद्धिकेसंकेतबोधकीसत्यसाक्षीमेंकलाकरणयोग्यक्षमतासे, वृत्तिकापूर्णविकासचित्तकेसंकेतग्रहणअर्थात्धर्मपूर्णविचारनिर्माणयोग्यतासेतथामनकापूर्णविकासवृत्तिकासंकेतग्रहणकरन्यायसम्मतव्यवहारपात्रताअर्जितकरनेसेहै।

The complete development of atma (as transparence of knowledge) is in the realisation in coexistence; the complete development of buddhi is by accepting signals of atma; the complete development of chitta is by attaining the capacity of creative visualisation according to the signals of buddhi in the presence of truth's realisation; the complete development of vritti is by accepting the signals of chitta, i.e. from the ability to generate thoughts of dharma; and the complete development of mun arises by acquiring the receptivity for just behaviour upon accepting the signals of vritti. ●​मन, वृत्ति, चित्त, बुद्धिवआत्माजीवनमेंअभिन्नहै।जीवनजागृतिकेस्थितिमें, जीवनपरंपरामेंप्रमाणितहोनेवालीविभूतियाँ ( क्रियाएँ) बलऔरशक्तिकेरूपमेंनिम्नहैं :- आत्मामेंदोविभूतियाँ, बुद्धिमेंचार, चित्तमेंसोलह, वृत्तिमेंछत्तीसवमनमेंस्थितिऔरगतिमेंंचौसठविभूतियाँ (क्रियाएँ) पायीजातीहै।उपरेाक्तसभीक्रियाओंकोहरव्यक्तिप्रमाणितकरसकताहै।इसप्रकारमानव (जीवन) मेंकुलस्थितिऔरगतिअर्थात्बलऔरशक्तिकेरूपमें 122 क्रियाएंपायीजातीहै।Mun, vritti, chitta, buddhi and atma are integral in jeevan. In awakened jeevan, its faculties or activities that become evident in the tradition in the form of strength & power or state & motion are as follows: atma has two faculties, buddhi has four, chitta has sixteen, vritti has thirty-six, and mun has sixty-four. Therefore, 122 activities are found in human jeevan in the form of strength & power, that is, in state & motion. Each person can demonstrate all of the above activities.

●​अनुभवऔरआनंदरूपीप्रमाणआत्मामें ; Evidence in the form of realisation and bliss occurs in atma; ●​अस्तित्वएवंपरमानंदआत्मस्थअनुभूतिहै।Existence and ultimate bliss is a realisation within atma.

○​अस्तित्व (अनुभव) :- नाशरहितगुण।नित्यवर्तमान।Realisation in existence (astitva anubhav): - The property of non-annihilation. Eternal presence. ○​परमानन्द (प्रामाणिकता) :- आत्माकीपारदर्शकताअथवासहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभूति।Ultimate bliss (paramanand): - The transparence of atma or realisation in coexistence. ○​आनंद :- मध्यस्थक्रियासहजपूर्ण-बोधयाआत्मबोध।Bliss (anand): - The complete enlightenment of mediative activity or atma-bodh.

○​धी :- निश्चयकीनिरंतरता।Dhee: - Continuity of definiteness. ○​अस्तित्व (बोध) :- ज्ञान-ग्रहणएवंप्रभावीकरणक्षमता।Enlightenment of existence (astitva bodh): - The capacity of accepting knowledge and its manifestation. ○​धृति :- भयकाअभाव।Dhruti: - The absence of fear.

○​श्रुति :- ​यथार्थरूपीज्ञान, विवेक, विज्ञानकाभाषाकरण।​यथार्थजानकारीकाभाषाकरण।Shruti: - Giving language to knowledge, wisdom and science in the form of reality.

Giving language to the knowledge of reality. ○​स्मृति :- बार-बारआवश्यकतानुसार, भाषापूर्वकसमझदारीकाप्रस्तुतीकरण।Smriti: - Presentation of understanding by way of language, as many times as necessary. ○​मेधा :- कलाकोधारणकरनेवालीक्रिया।Medha: - The activity that bears kala. ○​श्री :- समृद्धिकीस्वीकृति।Shree: - The acceptance of prosperity. ○​संतोष :- अभावकाअभाव।Contentment (santosh): - The lack of the sentiment of lacking. ○​कला :- उपयोगितायोग्यसुंदरक्रिया।Art (kala): - Activity of aesthetics with usefulness.

○​कान्ति :- अज्ञानकोक्षीणकरनेवालीप्रक्रिया।Radiance (kanti): - The process that uproots ignorance. ○​इच्छा :- वांछितएवंइप्सितकेप्रतिसजगता।Desire (ichchha): - Awareness about one's wishes and aspirations. ○​विद्या :- जोजैसाहै, उसकोवैसाहीस्वीकारकरना।Learning (vidya): - Accepting reality exactly as it is. ○​प्रज्ञा :- यथार्थकीपूर्णअनुमानसहितपूर्णस्वीकृतिक्रिया।Intelligence (pragya): - The activity of complete acceptance of reality along with mature inference. ○​कीर्ति :- विकासकीओरसक्रियता।Keerti: - The movement towards awakening. ○​विचार :- स्फुरणपूर्वकसत्यताकोउद्घाटितकरनेहेतुकीगईक्रिया।Thought (vichar): - The activity for unfolding verity with exuberance. ○​निश्चय :- सत्यतापूर्णविचारकीनिरंतरता।Certitude (nishchaya): - Continuity of truthful thoughts. ○​धैर्य :- न्यायपूर्णविचारकीनिरंतरता।Patience (dhairya): - Continuity of just thoughts. ○​शांति :- समाधानपूर्णविचार, व्यवहारमेंगतितहोना।Peace (shanti): - Behaviour based on resolved thoughts. ○​दया :- दूसरेकेविकासमेंहस्तक्षेपनकरना, सहायकहोना।Kindness (daya): - Not interfering in others' development, being helpful. ○​दम :- ह्रासकीओरजोआसक्तिहै, उसकीसमापनक्रिया।उत्थानकीओरप्रवृत्त।Uprightness (dum): - The end of attachment towards the decline (delusion).

Tendency towards upliftment (awakening). ○​कृपा :- दूसरेमानवकेजागृतिकेलियेसहायताअथवापात्रताअर्जितकरनेमेंसहायकहोना।Grace (krupa): - Being helpful for other human’s awakening or acquiring of receptivity. ○​करुणा :- जागृतिकेलिएउत्प्रेरितकरनाअथवाजागृतिकेलिएयोग्यताऔरपात्रताअर्जितकरनेमेंसहायकहोना।Compassion (karuna): - To inspire for awakening, or being helpful for acquiring ability and receptivity for awakening. ○​उत्साह :- जागृतिकेलियेप्रवृत्ति, उत्सव, सजगता।Enthusiasm (utsah): - Tendency for awakening; celebration; awareness. ○​कल्पना :- मान्यताकापूर्वरूप।Imagination (kalpana): - Prior form of belief. ○​भाव :- मूल्य, मूल्यांकन।Sentiment (bhav): - Value, evaluation. ○​श्रद्धा :- श्रेयकीओरगतिशीलता।Reverence (shraddha): - Movement towards righteousness. ○​क्षमा :- जागृतिकेलिएकीजानेवालीसहायताकेसमयउसकेह्रासपक्षसेअप्रभावितरहना।Forgiveness (kshama): - Remaining unaffected from other’s aspect of decline while helping them for awakening. ○​अनुराग :- निर्भ्रमज्ञानकीनिरंतरतामेंअनन्यता।Devotedness (anurag): - Non-otherness in the continuity of knowledge that is free from delusion. ○​जाति :- रूप, गुण, स्वभाववधर्मकीविशिष्टताएवंभौतिकता।Kind (jati): - The specificity and physicality of form, properties, essential nature and dharma.

●​मनकोजोप्रियहो, उसकेचुनावकीप्रकियाकीचयनसंज्ञाहै।मनमेंआस्वादनअपेक्षापूर्वकचयनहोताहै।The process of choosing what is pleasing to mun is referred to as selection, which occurs in expectation of taste.

●​चित्तसहजचित्रणकेआठक्रियायें - रूप, गुण, गणना, काल, विस्तार, श्रम, गति, परिणाम।The eight activities of visualisation in chitta: - form, property, count, time, expanse, effort, motion, result. ●​न्यायपूर्णव्यवहारतथाव्यवसायकेसमत्वमेंसहअस्तित्वतथासमृद्धि, शरीरतथाहृदयकेसमत्वमेंतृप्ति, हृदयतथाप्राणकेसमत्वमेंआरोग्यतथापुष्टि, प्राणएवंमनकेसमत्वमेंबलतथास्फूर्ति, मनववृत्तिकेसमत्वमेंसुख, वृत्तिवचित्तकेसमत्वमेंशांति, चित्तवबुद्धिकेसमत्वमेंसंतोष, बुद्धिवआत्माकेसमत्वमेंआनंदआत्मातथाव्यापकसत्तामेंनित्यसमत्वहैही।इसीलिएपरमानन्दसहजअनुभूतिवप्रमाणहै।

Concurrence in just behaviour and vocation entails coexistence and prosperity; concurrence in body and heart entails satisfaction; concurrence in heart and breathing entails health and growth; concurrence in breathing and mun entails strength and motivation; concurrence in mun and vritti entails happiness; concurrence in vritti and chitta entails peace; concurrence in chitta and buddhi entails contentment; concurrence in buddhi and atma entails bliss; and there is eternal concurrence between atma and Omnipresence, which entails realisation of ultimate bliss and its evidence. ●​परमानन्दसहजअनुभूतिहीमानवजीवनकाचरमलक्ष्यहै।परमानन्दसहअस्तित्वमेंअनुभवसहजवैभवहै।यहजागृतजीवनमेंसहजक्रियाऔरअभिव्यक्तिहै।The realisation of ultimate bliss is the highest goal of a human jeevan. Ultimate bliss is the grandeur of realisation in coexistence, which is the natural activity and expression in an awakened jeevan.

Cold/hot (sheet/ushna): - Nurturing/Depriving परिभाषा :- ​छ: प्रकारकीरुचियांजीभकेसंयोगमेंआईवस्तुचाहेतरल, विरल, ठोसक्योंनहो, परिणामस्वरूपहीपहचाननाहोताहै।हरजागृतमानवसंवेदनाओंकेप्रयोजनोंकास्वस्थशरीरकेप्रयोजनोंकेलिएपहचानेरहनास्वाभाविकरहताहै।The six types of tastes are recognised only as a result of contact of tongue with some object, be it solid, liquid or gaseous. Every awakened human recognises that the purpose of sensations is maintaining the health of the body. खट्टा ​ :- ​पोषण/शोषणSour (khatta): - Nourishing/Depleting मीठा :- ​पोषण/शोषणSweet (meetha): - Nourishing/Depleting चरपरा ​:- ​पोषण/शोषणPungent (charpara): - Nourishing/Depleting कड़ुवा ​ :- ​पोषण/शोषणBitter (kadua): - Nourishing/Depleting कसैला ​:- ​पोषण/शोषणAstringent (kasaila): - Nourishing/Depleting खारा :- ​पोषण/शोषणSalty (khara): - Nourishing/Depleting सुगन्ध/दुर्गन्ध :- ​प्रश्वसन/विश्वसनPleasant smell/Unpleasant smell (sugandh/durgandh): - Inhalation/Exhalation सुरूप/कुरूप ​:- अपनापन/परायापनBeautiful/Ugly (suroop/kuroop): - Affinity/Otherness पोषण ​ :- ​इकाई + अनुकूलइकाई।Nourishing (poshan): - unit + conducive unit शोषण ​:- ​इकाई - अनुकूलइकाई।:- ​ इकाई + प्रतिकूलइकाई।Depleting (shoshan): - unit - conducive unit

: - ​unit + unconducive unit.

“सर्वशुभहो” "May there be universal wellbeing"
